Jupiter.trainerLoses: Hmph. Maybe you've got more than nerve.

Jupiter.greeting: I don't care about Alola. I'm here because the strong ones are here.
Jupiter.trainerWins: And you're not one of them. Next.
Jupiter.trainerLoses: Fine. You're one of them. Don't let it go to your head.

Jupiter.greeting: Our boss has a vision for a new world. I just make sure nobody gets in the way.
Jupiter.trainerWins: Nobody gets in the way. Not even you.
Jupiter.trainerLoses: You got in the way. The boss won't like that.

Saturn.greeting: Commander Saturn. I prefer to settle things calmly. Shall we?
Team Galactic's goals don't concern you. This battle does.
Saturn.trainerWins: Battle concluded. Our goals remain unconcerned.
Saturn.trainerLoses: Perhaps you should concern yourself with our goals after all.

Saturn.greeting: I've been thinking about what a better world looks like. A battle helps me think.
Saturn.trainerWins: Thinking done. A better world includes my win.
Saturn.trainerLoses: Food for thought. I'll think on it.

Charon.greeting: Hohoho! A Team Galactic Commander, and a scientist besides! Let us experiment!
Charon.trainerWins: Hohoho! The experiment confirms my genius!
Charon.trainerLoses: Hohoho... the data must be wrong. Surely.

Charon.greeting: Power is everything, child. Power and knowledge. Do you have either?
These Alolan legends are fascinating. Imagine the power... hohoho!
Charon.trainerLoses: The power slipped away. Hohoho... I'll find more.

N.greeting: I'm N. I want to hear your partners' voices. Will you let them speak through this battle?
N.trainerWins: Their voices are kind, but they're tired. Let them rest.
N.trainerLoses: Your partners are happy with you. I can hear it.

N.greeting: Truth, ideals... I still don't know which is right. Maybe this battle will tell me.
N.trainerWins: This time, the battle didn't give me an answer.
N.trainerLoses: Maybe your way is the answer. I'll think about it.

N.greeting: Alola's people live so closely with their partners. I wanted to see it for myself.
N.trainerWins: Close bonds, but not close enough. Not yet.
N.trainerLoses: Close bonds, and real strength. Thank you.

Ghetsis.greeting: I am Ghetsis. You'll find I don't lose gracefully, so I simply don't lose.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: As I said. I don't lose.

Ghetsis.greeting: Power belongs to those who know how to use it. Let me demonstrate.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: You dare use power against me?!

Ghetsis.greeting: I am merely a humble Sage, here to enjoy the islands... and crush whoever I meet.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Crushed, as planned. How humble of me.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Not as planned. Not at all as planned.

Zinzolin.greeting: I am Zinzolin, one of Team Plasma's Sages. I find the tropics dreadfully hot.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: Defeat and heat. A terrible combination.

Zinzolin.greeting: Ice is patient. It waits, and then it shatters everything. Shall we wait together?
Zinzolin.trainerWins: The ice shatters. As it always does.

Zinzolin.greeting: Team Plasma had grand plans once. Today, I plan only to win.

Lysandre.greeting: I am Lysandre. I want a beautiful world. Show me whether you belong in it.
Lysandre.trainerWins: You don't belong in it. Yet.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: You belong in it more than I do. How bitter.

Lysandre.greeting: Those who take without giving make the world ugly. Which are you?
Lysandre.trainerWins: You took a chance and gave me a win. Thank you.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: You gave everything. I respect that deeply.

Lysandre.greeting: A café owner, a scientist, a dreamer. Today, simply a challenger.
Lysandre.trainerWins: Simply a challenger, and simply a winner.

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm... Xerosic, Team Flare's finest scientist. You'll make a fine test subject!
Xerosic.trainerWins: Data collected! Thank you, test subject!
Xerosic.trainerLoses: Hmm?! The data... contradicts my hypothesis!

Xerosic.greeting: Science has no morals. Only results. Let's get some results!
I built many gadgets in my time. None as satisfying as a good battle.
Xerosic.trainerLoses: Back to the lab, I suppose.

Bryony.greeting: I'm Bryony, a Team Flare admin. Let's make this quick; I have a fitting later.
Bryony.trainerWins: Quick, as promised. Off to my fitting.
Bryony.trainerLoses: I'll be late for my fitting now. Thanks a lot.

Bryony.greeting: Elegance is a weapon. Most people don't know how to wield it.
Alola's fashion is so... casual. I'll bring a little class to this battle.
Bryony.trainerLoses: Even class can't save every look.

Mable.greeting: I'm Mable, Team Flare admin. Blue suits me, and so does winning.
Research is my specialty. Let's research your weaknesses.
Mable.trainerLoses: Research says I'm the weak one. How annoying.

Mable.greeting: Team Flare is gone, but my ambition isn't. Let's see yours.
Mable.trainerLoses: Your ambition is bigger. For now.

Lusamine.greeting: I love all Pokémon, truly. That's why I'll show you how beautiful they are when they win.
Lusamine.trainerWins: Beautiful, weren't they? I love them so.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: You made my beauties lose? How cruel of you.

Lusamine.greeting: As President of the Aether Foundation, I protect what I love. Don't make me protect it from you.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: You've hurt what I love. I'll remember this.

Lusamine.greeting: My children say I'm too much. I say there's no such thing as too much love.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: Even love isn't enough sometimes. How painful.

Faba.greeting: I, Faba, Branch Chief of the Aether Foundation, will grace you with a battle. Be grateful.
Faba.trainerWins: You should be grateful. That was a privilege.
Faba.trainerLoses: This is... a temporary setback for a genius like me!

Faba.greeting: My research will change the world. A battle with you will barely change my afternoon.
Faba.trainerWins: As predicted. My afternoon remains unchanged.

Faba.greeting: Do you know how important I am? Very. Let me show you.
Faba.trainerLoses: Important people lose sometimes too... rarely.

Izzy.greeting: One moment I was at my laptop, the next I was here. I've been researching this world ever since. Prodigious!
Izzy.trainerWins: Just as my calculations predicted! I'll add this battle to my research notes.
Izzy.trainerLoses: Fascinating... I clearly overlooked a few variables. Back to the data!

Izzy.greeting: My partner was reformatted the moment we crossed over. Same heart, all-new data. Let me show you what we learned!
Izzy.trainerWins: Knowledge is power, and today's data proves it!
Izzy.trainerLoses: Your strategy didn't fit any of my models. I'll have to revise my theory.

Izzy.greeting: Tai and the others were pulled into this world too. They explore it; I study it. Care to be my next data point?
Izzy.trainerWins: Wait till I tell Tai! He never believes my theories until he sees them work.
Izzy.trainerLoses: Tai would say I overthought it. Please don't tell him he was right.

Kaito.greeting: I don't give orders. I give information. My partner decides what to do with it. Your move.
Kaito.trainerWins: Three seconds. That's all it took. ...Good battle, though.
Kaito.trainerLoses: You read us better than most. My partner will want a rematch. So will I.

Kaito.greeting: People see my team and assume the worst. Fine. Battle us, then decide for yourself who we are.
Kaito.trainerWins: Labels don't win battles. Choices do.
Kaito.trainerLoses: You didn't judge us. You just beat us. I can respect that.

Kaito.greeting: Nobody owns my partner. We fight beside each other because we chose to. Don't mistake that for weakness.
Kaito.trainerWins: We chose this fight, and we chose to win it.
Kaito.trainerLoses: We'll be back. Not because anyone told us to. Because we want to.

Takato.greeting: One second I was drawing dinosaurs in class, the next I was here! At least my partner came too. Let's battle!
Takato.trainerWins: We did it! I'm drawing this battle in my notebook tonight!
Takato.trainerLoses: Aw, man... You were awesome, though. Can I draw your team?

Takato.greeting: I don't know how we ended up in this world, but if there's a battle, my partner and I won't run from it!
Takato.trainerWins: Yes! My partner's going to want bread to celebrate. Lots of bread.
Takato.trainerLoses: We'll get stronger. That's what Tamers do. Good battle!

Takato.greeting: I'm not the bravest guy around, but my partner believes in me. That's enough to make me try!
Takato.trainerWins: We actually won! I mean, of course we did. ...We did, right?
Takato.trainerLoses: I froze up a little. Next time I'll be braver. Promise!

Rika.greeting: Digi-Modify! Poké Matrix Activate! ...What? A card slash works in any world. Let's go.
Rika.trainerWins: Too easy. Next time, bring a real challenge.
Rika.trainerLoses: Fine. You won. Don't let it go to your head.

Rika.greeting: I was winning a card tournament when this world dragged me in. Lucky you. Now you get to lose to the Queen.
Rika.trainerWins: Queen of this world too, apparently. Shocker.
Rika.trainerLoses: Hmph. I'll find my way home. Right after I beat you in a rematch.

Rika.greeting: No idea how I got here, and I don't care. My partner's with me. That's all I need to win.
Rika.trainerWins: My partner and I don't need anyone else. ...Okay, that was a good battle.
Rika.trainerLoses: ...Not bad. My partner thinks so too. Don't expect me to say it twice.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: I was fixing my dad's code when the screen flashed, and now I'm here. I'd rather talk, but I'll battle if I must.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: I'm glad nobody got hurt. You fought with honor.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: Well played. My partner would just say "Momentai." Take it easy.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: One minute I was home with my little sister, the next I was in this world. Let's keep this a fair fight.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: A clean win. That's how my martial arts teacher taught me.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: You read my moves well. I'll train harder and come back calmer.

Henry (Tamer).greeting: Fighting should never be just for fun. But a fair battle, with rules and respect? That I can do.
Henry (Tamer).trainerWins: Balance and patience. That's all it takes.
Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: Patience lost to passion today. I'll think about that.

Tate.greeting: Hehehe! Did you think you'd face us one at a time?
We can feel each other's thoughts...

Liza.greeting: Our teamwork is out of this world!

Tai.greeting: Me and Matt, together again! Courage and Friendship, just like old times on File Island!
Tai.trainerWins: See, Matt? Charging in works! ...With you covering me, anyway.
Tai.trainerLoses: Okay, that one's on me. Matt, don't say it.

Tai.greeting: Our partners fought side by side to save two worlds. One tree's nothing! Right, Matt?
Tai.trainerWins: Two worlds, one tree! Fist bump, Matt!
Tai.trainerLoses: We've lost before and come back stronger. Right, Matt?

Tai.greeting: Matt and I fought each other plenty as kids. Fighting alongside him is way better. Ready?
Tai.trainerWins: Best rivals, best friends, best team! That's us!
Tai.trainerLoses: Ugh! We'll get 'em in the rematch. I'll lead this time... again.

Matt.greeting: Try not to run ahead this time, Tai. ...Fine. Let's show them what the DigiDestined can do.
Matt.trainerWins: You ran ahead. Again. Good thing I was there. ...Nice job, Tai.
Matt.trainerLoses: I wasn't going to say anything, Tai. ...Your plan was terrible, though.

Matt.greeting: Two worlds, and he still forgets to plan. Stay sharp, Tai. These two are good.
Matt.trainerWins: ...Fine. One fist bump. Don't make it weird, Tai.
Matt.trainerLoses: Right. And next time, we follow my plan.

Matt.greeting: Tai's the sun, I'm the moon. Annoying, but it works. Let's go.
Matt.trainerWins: Don't let it go to your head, Tai. ...It was a good win.
Matt.trainerLoses: You always lead, Tai. Maybe that's the problem. ...Kidding. Mostly.

multiNote: Lines for trainers who always battle together as opponents in a Multi Battle (Tate and Liza; Tai and Matt): the same set index is used for both, so they answer each other. Used only when they battle together.
pairsNote: Greetings for two special trainers drawn together in a Multi Battle who share a region or a type (written for this app). Each entry has one set of lines per trainer: a greeting and both closing remarks, all about battling together (closing remarks added 2026-10-19, on request). To add a pair, add an entry with both trainers' names and a set for each. The Elite Four and Champions (added 2026-10-10) also greet partners they have a relationship with (Koga and Janine, Lance and Clair, Wallace and Juan, Flint and Volkner, Iris and Drayden...), other Champions, and a few kindred spirits (Siebold with the Striaton chefs and Mallow, Diantha with Brycen, Kukui with Crasher Wake; and Mallow with every one of the younger female Gym Leaders, added 2026-10-19 on request). The evil teams' leaders and admins (added 2026-10-11) follow the region rule too, plus Giovanni with his Rocket Executives; trainers with two versions (Archie, Maxie) are listed by their key ("Archie (ORAS)") and never paired with themselves. The younger female Gym Leaders (Misty, Erika, Sabrina, Janine, Whitney, Jasmine, Clair, Roxanne, Flannery, Winona, Gardenia, Maylene, Candice, Elesa, Skyla, Roxie; added 2026-10-18, on request) greet each other too, as friends, whatever their region or type. Courtney only teams up with female trainers (on request, 2026-10-19), so her pair lines with male characters were removed.

Brock.greeting: Misty and I go way back. Pewter and Cerulean, rock and water. We know each other's moves by heart.
Brock.trainerWins: Moves we know by heart, and a win we earned together. Nice work, Misty!
Brock.trainerLoses: We knew each other's moves by heart. Guess you learned them too.

Misty.greeting: Brock, if you start flirting with the Pokémon Center nurse mid-battle, I'm soaking you myself!
Misty.trainerWins: Not one soaking needed! Brock behaved, and we won!
Misty.trainerLoses: Fine, we lost. And no, Brock, it wasn't the nurse's fault.

Brock.greeting: Surge says his Electric types will carry us. My Rock types say they'll be the ones standing at the end.
Brock.trainerWins: Rock and lightning, still standing at the end. Just like I said.
Brock.trainerLoses: My Rock types didn't stand at the end this time. You earned that one.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Hey, kid! Pewter's rock wall and Vermilion's lightning, together. Your team won't know what hit it!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Told ya, kid! Rock wall and lightning! Your team never knew what hit it!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! Even rock and lightning can crumble. Good fight, kid!

Brock.greeting: Erika keeps watering the plants by the stairs. Rock and Grass get along better than you'd think.
Brock.trainerWins: Rock and Grass, getting along just fine. Thanks for the teamwork, Erika.
Brock.trainerLoses: Rock and Grass couldn't hold you back. Impressive.

Erika.greeting: Brock offered to carry my flower arrangements up the tree. Such a sturdy gentleman. Now, shall we?
Erika.trainerWins: A sturdy gentleman and a quiet garden. A lovely win, Brock.
Erika.trainerLoses: Oh my. Even sturdy gentlemen fall sometimes. Shall we rest?

Brock.greeting: Janine was standing behind me this whole time? Kanto's ninja is good. I'll handle the front line.
Brock.trainerWins: I held the front line, and Janine did the rest. Never even saw her.
Brock.trainerLoses: The front line broke. I'll train harder... and so will she, knowing Janine.

Janine.greeting: Brock never even noticed me. Kanto's rock is strong, but my poison strikes from the shadows!
Janine.trainerWins: The shadows struck true! Brock never knew I was there, and neither did you!
Janine.trainerLoses: You saw through the shadows. Father would be impressed. I'm annoyed.

Brock.greeting: Sabrina says she already knows how this ends. As a Kanto Leader, I prefer to earn it the hard way.
Brock.trainerWins: We earned it the hard way, Sabrina. Even if you saw it coming.
Brock.trainerLoses: Sabrina, did you see THAT coming? ...Don't answer.

Sabrina.greeting: Brock's defense and my foresight. I have seen this battle, and Kanto does not lose it.
Sabrina.trainerWins: As foreseen. Kanto does not lose this battle.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: My foresight failed. Brock's way, the hard way, it seems.

Brock.greeting: Blaine asked me a quiz question on the way up. I got it wrong. Let's hope my battling goes better.
Brock.trainerWins: Battling went better than the quiz! Thanks, Blaine.
Brock.trainerLoses: Wrong answer on the quiz, wrong moves in battle. Rough day.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Brock's rocks don't melt, but my fire will melt your hopes! Kanto's quiz is in session!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Quiz complete! Your hopes melted, just like I said!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! You answered my quiz correctly. Bravo, challenger!

Brock.greeting: I'm teaming up with Giovanni? Viridian's Gym Leader... and Team Rocket's boss. Just this once.
Brock.trainerWins: A win's a win... even with Team Rocket's boss. Just this once, though.
Brock.trainerLoses: Losing with Giovanni. I'm not sure which part I like least.

Giovanni.greeting: The Pewter Gym Leader. Reliable, like the bedrock under Viridian. He'll do as a shield.
Giovanni.trainerWins: The bedrock held, and the challenger fell. As expected.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: My shield cracked. A rare miscalculation on my part.

Misty.greeting: Surge, if your Electric attack hits my Water Pokémon, you're buying the whole team dinner!
Misty.trainerWins: No zaps on my team, and we won! Surge, you're off the hook for dinner.
Misty.trainerLoses: Not one hit landed on my team... from Surge. The rest? From you.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Ha! Misty's afraid I'll zap her team. Don't worry, kid, I only aim at the enemy. Mostly!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Ha! Aimed at the enemy, just like I promised! Mission complete!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! You out-soldiered a soldier, kid! Respect!

Misty.greeting: Erika's Grass types and my Water types? Cerulean and Celadon's cutest combo. Let's go!
Misty.trainerWins: Cerulean and Celadon's cutest combo wins again!
Misty.trainerLoses: Cutest combo, but not the strongest today. Next time!

Erika.greeting: Misty keeps my garden watered and my battles lively. Kanto's flowers bloom brightest together.
Erika.trainerWins: Watered and lively, and victorious. Kanto's garden is in full bloom.
Erika.trainerLoses: Our flowers wilted a little today. They'll bloom again.

Misty.greeting: Janine snuck up on me in the lobby! I almost threw a Water Gun at her. We're on the same team, right?
Misty.trainerWins: Good thing I didn't Water Gun my own teammate! We did it!
Misty.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe I should have aimed that Water Gun at you instead.

Janine.greeting: Misty's temper is louder than a thunderstorm. Good. It keeps you looking at her while I strike.
Janine.trainerWins: Misty kept you busy, and I struck. A perfect plan.
Janine.trainerLoses: My strike missed. Misty was loud enough, it's my fault.

Misty.greeting: Sabrina gives me the chills, but she's on my side today. Saffron and Cerulean. Bring it!
Misty.trainerWins: Saffron and Cerulean, unbeatable! Sabrina, you can smile now.
Misty.trainerLoses: You beat Saffron AND Cerulean? I'm soaking myself in shame.

Sabrina.greeting: Misty's fire burns hotter than her Water types. I foresee her splashing you out of this battle.
Sabrina.trainerWins: I foresaw the splash. It was magnificent.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: The vision was clouded. Misty's fire wasn't enough today.

Misty.greeting: Blaine's fire and my water. We'll make so much steam you won't see a thing!
Misty.trainerWins: All that steam, and you still couldn't see us coming!
Misty.trainerLoses: So much steam, and you saw right through it.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Water and fire, side by side! Even my hot springs can't match Misty's temper!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Fire, water, and victory! What a recipe!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! My hot springs are cooler than this loss!

Misty.greeting: Giovanni? You'd better not try anything funny. I'll be watching you, Team Rocket!
Misty.trainerWins: We won, Giovanni. Now hands where I can see them.
Misty.trainerLoses: We lost, and I still don't trust you, Giovanni.

Giovanni.greeting: The Cerulean Gym Leader has a fiery spirit. Aim it at our opponent, and we'll get along.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Your spirit was aimed well, Cerulean. We got along after all.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Hmph. Even our alliance couldn't stop this challenger.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Erika, take a nap if you want. I'll electrify 'em before you wake up! Kanto's strongest, coming through!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Electrified 'em before you woke up, Erika! Mission accomplished!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! I couldn't electrify 'em fast enough! Wake up, Erika, we lost!

Erika.greeting: Lt. Surge is so loud. Still, Vermilion and Celadon make quite the bouquet. Let's battle.
Erika.trainerWins: What a lovely bouquet we made. And quite a loud one.
Erika.trainerLoses: Even our bouquet wilted. Perhaps I should have stayed awake.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Janine's a sneaky little ninja. Me? I come in loud, like a thunderclap. Kanto covers both!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Loud and sneaky, the perfect combo! Kanto wins!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Thunderclap couldn't drown you out, kid. Good fight!

Janine.greeting: The Lieutenant made so much noise climbing up, they'll never notice me slipping in.
Janine.trainerWins: They never noticed me slipping in. Thank you for the noise, Lieutenant.
Janine.trainerLoses: You noticed me after all. The Lieutenant was too loud.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Saffron's right next door to Vermilion. Sabrina predicts, I electrocute. Easy mission, soldier!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Easy mission, just like I said! Predict and electrocute!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Mission failed, soldier. Even with Sabrina's predictions!

Sabrina.greeting: Surge's lightning is predictable. That is why it works so well with my power. Kanto will win.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Predictable lightning, unpredictable defeat for you. As planned.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: His lightning was predictable. So, it seems, was my plan.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Blaine, old man! You burn 'em, I zap 'em! What's left is a pile of ashes and sparks!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Ashes and sparks, just like I promised! Great fight, old man!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! No ashes, no sparks. Just us, beaten. Good one, kid!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Surge's sparks and my blaze! Quiz time: what's left of your team after this? Nothing!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Quiz answer: nothing's left of your team! Correct!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! The answer was "our team." Wrong answer for us!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Giovanni and I go way back. Two Kanto Leaders who don't mess around. Prepare yourself, kid!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Two Leaders who don't mess around! Told ya, kid!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! You messed us up good, kid! Respect!

Giovanni.greeting: Lt. Surge follows orders well. Today, my orders are simple: crush this challenger.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Orders carried out. The challenger has been crushed.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: My orders failed. Unacceptable... and impressive.

Erika.greeting: Janine wanted to borrow some of my Grass Pokémon's sleep powder. I believe she has a plan.
Erika.trainerWins: Janine's plan worked beautifully. And so did my sleep powder.
Erika.trainerLoses: Oh dear. The plan put us to sleep instead.

Janine.greeting: Erika's flowers smell lovely. Mine smell lovely too... right before the poison sets in.
Janine.trainerWins: Lovely flowers, lovely poison, lovely victory!
Janine.trainerLoses: The poison didn't set in fast enough. I'll train harder.

Erika.greeting: Sabrina says she foresaw me falling asleep. How rude. I was merely resting my eyes. Shall we?
Erika.trainerWins: I was merely resting my eyes, and still we won. How nice.
Erika.trainerLoses: Perhaps I truly was asleep. That would explain this loss.

Sabrina.greeting: Erika's garden is calm. My mind is calm. Your defeat will be quite peaceful.
Sabrina.trainerWins: A peaceful defeat, as foreseen. For you.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: My vision of peace was... inaccurate. Hmm.

Erika.greeting: Blaine, please mind my flowers with your fire. Kanto's Leaders must work together, after all.
Erika.trainerWins: Kanto's Leaders worked together, and my flowers are unharmed. Lovely.
Erika.trainerLoses: My flowers are fine. Our pride, less so.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Erika's worried about her flowers. Don't fret! I only burn challengers. Quiz time!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Only challengers burned! Quiz complete!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! A flower-friendly fire, and still we lost!

Erika.greeting: Giovanni... I remember Team Rocket's Game Corner in Celadon. Very well. Just for today.
Erika.trainerWins: A win for Celadon. And for Giovanni, just this once.
Erika.trainerLoses: I knew this alliance was ill-fated. Perhaps it was the Game Corner luck.

Giovanni.greeting: Celadon's Gym Leader. Elegant, and far tougher than she looks. Let's see what she can do.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Tougher than she looks, indeed. A fine result.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Even elegance can't save a poor gamble.

Janine.greeting: Sabrina read my mind before I could sneak up on her. Fine. Then you'll be the one surprised!
Janine.trainerWins: Surprised? I told you you'd be the one surprised!
Janine.trainerLoses: Sabrina read your mind too, didn't she? We still lost...

Sabrina.greeting: Janine moves without a sound. I move without moving. Kanto's quiet Leaders are its deadliest.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Kanto's quiet Leaders are its deadliest. As I said.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: You made no sound and beat us anyway. Impressive.

Janine.greeting: Blaine's quizzes are so loud! Okay, Blaine, here's mine: where am I hiding? Exactly. Let's go!
Janine.trainerWins: Where am I hiding? Behind a victory! Great quiz, Blaine!
Janine.trainerLoses: I hid so well, I hid our chance to win. Oops.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Janine's poison and my fire. Here's a quiz: how fast can a challenger fall? Very!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Quiz answer: very fast! Correct!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! The challenger fell slower than planned. Not at all, actually!

Janine.greeting: Father worked for Giovanni once. I'll show him what Koga's daughter can do on her own!
Janine.trainerWins: Koga's daughter, winning on her own terms! Even beside Giovanni.
Janine.trainerLoses: I couldn't prove myself today. Father would say train harder.

Giovanni.greeting: Koga's daughter. Her father served me well. Let's see if she has his talent.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Her father's talent runs deep. Well done, ninja.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: The ninja's talent wasn't enough. Nor mine, it seems.

Sabrina.greeting: Blaine's next quiz question: how will this battle end? I already know the answer.
Sabrina.trainerWins: The answer to the quiz: we win. I knew it all along.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: The answer was... we lose. I should have looked closer.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Sabrina knows all my quiz answers. No fair! Still, a psychic partner's a fine thing to have!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! A psychic partner AND a win! Splendid!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Even a psychic can't answer every quiz!

Sabrina.greeting: Team Rocket once took over Saffron's Silph Co. I foresaw today's alliance. I didn't like it.
Sabrina.trainerWins: I foresaw the win. I still don't like the company.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: I foresaw this alliance. I should have foreseen this loss.

Giovanni.greeting: The Saffron Gym Leader. Her power is genuine. Together, Kanto's might is beyond your reach.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Kanto's might, beyond your reach. As I promised.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Beyond your reach, I said. Apparently not.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Giovanni! I quit working for Team Rocket's lab years ago! Today, we're just Kanto Leaders!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Just two Kanto Leaders, and one big win!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Rocket lab or Gym, losing still burns!

Giovanni.greeting: Blaine. Hot-tempered, but brilliant. Viridian and Cinnabar will scorch this challenger to the ground.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Scorched to the ground, as promised. Excellent.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Cinnabar and Viridian, extinguished. How disappointing.

Falkner.greeting: Bugsy loves Bug types. I love Flying types. Johto's first two Gyms will show you the way up!
Falkner.trainerWins: Johto's first two Gyms showed you the way up! Great job, Bugsy!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We showed you the way up, and you climbed right past us.

Bugsy.greeting: Falkner's Flying types eat Bug types in the wild... but in battle, we're the best of friends!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Best friends in battle, and best winners too!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Even best friends lose sometimes. My research continues!

Falkner.greeting: Whitney's team is fearsome when she's not crying. My father taught me to soar above any trouble. Johto takes flight!
Falkner.trainerWins: No tears today, Whitney! Johto took flight!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We didn't soar today. Whitney, please don't cry... too much.

Whitney.greeting: Falkner's birds are so cute! Teaming up with them is gonna be super fun. No crying today!
Whitney.trainerWins: Super fun, and no crying! I told you so!
Whitney.trainerLoses: I said no crying... but I'm gonna cry a little.

Falkner.greeting: Morty's ghosts and my birds both rule the Johto skies. We'll show you the mystic heights!
Falkner.trainerWins: Johto's skies are ours! Mystic heights reached!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We didn't reach the heights today. My father would want me to try again.

Morty.greeting: Falkner's wings over Violet City, my visions over Ecruteak. Johto's skies favor us today.
Morty.trainerWins: Johto's skies favored us, as I saw.
Morty.trainerLoses: The skies changed. My visions didn't.

Falkner.greeting: Chuck's been doing pushups since we got here. I'll keep the skies clear while he punches!
Falkner.trainerWins: Skies clear, punches landed! What a team!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Even clear skies couldn't stop that challenger. Train harder, Chuck!

Chuck.greeting: Falkner, your birds are tough! But can they lift boulders? Wahahah! Johto's strength, together!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Johto's strength wins! Now, pushups!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! I'll lift a boulder to get over this one!

Falkner.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types can take my Flying types' hits... so it's a good thing we're partners.
Falkner.trainerWins: Steel and Flying, a perfect pair! Thanks, Jasmine!
Falkner.trainerLoses: My birds couldn't carry us this time. Sorry, Jasmine.

Jasmine.greeting: Falkner's birds flew me from Olivine. The view from the lighthouse is nothing like this tree.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We won... The view from up here is lovely after a win.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We lost... Falkner, let's fly home to Olivine.

Falkner.greeting: Pryce has trained longer than I've been alive. Johto's youngest and oldest Leaders, side by side.
Falkner.trainerWins: Johto's youngest and oldest, victorious!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Even with Pryce's experience, we fell. I'll keep training.

Pryce.greeting: Young Falkner flies so freely. I remember those days. Let's show this challenger winter's chill.
Pryce.trainerWins: Winter's chill, delivered. Well flown, young Falkner.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Ah, the chill turned on us. Even old men lose.

Falkner.greeting: Clair's dragons fly higher than my birds. Don't tell her I said that. Johto, take wing!
Falkner.trainerWins: Johto took wing! Clair, your dragons were great... don't let that go to your head.
Falkner.trainerLoses: We were grounded. Clair will never let me hear the end of this.

Clair.greeting: Falkner's birds are adequate. My dragons rule the skies. Johto's skies, that is. Let's go.
Clair.trainerWins: My dragons did their job. Your birds were... adequate.
Clair.trainerLoses: You beat my dragons? Unacceptable. Falkner, we train tomorrow.

Bugsy.greeting: Whitney cried when I showed her my bug collection. But today, she's going to make you cry instead!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Whitney made you cry instead! Just like I said!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Whitney's crying, and I'm writing this loss in my research notes.

Whitney.greeting: Bugsy's bugs gave me a fright, but they're tough! Our Johto team-up is gonna be the best!
Whitney.trainerWins: The best Johto team-up ever! Yay!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Bugsy's bugs were tough, but you were tougher. Waah!

Bugsy.greeting: Morty says there are ghost bugs in Ecruteak's Burned Tower. I need to research that! After this!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Johto knew your every move! Now, to the Burned Tower for research!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: My research was incomplete. And you knew it.

Morty.greeting: Bugsy researches everything. I research the unseen. Between us, Johto knows your every move.
Morty.trainerWins: As I saw it: Johto knew your every move.
Morty.trainerLoses: The unseen surprised even me today.

Bugsy.greeting: Chuck says bugs are too small to be strong. Just watch my team, Chuck! Johto power!
Bugsy.trainerWins: See, Chuck? Bugs are strong! Johto power!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Chuck, maybe bugs are too small... No! I refuse!

Chuck.greeting: Bugsy's bugs are tougher than they look! Like a waterfall's spray. Wahahah! Let's go!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! The waterfall's spray wins! Great job, Bugsy!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! That spray dried up fast! Good fight!

Bugsy.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types are hard to research. They're so shiny! Let's study this battle together!
Bugsy.trainerWins: This battle's data is shiny and wonderful! We won!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: The data says we lost. I'll study it anyway.

Jasmine.greeting: Bugsy told me all about Bug types on the way up. I... learned a lot. Let's do our best.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I learned a lot about Bug types... and about winning. Thank you, Bugsy.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I learned something new... about losing. Let's do better next time.

Bugsy.greeting: Pryce says bugs don't survive Mahogany's winters. Mine do! I bred them myself!
Bugsy.trainerWins: My bugs survived Mahogany's winter AND this battle!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Even my bred bugs couldn't survive that. I'll keep researching!

Pryce.greeting: Bugsy's enthusiasm reminds me of my youth. Johto's oldest and youngest. Let's show you what we know.
Pryce.trainerWins: Johto's oldest and youngest know a thing or two. As do you, now.
Pryce.trainerLoses: We showed you what we know. You showed us more.

Bugsy.greeting: Clair says dragons outclass bugs. My research says otherwise! Johto's Gyms, together!
Bugsy.trainerWins: My research was right! Johto's Gyms, victorious!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: My research needs revising... and so does Clair's opinion of me, probably.

Clair.greeting: A bug researcher as my partner? Fine. Just stay out of my dragons' way, Bugsy.
Clair.trainerWins: My dragons won. Your bugs stayed out of the way. Good.
Clair.trainerLoses: You stayed out of my way, and still we lost. Hmph.

Whitney.greeting: Morty's ghosts are spooky! But with them on my side, nothing can scare me. Johto's cutest Leader is here!
Whitney.trainerWins: Nothing scared me, and we won! Johto's cutest Leader wins!
Whitney.trainerLoses: The ghosts didn't scare me... but losing did! Waah!

Morty.greeting: Whitney cried at the Burned Tower. Today, I foresee her laughing. Ecruteak and Goldenrod, together.
Morty.trainerWins: I foresaw her laughing. And so she is.
Morty.trainerLoses: I foresaw laughter. I see tears. My visions need work.

Whitney.greeting: Chuck's all muscles and I'm all heart! Goldenrod and Cianwood, let's roll right over 'em!
Whitney.trainerWins: We rolled right over 'em! Goldenrod and Cianwood rule!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We got rolled over instead! Not cute!

Chuck.greeting: Whitney's team rolls in like a boulder down a waterfall! Wahahah! We're unbeatable!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Unbeatable, like I said!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Beaten! I'll do a thousand pushups!

Whitney.greeting: Jasmine and I go shopping in Goldenrod sometimes! Today, we're shopping for a win!
Whitney.trainerWins: Shopping trip complete! We bought ourselves a win!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We couldn't afford a win today. Jasmine, let's go shopping to cheer up!

Jasmine.greeting: Whitney is my friend. She's very... energetic. I'll do my best to keep up. Let's battle.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I kept up with Whitney... and we won. Good.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I couldn't keep up. I'm sorry, Whitney.

Whitney.greeting: Pryce is like a grumpy grandpa. But he's super strong! Johto's not losing today!
Whitney.trainerWins: The grumpy grandpa and me, unbeatable! Johto wins!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Johto lost?! Pryce, say something comforting! ...He won't.

Pryce.greeting: Whitney's tears could freeze in Mahogany's cold. Let's make sure she has nothing to cry about.
Pryce.trainerWins: Nothing to cry about. Well done, Whitney.
Pryce.trainerLoses: There's crying now. I failed to prevent it.

Whitney.greeting: Clair's so cool and scary! I bet her dragons and my cuties make the strongest Johto team ever!
Whitney.trainerWins: The strongest Johto team ever! Told you, Clair!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Clair's mad at me now. This is the worst!

Clair.greeting: Whitney's team is the one thing in Goldenrod I respect. Don't slow me down.
Clair.trainerWins: You didn't slow me down. ...Fine. Good job, Whitney.
Clair.trainerLoses: You slowed me down. Or the challenger was simply better.

Morty.greeting: Chuck punches what he can see. My ghosts strike what you can't. Johto has you surrounded.
Morty.trainerWins: Johto surrounded you, seen and unseen.
Morty.trainerLoses: We had you surrounded, and you still slipped through.

Chuck.greeting: Morty's ghosts give me goosebumps! But Fighting moves don't touch them... so they're perfect partners!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Perfect partners! Ghosts and fists!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Goosebumps AND a loss! Rough day!

Morty.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types stand firm against my ghosts. Today, they stand beside them. Shall we?
Morty.trainerWins: Steel and spirit, standing firm together. A fine battle.
Morty.trainerLoses: Even standing together, we fell. Hmm.

Jasmine.greeting: Morty told me Ecruteak's legends about a rainbow-winged guardian. I hope I see it over the Olivine lighthouse someday.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We won... Maybe the rainbow guardian was watching over us.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We lost... I hope the guardian didn't see that.

Morty.greeting: Pryce has seen many winters, and I have seen many spirits. Johto's wisdom is on our side.
Morty.trainerWins: Johto's wisdom prevailed, as I saw it would.
Morty.trainerLoses: Even Johto's wisdom couldn't see this coming.

Pryce.greeting: Morty, the Ecruteak mystic. Young, but he sees deeply. Together, we'll see this through.
Pryce.trainerWins: We saw it through, young Morty. Well done.
Pryce.trainerLoses: We didn't see it through. Perhaps I'm getting old.

Morty.greeting: Clair's dragons are legendary in Blackthorn. In Ecruteak, we have our own legends. Let's battle.
Morty.trainerWins: Ecruteak's legends and Blackthorn's, victorious together.
Morty.trainerLoses: Our legends were outshone today.

Clair.greeting: Morty's still waiting for his rainbow legend, isn't he? Fine. I'll show you a real legend: my dragons.
Clair.trainerWins: You saw a real legend today. My dragons.
Clair.trainerLoses: A real legend lost. That's not supposed to happen.

Chuck.greeting: Jasmine's from Olivine, just across the sea from Cianwood! I'll swim over to help any time!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Cianwood and Olivine, sturdy and strong!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! I'll swim back to Cianwood and train!

Jasmine.greeting: Chuck is very loud. But strong. Cianwood and Olivine's Gym Leaders will make a sturdy team.
Jasmine.trainerWins: A sturdy team, as I hoped. Thank you, Chuck.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We weren't sturdy enough today. I'm sorry, Chuck.

Chuck.greeting: Pryce trains under ice! I train under waterfalls! Johto's toughest training, combined!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! The toughest training wins!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Waterfalls AND ice, and still we lost!

Pryce.greeting: Chuck's waterfall training is impressive. Try it in Mahogany's winter, young man.
Pryce.trainerWins: Your training held up, young man. Impressive.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Even ice cracks. I'll train harder, at my age.

Chuck.greeting: Clair, your dragons are strong! But can they do a hundred pushups? Mine can! Johto power!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Pushups pay off! Johto power!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! I'll do a thousand pushups to make up for this!

Clair.greeting: Chuck's fists won't scratch my dragons. Good thing they're aimed at you today.
Clair.trainerWins: Your fists did fine. Aimed at the right target.
Clair.trainerLoses: Your fists missed, Chuck. So did my dragons.

Jasmine.greeting: Pryce is very wise. He told me Steel types can stand any winter. I'll trust him.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Pryce was right. Steel stands any winter.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: Even Steel types fall in a hard winter...

Pryce.greeting: Jasmine is gentle, but her Steel types never bend. Johto's strongest, together.
Pryce.trainerWins: Gentle, but unbending. Johto's strongest, as I said.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Even steel bends sometimes. Well fought.

Jasmine.greeting: Clair... looks scary. But her dragons protected me on the way up. Let's battle together.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Clair's dragons protected me again. Thank you.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Clair... I couldn't help enough.

Clair.greeting: Jasmine's Steel types can take a dragon's hit. Useful. Stay behind me, Olivine.
Clair.trainerWins: You stayed behind me and we won. Good, Olivine.
Clair.trainerLoses: Even with you behind me, we fell. Annoying.

Pryce.greeting: Clair. Your dragons once fell to my ice. Today, they'll rise beside it. Johto stands strong.
Pryce.trainerWins: Ice and dragon, rising together. Johto stands strong.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Even ice and dragons can melt away.

Clair.greeting: Pryce's ice is the only thing I've ever feared. Today, it's your problem. Let's go.
Clair.trainerWins: Pryce's ice and my dragons. Your problem, solved.
Clair.trainerLoses: Your problem became ours. How irritating.

Roxanne.greeting: Brawly surfs, I study. Rustboro and Dewford are neighbors by boat, and our strategies fit together.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Studying and surfing, a winning strategy! I'll write it down.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Our strategies didn't fit after all. Back to my notes.

Brawly.greeting: Roxanne's got the notes, I've got the waves! Hoenn's first two Gyms are gonna wipe you out!
Brawly.trainerWins: We wiped you out! Hoenn's first two Gyms rule!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Wiped out by the wave instead. Tough break!

Roxanne.greeting: Wattson laughs through every battle. I took notes on why it works. Hoenn's lesson starts now.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Hoenn's lesson is over. You learned it well... by losing.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: The lesson turned on us. I'll take better notes.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Roxanne's the smartest Leader in Hoenn, and I'm the most electrifying! Ready?
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! Even I can't laugh this one off! ...Okay, a little.

Roxanne.greeting: Flannery's fire meets my Rock types' defense. According to my notes, that's an excellent pairing.
Roxanne.trainerWins: According to my notes, an excellent pairing. Confirmed!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: My notes were wrong. How embarrassing.

Flannery.greeting: Roxanne's so put together! I'm trying to be, too. Lavaridge and Rustboro, let's heat things up!
Flannery.trainerWins: Heated things up and won! Put together, just like Roxanne!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I tried to be put together... and we fell apart. Ugh!

Roxanne.greeting: Norman is the most respected Leader in Hoenn. I studied his battles at the Trainers' School.
Roxanne.trainerWins: I learned so much from battling with Norman. And we won!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Even studying Norman's battles couldn't prepare me for that.

Norman.greeting: Roxanne taught at the Trainers' School. Her students learn well. Let's give you a lesson, too.
Norman.trainerWins: A lesson well taught. Thank you, Roxanne.
Norman.trainerLoses: The lesson was ours to learn today. Well done, challenger.

Roxanne.greeting: Winona's Flying types cover the sky; my Rock types hold the ground. Hoenn has you surrounded.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Sky and ground, you had nowhere to go!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Surrounded, and you still escaped. Fascinating.

Winona.greeting: Roxanne's Rock types are sturdy, like Fortree's treetops. Let's soar to victory.
Winona.trainerWins: We soared to victory, Roxanne. Well done.
Winona.trainerLoses: Our treetops shook today. Well fought.

Roxanne.greeting: Juan taught Wallace, and Wallace became Champion. I'd like to take notes on his battling today.
Roxanne.trainerWins: My notes on Juan's battling are complete. And so is our win!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: I took notes on how we lost. Very thorough notes.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Roxanne! A scholar of stone. Let our Hoenn art, rock and water, sculpt your defeat.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a sculpture of defeat, for you! Magnificent!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our sculpture crumbled. Still, a fine piece of art.

Roxanne.greeting: Wally earned my badge, didn't he? He's grown so much. I'm happy to battle alongside him.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Wally's grown so much! We won together!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Wally, don't worry. Losing is part of learning.

Wally.greeting: Roxanne was my very first Gym battle! Now we're partners. I want to make Hoenn proud!
Wally.trainerWins: I made Hoenn proud with Roxanne! I did it!
Wally.trainerLoses: I didn't make Hoenn proud today... I'll keep trying!

Roxanne.greeting: Anabel was a Frontier Brain in Hoenn. I studied the Battle Frontier's records for months.
Roxanne.trainerWins: My months of study paid off! Thank you, Anabel.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Even months of study couldn't prepare me for you.

Anabel.greeting: Roxanne's bond with her Pokémon is very steady. Like stone. Hoenn's Trainers won't fall easily.
Anabel.trainerWins: Steady as stone, and victorious. Hoenn holds.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Even stone cracks. Your bond was stronger.

Brawly.greeting: Wattson's got energy like a big wave! Dewford and Mauville, let's ride this one together!
Brawly.trainerWins: We rode that wave all the way in! Great job, Wattson!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The wave crashed on us. Still a great ride!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Brawly's sea breeze and my lightning! Hoenn's having a thunderstorm today!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! The storm passed you right by!

Brawly.greeting: Flannery's hot, I'm cool, like the ocean breeze. Hoenn's big wave is coming for you!
Brawly.trainerWins: The big wave came for you, just like I said!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The big wave missed. Totally wiped out!

Flannery.greeting: Brawly surfed all the way here? I'll bring the heat, Brawly. You bring the waves!
Flannery.trainerWins: Heat and waves, a perfect combo! We won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: My heat fizzled out... Sorry, Brawly!

Brawly.greeting: Norman's the strongest guy in Hoenn. Teaming up with him? That's the biggest wave I've caught!
Brawly.trainerWins: Biggest wave of my life, and we rode it!
Brawly.trainerLoses: That wave was too big even for Norman and me.

Norman.greeting: Brawly's Fighting types and my Normal types share one thing: strength. Let's show it.
Norman.trainerWins: Strength, shown. Well done, Brawly.
Norman.trainerLoses: Our strength fell short. Train harder.

Brawly.greeting: Winona's birds ride the wind, I ride the waves. Hoenn's sky and sea, coming at you!
Brawly.trainerWins: Sky and sea got you! Hoenn wins!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Sky and sea got us instead. Wiped out!

Winona.greeting: Brawly's Fighting types hit hard. My Flying types hit from above. Shall we?
Winona.trainerWins: From above and from below. A graceful win, Brawly.
Winona.trainerLoses: Our wings were clipped. Well fought.

Brawly.greeting: Juan's the Water master of Sootopolis! Me, I just love the ocean. Let's make a splash!
Brawly.trainerWins: We made a splash! Thanks, Juan!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The splash missed. Totally wiped out!

Juan.greeting: Brawly surfs with such passion! Ahh, Hoenn's seas inspire us both. Let's make art of this battle.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a masterpiece of a battle! Hoenn's seas sing!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our art was misunderstood today.

Brawly.greeting: Wally's not that frail kid anymore! He hits like a wave now. Let's show 'em, partner!
Brawly.trainerWins: Wally hits like a wave! Told ya, partner!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Even our waves crashed. Keep at it, Wally!

Wally.greeting: Brawly's Gym was my second badge. Now we're teammates! I'll fight with all I've got!
Wally.trainerWins: I fought with all I had, and we won! Thanks, Brawly!
Wally.trainerLoses: I gave it everything... and still lost. I'll keep training!

Brawly.greeting: Anabel can sense my team's spirit? Then she knows it's huge! Hoenn's coming for you!
Brawly.trainerWins: Huge spirit, huge win! Hoenn rules!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Our spirit was huge, but you were bigger!

Anabel.greeting: Brawly's bond with his Pokémon is strong and wild, like the sea. I like it. Let's battle.
Anabel.trainerWins: A wild bond, a fine victory. Thank you, Brawly.
Anabel.trainerLoses: The sea was rough today. Well battled.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Flannery's fire and my thunder! Hoenn's volcano and storm, all in one battle!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! Volcano and storm! What a show!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! The volcano fizzled and the storm passed!

Flannery.greeting: Wattson laughs so much, it's contagious! Mauville and Lavaridge, let's light this place up!
Flannery.trainerWins: We lit this place up! Wattson, you're the best!
Flannery.trainerLoses: The lights went out on us... Ugh!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Norman's so serious! Lighten up, partner. Hoenn's going to win anyway!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! See, Norman? Hoenn wins anyway!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! Even I didn't see that coming!

Norman.greeting: Wattson's laughter fills the room. His Electric types fill the battle. Let's go, old friend.
Norman.trainerWins: Laughter and victory. Well done, old friend.
Norman.trainerLoses: Hmph. Laughter won't fix this one, Wattson.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Winona's birds are in for a shock... no, wait, we're on the same side! Go!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! No birds shocked! And we won!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! I shocked nobody at all today!

Winona.greeting: Wattson, please aim away from my Flying types. Hoenn's sky will be ours together.
Winona.trainerWins: The sky was ours, and my birds are unharmed. Thank you, Wattson.
Winona.trainerLoses: The sky slipped away from us. Well fought.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Juan's water conducts my electricity beautifully! Hoenn's shocking art show begins!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! The shocking art show is a hit!

Juan.greeting: Wattson, your thunder makes my waters sparkle. Ahh, together we are a masterpiece.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a sparkling masterpiece! Bravo, Wattson!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the sparkle faded. A tragic piece.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Wally once battled right outside my Mauville Gym! Gutsy kid! Let's go!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! Gutsy, but not enough today!

Wally.greeting: Wattson is so cheerful! It makes me feel brave. Hoenn's going to win this!
Wally.trainerWins: I felt brave, and we won! Thanks, Wattson!
Wally.trainerLoses: I was brave, but we still lost... I'll try harder!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Anabel, the Frontier Brain! Hoenn's Battle Frontier and Mauville, together!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! The Frontier and Mauville, both shocked!

Anabel.greeting: Wattson's energy is shocking. I sense his Pokémon love him dearly. Let's battle together.
Anabel.trainerWins: Shocking energy, shocking win. Thank you, Wattson.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Even that energy wasn't enough. Well battled.

Flannery.greeting: Norman's so cool and calm. I'm trying to be like that! Hoenn's fiercest, let's go!
Flannery.trainerWins: Calm AND fierce! We did it, Norman!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I wasn't calm enough... Sorry, Norman!

Norman.greeting: Flannery has her grandfather's fire. Use it well, Lavaridge. Hoenn will win this battle.
Norman.trainerWins: You used your fire well, Lavaridge. Hoenn wins.
Norman.trainerLoses: A fine effort, Flannery. We'll be ready next time.

Flannery.greeting: Winona's so graceful. Me? I'm all fire! Lavaridge and Fortree, let's heat up the sky!
Flannery.trainerWins: We heated up the sky! Lavaridge and Fortree win!
Flannery.trainerLoses: The sky cooled us right down. Ugh!

Winona.greeting: Flannery's flames light up Hoenn's sky. Let's soar above this challenger together.
Winona.trainerWins: Flannery's flames lit the way to victory.
Winona.trainerLoses: The flames flickered out. Well fought.

Flannery.greeting: Juan's water could put my fire out... but today we're teammates! Hoenn, here we come!
Flannery.trainerWins: Fire and water, best teammates ever!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Juan's water didn't put out my fire... the challenger did!

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Flannery! Fire and water dance together. A Hoenn masterpiece of steam and splendor!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a masterpiece of steam! Splendid, Flannery!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the steam has cleared. A tragic finale.

Flannery.greeting: Wally came to Lavaridge's hot springs to build up his health, and look at him now! Let's heat things up!
Flannery.trainerWins: Wally got stronger, and so did our teamwork!
Flannery.trainerLoses: The hot springs couldn't heal this loss!

Wally.greeting: Flannery's hot springs helped me get stronger. Now I'll repay her with a win!
Wally.trainerWins: I repaid her with a win! Thank you, Flannery!
Wally.trainerLoses: I couldn't repay her today... Next time!

Flannery.greeting: Anabel's so calm and collected! I'm all fired up! Hoenn's ready to win this one!
Flannery.trainerWins: Hoenn won! Fired up AND collected!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I got so fired up I fizzled out. Ugh!

Anabel.greeting: Flannery's bond with her Pokémon burns brightly. I can feel it from here. Let's battle.
Anabel.trainerWins: Her bond burned brightly, and so did our win.
Anabel.trainerLoses: The flame dimmed today. Well battled.

Norman.greeting: Winona's birds are a sight to behold. Petalburg and Fortree, let's show Hoenn's strength.
Norman.trainerWins: Hoenn's strength, on the ground and in the sky. Well done.
Norman.trainerLoses: Hoenn's strength faltered. Train harder.

Winona.greeting: Norman's strength is legendary in Hoenn. With him on the ground, my birds rule the sky.
Winona.trainerWins: My birds ruled the sky, with Norman on the ground.
Winona.trainerLoses: Even the sky couldn't save us today.

Norman.greeting: Juan taught the Champion. I taught my child. Hoenn's teachers don't lose easily.
Norman.trainerWins: Hoenn's teachers don't lose easily. They didn't today.
Norman.trainerLoses: Hoenn's teachers learned a lesson today.

Juan.greeting: Norman, ahh, such quiet strength. Let us show this challenger Hoenn's grace and might.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, grace and might, together! A masterpiece!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our grace stumbled. How tragic.

Norman.greeting: Wally caught his first Pokémon with my help in Petalburg. Look at him now. Let's battle, Wally.
Norman.trainerWins: Well battled, Wally. You've come so far.
Norman.trainerLoses: We'll get them next time, Wally. Keep your head up.

Wally.greeting: Norman helped me catch my very first Pokémon when I was just starting out. I'll make him proud today!
Wally.trainerWins: I made Norman proud! I can't believe it!
Wally.trainerLoses: I wanted to make Norman proud... I'll do better!

Norman.greeting: Anabel was a Frontier Brain. Hoenn's toughest facility. I'm glad she's on our side.
Norman.trainerWins: Glad you were on our side, Anabel. A fine win.
Norman.trainerLoses: Even the Frontier's toughest couldn't hold today.

Anabel.greeting: Norman's bond with his Pokémon is steady, like a father's. Hoenn's Trainers are strong.
Anabel.trainerWins: Steady and strong, like a father's bond. A fine win.
Anabel.trainerLoses: The bond held, but the battle didn't.

Winona.greeting: Juan's art and my birds' grace. Hoenn's sky and sea will move together.
Winona.trainerWins: Sky and sea moved together, and won.
Winona.trainerLoses: Our sky and sea were out of step today.

Juan.greeting: Winona's wings and my waters. Ahh, a duet of sky and sea! Hoenn's finest art!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a duet of victory! Hoenn's finest art!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our duet ended on a sour note.

Winona.greeting: Wally used to be too weak to climb Fortree's treetops. Now he's climbed the Battle Tree.
Winona.trainerWins: From too weak to climb Fortree to winning here. Well flown, Wally.
Winona.trainerLoses: We'll climb higher next time, Wally.

Wally.greeting: Winona's birds are so beautiful! I'll fight hard so they can soar!
Wally.trainerWins: The birds soared, and we won! Thank you, Winona!
Wally.trainerLoses: The birds couldn't soar today... I'm sorry!

Winona.greeting: Anabel senses bonds, and my birds feel the wind. Hoenn's quiet Trainers are its strongest.
Winona.trainerWins: Hoenn's quiet Trainers, victorious. As I said.
Winona.trainerLoses: Our quiet strength wasn't enough today.

Anabel.greeting: Winona's bond with her birds is light, like feathers. But strong. Let's battle together.
Anabel.trainerWins: Light as feathers, strong as steel. A fine victory.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Wally! You battled through Victory Road itself. A Hoenn star is born! Let us shine together!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a Hoenn star shines! Bravo, Wally!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, even stars dim sometimes. Shine again, Wally.

Wally.greeting: Juan taught Wallace, and Wallace inspired me! I want to show Juan how far I've come!
Wally.trainerWins: I showed Juan how far I've come! We won!
Wally.trainerLoses: I wanted to show Juan... I'll try again!

Juan.greeting: Anabel, the Salon Maiden! Ahh, Hoenn's Battle Frontier and Sootopolis, an elegant duet!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, an elegant duet, triumphant!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, our duet was drowned out.

Anabel.greeting: Juan's bond with his Pokémon is like a dance. I sense harmony. Let's battle together.
Anabel.trainerWins: Harmony, and victory. Thank you, Juan.

Wally.greeting: Anabel was a Frontier Brain when I was still training! Hoenn's not losing today!
Wally.trainerWins: Hoenn won! I battled with a Frontier Brain!
Wally.trainerLoses: I lost with a Frontier Brain beside me... I'll keep training!

Anabel.greeting: Wally's bond with his Pokémon grew as he did. I can sense how strong it is now. Let's go.
Anabel.trainerWins: Strong bond, strong win. Well done, Wally.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Your bond is strong, Wally. Today, theirs was stronger.

Roark.greeting: Gardenia's Grass types grow right out of my rocks. Oreburgh and Eterna, Sinnoh's first two badges!
Roark.trainerWins: Sinnoh's first two badges, victorious! Great job, Gardenia!
Roark.trainerLoses: Even Oreburgh and Eterna fell. Back to the mines.

Gardenia.greeting: Roark spends all day underground? No thanks. Just keep any Old Chateau ghosts away from me, okay?
Gardenia.trainerWins: No ghosts AND a win! Best day! Thanks, Roark!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: We lost... and I think I heard a ghost. I'm leaving!

Roark.greeting: Fantina's ghosts give me the creeps. Still, Oreburgh's rocks can anchor any Hearthome show.
Roark.trainerWins: My rocks anchored the show! Creepy, but great!
Roark.trainerLoses: The show went on without us. And her ghosts still give me the creeps.

Fantina.greeting: Roark, mon ami! Your team is so... how you say... rugged! Let us put on a Sinnoh spectacle!
Fantina.trainerWins: Magnifique! A Sinnoh spectacle! Bravo, Roark!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Non, non! The spectacle has ended in sadness!

Roark.greeting: Maylene's Fighting types smash boulders for training. Glad my Rock types are on her side today!
Roark.trainerWins: Glad my rocks weren't on the wrong side of those fists! We won!
Roark.trainerLoses: Even my rocks crumbled. Good fight, Maylene.

Maylene.greeting: Roark's rocks are tough. My fists are tougher. I... I think. Let's do this for Sinnoh!
Maylene.trainerWins: My fists ARE tougher! I think! We won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: My fists weren't enough. I'll train harder!

Roark.greeting: Crasher Wake shook the whole mine just by shouting hello. My Rock types are ready, Wake!
Roark.trainerWins: Wake shook the mine, and we shook you!
Roark.trainerLoses: Wake, your shouting couldn't save us this time.

Crasher Wake.greeting: The miner of Oreburgh! Rock and Water, the Crasher Wake tag team is on! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The Crasher Wake tag team triumphs!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The tag team takes a tumble!

Roark.greeting: Dad's my partner?! Fine, Byron. Let's see whose Rock and Steel team is really number one!
Roark.trainerWins: Fine, Dad. We're number one together. Just this once.
Roark.trainerLoses: We lost, Dad. Don't you dare say it was my fault.

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! My boy Roark! Oreburgh's rocks and Canalave's steel, father and son! Nothing breaks us!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Father and son! Nothing breaks us!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! We broke, my boy! Back to training!

Roark.greeting: Candice keeps yelling 'focus!' at me. I'm focused! Snowpoint ice on Oreburgh rock, let's go!
Roark.trainerWins: I was focused, Candice! And we won!
Roark.trainerLoses: I lost focus. Candice is never letting me forget it.

Candice.greeting: Roark, FOCUS! Rock types don't mind the cold, right? Then Snowpoint and Oreburgh can't lose!
Candice.trainerWins: FOCUS! And victory! Snowpoint and Oreburgh rule!
Candice.trainerLoses: We lost focus! Both of us! Kiai... next time!

Roark.greeting: Volkner's Sinnoh's last Gym and I'm its first. Together, we cover every badge you could earn.
Roark.trainerWins: Every badge in Sinnoh, covered and won. Thanks, Volkner.
Roark.trainerLoses: First and last badge, both fell. Ouch.

Volkner.greeting: The first badge of Sinnoh. Let's see if Oreburgh can make this more interesting than Sunyshore.
Volkner.trainerWins: Fine. Oreburgh made it interesting. Good.
Volkner.trainerLoses: That was interesting. I'll admit it. For you.

Roark.greeting: Teaming up with Champion Cynthia? Oreburgh's fossil fanatic won't let Sinnoh down!
Roark.trainerWins: Oreburgh's fossil fanatic didn't let Sinnoh down!
Roark.trainerLoses: I let the Champion down. I'm going back underground.

Cynthia.greeting: Roark digs up fossils, and I dig up legends. Sinnoh's history is on our side. Shall we?
Cynthia.trainerWins: Sinnoh's history was on our side. Well done, Roark.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: History favored the challenger today. Fascinating.

Gardenia.greeting: F-F-Fantina's my partner?! Your ghosts aren't from the Old Chateau, are they?! Are they?!
Gardenia.trainerWins: We won, and no Old Chateau ghosts showed up! Phew!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: We lost AND your ghosts were staring at me! Worst day!

Fantina.greeting: Gardenia, ma chérie, you tremble! My ghosts are friends. Eterna and Hearthome, together, oui?
Fantina.trainerWins: Magnifique! Gardenia, my ghosts were friends after all, oui?
Fantina.trainerLoses: Non! Even friendly ghosts could not save us. Quelle tristesse.

Gardenia.greeting: Maylene walks barefoot through Eterna Forest with me. We're both nature girls at heart!
Gardenia.trainerWins: Nature girls win! Back to Eterna Forest to celebrate!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Even nature girls lose sometimes. Let's walk it off barefoot!

Maylene.greeting: Gardenia's flowers look delicate, but they're tough, like Veilstone's fighters. Let's battle!
Maylene.trainerWins: Tough flowers, tough fists! We did it, Gardenia!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Gardenia's flowers held up better than my fists did...

Gardenia.greeting: Crasher Wake's rain makes my Grass types grow big and strong! Pastoria's marsh would be jealous!
Gardenia.trainerWins: The rain made my team grow strong, and we won!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Too much rain, maybe? My team got soggy.

Crasher Wake.greeting: Gardenia's Grass types love the Great Marsh! Water and Grass, the Crasher Wake jungle match!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The jungle match goes to the Crasher Wake!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Lost in the jungle! What a match!

Gardenia.greeting: Byron says the Old Chateau is just an old house. Easy for a guy made of steel to say!
Gardenia.trainerWins: We won! Maybe I'm a little bit made of steel too!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: We lost, and Byron still says the Old Chateau is fine. Ugh!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Gardenia's scared of ghosts? My Steel types fear nothing! Canalave's got your back!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Canalave had your back, and we won!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Even steel couldn't hold that one!

Gardenia.greeting: Candice's ice is gonna be gentle with my Grass types, right? Right?! Okay, let's go, Sinnoh!
Gardenia.trainerWins: Candice was gentle! We won! Sinnoh rocks!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Candice's ice froze my flowers... and our chances!

Candice.greeting: Gardenia, focus! Grass under snow grows back stronger! Snowpoint and Eterna, team spirit!
Candice.trainerWins: Grass under snow grows back stronger, and so do we!
Candice.trainerLoses: We didn't grow back fast enough! Focus next time!

Gardenia.greeting: Volkner looks so bored. Don't worry, my Grass types will make this battle fun for both of us!
Gardenia.trainerWins: Told you it'd be fun, Volkner! We won!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Volkner's still bored... and we lost! Not fun!

Volkner.greeting: Gardenia's energy is... a lot. Maybe that's what this battle needs. Let's see.
Volkner.trainerWins: That was... actually fun. Thanks, Gardenia.
Volkner.trainerLoses: That was a lot. And not enough.

Gardenia.greeting: Cynthia studies the old statue in Eterna City, right by my Gym! The Champion and Eterna's Leader, let's grow a win!
Gardenia.trainerWins: The Champion and Eterna's Leader grew a win!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: We didn't grow a win today... Sorry, Cynthia!

Cynthia.greeting: Gardenia keeps Eterna Forest safe while I study the statue in her city. Eterna's pride, together.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Eterna's pride shines bright. Thank you, Gardenia.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Eterna's statue has seen worse. We'll recover.

Fantina.greeting: Maylene, such strength in such a small Trainer! Ghost and Fighting, a duet magnifique!
Fantina.trainerWins: A duet magnifique! Such strength, my little Maylene!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Our duet has ended too soon. Hélas!

Maylene.greeting: Fantina's dance moves are amazing. My moves are... punches. But together, I think we can win!
Maylene.trainerWins: Dance moves and punches, together! We won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: My punches couldn't keep up with the dance...

Fantina.greeting: Crasher Wake, you are so loud! But on stage, loud is good! Hearthome and Pastoria, allons-y!
Fantina.trainerWins: Bravo! Loud is good on stage! Allons-y to victory!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The curtain falls on us. Too loud? Non, not loud enough!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Fantina's contest flair and the Crasher Wake! Ghost and Water, the dramatic tag team! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The dramatic tag team triumphs!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! A dramatic loss for the tag team!

Fantina.greeting: Byron, your Steel types shine like contest costumes! Together, we are a très grand show!
Fantina.trainerWins: Très grand! Our show was a triumph!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Our grand show was cancelled. Quel dommage!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Fantina's ghosts and my steel! I don't understand half of what she says, but let's win!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Didn't understand a word, but we won!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! I didn't understand that loss either!

Fantina.greeting: Candice, your Ice types dance on snow like my ghosts dance in the dark! A chilling ballet!
Fantina.trainerWins: Our chilling ballet earned a standing ovation!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The ballet was frozen out. Non, non!

Candice.greeting: Fantina, FOCUS! Ghost and Ice, a snowy haunted stage! We'll share the spotlight! Let's go!
Candice.trainerWins: FOCUS paid off! We shared the spotlight and won!
Candice.trainerLoses: We lost focus AND the spotlight! Next time!

Fantina.greeting: Volkner, you are bored? Non, non! With me, every battle is a spectacle! Sunyshore will shine!
Fantina.trainerWins: Every battle a spectacle! Sunyshore shines!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The spectacle was yours today. C'est la vie.

Volkner.greeting: Fantina makes everything a performance. Fine. Let's give this challenger a show worth watching.
Volkner.trainerWins: A show worth watching. I'll admit it.
Volkner.trainerLoses: The show went on without us. Hm.

Fantina.greeting: Cynthia, the Champion! Ahh, Sinnoh's grace and my ghosts' charm. Une bataille magnifique!
Fantina.trainerWins: Une bataille magnifique, and a victory!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Magnifique, but lost. Such is the stage.

Cynthia.greeting: Fantina's Ghost types know the old Sinnoh tales as well as I do. Let's add a new one.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A new Sinnoh tale, and a happy ending for us.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: The new tale has a twist. For you.

Maylene.greeting: Crasher Wake's a wrestler, I'm a fighter! He says my punches could go pro. Let's prove it!
Maylene.trainerWins: My punches went pro! We won, Wake!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I wasn't ready to go pro yet...

Crasher Wake.greeting: Maylene's fists and my wrestling moves! The Crasher Wake tag team title match! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Tag team title, defended!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The title belt slips away!

Maylene.greeting: Byron told me to wear shoes up the tree. I didn't. Veilstone and Canalave, let's go!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Maybe I should've worn shoes...

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Barefoot on this tree?! That's guts! Maylene's fists and my steel, unstoppable!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Guts and steel, unstoppable!

Maylene.greeting: Candice says toughness is all in your head. I go barefoot, she wears a skirt in blizzards. Let's win!
Maylene.trainerWins: Sinnoh girls don't feel the cold, and they don't lose!
Maylene.trainerLoses: We felt the cold today... and the loss.

Candice.greeting: Maylene, FOCUS! Barefoot on a tree, a skirt in a blizzard: Sinnoh girls don't feel the cold! Let's go!
Candice.trainerLoses: We didn't feel the cold, just the loss. Kiai, next time!

Maylene.greeting: Volkner's the strongest Leader in Sinnoh. I'll do my best to make him take us seriously!
Maylene.trainerWins: Volkner took us seriously! And we won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Volkner was right to be bored. I let him down.

Volkner.greeting: Maylene's gotten stronger since Veilstone. Let's see if she can keep this battle from being dull.
Volkner.trainerWins: Not dull at all. Nice work, Maylene.

Maylene.greeting: Fighting alongside Champion Cynthia! I can feel her team's aura from here! Sinnoh's shining today!
Maylene.trainerWins: Sinnoh shines! I fought beside the Champion and won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I let the Champion down... I'll train harder!

Cynthia.greeting: Maylene's team has a fine aura, as fierce as her fists. Let's see if you can feel it.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A fierce aura, and a fierce win. Well done.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: The aura wasn't enough today. We'll grow.

Crasher Wake.greeting: Byron! The steel giant of Canalave! Water and Steel, Sinnoh's heavyweight tag team! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Sinnoh's heavyweights, undefeated!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The heavyweights hit the mat!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Crasher Wake's loud! But I'm louder! Canalave and Pastoria, let's crush this kid!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Louder AND victorious!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Crushed instead! Back to the mines!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Candice! The Crasher Wake hails from Pastoria's marsh, she hails from the snow! Water and Ice!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The marsh and the snow, triumphant!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The marsh froze over!

Candice.greeting: Crasher Wake, FOCUS! Your waves and my snow, a Snowpoint storm! Let's go!
Candice.trainerWins: FOCUS! The Snowpoint storm swept you away!
Candice.trainerLoses: Our storm melted. Focus harder next time!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Volkner! Sunyshore's lightning and the Crasher Wake's waves! Don't zap me, partner! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! No zaps on the Crasher Wake! Victory!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Zapped by the challenger instead!

Volkner.greeting: Crasher Wake's water and my lightning. Stand clear, Wake. This might actually be fun.
Volkner.trainerWins: That was fun, actually. Don't tell anyone, Wake.

Crasher Wake.greeting: Cynthia! The Champion of Sinnoh! The Crasher Wake tag team just went legendary! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The legendary tag team wins!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Even legends take a fall!

Cynthia.greeting: Crasher Wake brings the energy. I'll bring the Champion's resolve. Sinnoh's strength, together. Shall we?
Cynthia.trainerWins: Energy and resolve. Sinnoh's strength, proven.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Our resolve was tested. Not enough today.

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Candice's ice and my steel! Snowpoint and Canalave, Sinnoh's coldest, hardest team!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Coldest, hardest, and victorious!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Cold AND hard, but beaten!

Candice.greeting: Byron, FOCUS! Steel doesn't crack in the cold! Canalave and Snowpoint, unbreakable!
Candice.trainerLoses: We cracked! Focus, Candice, focus!

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Volkner's bored? Watch my steel wall tank everything! That'll wake you up!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Woke you up, didn't it, Volkner?
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! My wall fell! Volkner, stay awake!

Volkner.greeting: Byron's loud enough to keep me awake. His steel holds the line, my lightning finishes. Let's go.
Volkner.trainerWins: Byron held, I finished. Simple.
Volkner.trainerLoses: The line broke. Even I didn't expect that.

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Cynthia, the Champion! Sinnoh's steel and Sinnoh's legends, together!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Sinnoh's steel and legends, triumphant!
Byron.trainerLoses: Gahahah! Even steel and legends crack!

Cynthia.greeting: Byron digs up Sinnoh's past in the mines. I study its legends. A fine match. Let's battle.
Cynthia.trainerWins: The past and its legends, standing strong. Well done, Byron.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: History was unkind to us today.

Candice.greeting: Volkner, FOCUS! Ice and Electric, Snowpoint and Sunyshore! We're gonna win, I know it!
Candice.trainerWins: FOCUS paid off! I knew we'd win!
Candice.trainerLoses: I was SO sure we'd win... Focus, next time!

Volkner.greeting: Candice's focus is exhausting. Maybe that's the point. Sinnoh's shock and chill, let's go.
Volkner.trainerWins: Shock and chill. It worked. Thanks, Candice.

Candice.greeting: Cynthia, the Champion! FOCUS, Candice! Snowpoint's best won't let Sinnoh's Champion down!
Candice.trainerWins: I didn't let Sinnoh's Champion down! Kiai!
Candice.trainerLoses: I let Cynthia down... I'm so sorry!

Cynthia.greeting: Candice's focus is admirable. Snowpoint's ice and the Champion's resolve. Let's show you Sinnoh's strength.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Snowpoint's ice and the Champion's resolve, victorious.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Our resolve was strong. Theirs, stronger.

Volkner.greeting: Cynthia. The only Trainer in Sinnoh who never bores me. This might be fun after all.
Volkner.trainerWins: Not boring at all. Thanks, Cynthia.
Volkner.trainerLoses: Even the Champion couldn't keep that from being a loss.

Cynthia.greeting: Volkner finally looks interested. Sunyshore's lightning and the Champion of Sinnoh. Let's begin.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Volkner smiled. That's rarer than winning.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Volkner looks bored again. I don't blame him.

Cheren.greeting: Roxie's Gym is the second one new Trainers face after mine. Today's lesson: Unova teamwork.
Cheren.trainerWins: Lesson complete: Unova teamwork works.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The lesson failed. I'll revise the plan, Roxie.

Roxie.greeting: Cheren's a teacher? Ugh, school. Fine, Teach. Let's make this loud and poisonous! Virbank rocks!
Roxie.trainerWins: Loud, poisonous, and victorious! Virbank rocks!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Ugh, I flunked the lesson. Detention, Teach?

Cheren.greeting: Burgh sees art in every battle. I see logic. Either way, Unova's Leaders will see your defeat.
Cheren.trainerWins: Logic and art reached the same conclusion: victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Neither logic nor art saw that coming.

Burgh.greeting: Cheren's battles are so precise, like a sketch with no wasted lines! A Unova masterpiece awaits!
Burgh.trainerWins: A Unova masterpiece, with no wasted lines!
Burgh.trainerLoses: Our sketch got smudged. Back to the canvas!

Cheren.greeting: Elesa's battles dazzle. Mine teach. Between Nimbasa and Aspertia, you'll learn something today.
Cheren.trainerWins: You learned something today: how to lose to us.
Cheren.trainerLoses: I learned something today. Unpleasant, but useful.

Elesa.greeting: Cheren's a bit serious for the runway, but he's sharp! Unova's Leaders, strike a pose!
Elesa.trainerWins: Unova's Leaders struck a pose, and the win!
Elesa.trainerLoses: We posed, but didn't win. Fashion fail!

Cheren.greeting: Clay built Driftveil with hard work and stubbornness. I teach my students the first one. Let's battle.
Cheren.trainerWins: Hard work and stubbornness paid off. Thank you, Clay.
Cheren.trainerLoses: We were stubborn, but not enough today.

Clay.greeting: Cheren, the schoolteacher! Teach this kid that Unova don't hand out wins for free!
Clay.trainerWins: Taught this kid a lesson! Unova don't hand out wins!
Clay.trainerLoses: Hmph. Kid earned that one. Fair and square.

Cheren.greeting: Skyla delivers cargo across Unova; I deliver lessons. Today, we'll deliver a defeat.
Cheren.trainerWins: Defeat delivered. Thank you, Skyla.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Our delivery was returned to sender.

Skyla.greeting: Cheren's so serious! Loosen up, flyboy! Mistralton and Aspertia are taking off together!
Skyla.trainerWins: We took off together, flyboy! Ha!
Skyla.trainerLoses: We crashed... Loosen up, Cheren, it's just a battle!

Cheren.greeting: Drayden taught Iris everything. I hope to teach my students half as well. Let's battle, sir.
Cheren.trainerWins: I hope my students learn from this as I did. Thank you, sir.
Cheren.trainerLoses: I've much to learn still. Thank you, Drayden.

Drayden.greeting: Cheren has grown into a fine teacher. Opelucid and Aspertia, Unova's wisdom, together.
Drayden.trainerWins: Unova's wisdom, proven together. Well done, Cheren.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Wisdom gained, victory lost. Such is battle.

Cheren.greeting: Marlon's Gym is the last in Unova, and mine is the first. Together, we cover a Trainer's whole journey.
Cheren.trainerWins: A whole journey, first Gym to last, ending in victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The journey ends in defeat. A lesson, still.

Marlon.greeting: Cheren, dude, you gotta relax! Aspertia's first and Humilau's last, the whole Unova wave!
Marlon.trainerWins: Whole Unova wave, dude! Totally rad!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out, man. Cheren, relax, it's cool!

Cheren.greeting: Chili, please don't rush in before I explain the plan. Unova's Leaders work best with a strategy.
Cheren.trainerWins: The plan worked, even with Chili rushing in.
Cheren.trainerLoses: I explained the plan. Chili didn't listen. We lost.

Chili.greeting: Cheren's got a plan? Cool! I'll just set everything on fire while he explains it! Let's go!
Chili.trainerWins: Set it all on fire while he explained! It worked!
Chili.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe I should've listened to the plan...
