Cheren.greeting: Cress analyzes everything, like I do. Unova's most logical Leaders. Shall we begin?
Cheren.trainerWins: Logic prevails. A refined result, Cress.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Even logic fails sometimes. Interesting.

Cress.greeting: Cheren and I both value clear thinking. A refined Unova partnership. Let's battle elegantly.
Cress.trainerWins: Clear thinking, elegant victory. A fine pairing.
Cress.trainerLoses: Our thinking was clear. Our result, less so.

Cheren.greeting: Cilan says he can taste the flavor of a battle. I'll trust his palate and my plan.
Cheren.trainerWins: Cilan's palate and my plan. A winning recipe.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The recipe needs adjusting, Cilan.

Cilan.greeting: Cheren! Your battle style has a crisp, logical flavor! Paired with my Grass types, a fine Unova course!
Cilan.trainerWins: A crisp, logical victory! Delicious!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The flavor turned sour. Back to the kitchen!

Cheren.greeting: Lenora's Normal types taught me how strong 'ordinary' can be. Two Unova Normal-type Leaders, together.
Cheren.trainerWins: Ordinary, and stronger than anyone thought. We won.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Even ordinary strength has its limits.

Lenora.greeting: Cheren uses Normal types too! History says the simplest tools last longest. Let's prove it, Teacher!
Lenora.trainerWins: The simplest tools lasted longest! History repeats!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History has a new chapter. Not ours.

Cheren.greeting: Brycen was an action star. I'm a teacher. We both believe in discipline. Let's battle.
Cheren.trainerWins: Discipline wins. Thank you, Brycen.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Our discipline was tested and found wanting.

Brycen.greeting: Cheren's discipline rivals any Pokéstar Studios stunt crew. Unova's resolve, together. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: A well-disciplined scene. Cut, and print. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: The scene didn't land. Another take. Hm!

Cheren.greeting: Bianca and I have been friends since we were kids in Nuvema. Don't trip on the stairs, Bianca.
Cheren.trainerWins: No tripping, no drops, and we won. Well done, Bianca.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Bianca didn't trip. I did, in my planning.

Bianca.greeting: Cheren! You're my partner! Just like old times! I promise I won't drop my Poké Balls this time!
Bianca.trainerWins: Just like old times! We won! I didn't drop anything!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I dropped a Poké Ball AND we lost! Sorry, Cheren!

Cheren.greeting: Grimsley gambles. I calculate. Strange partners for Unova, but the math says we win.
Cheren.trainerWins: The math said we'd win, and it did.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The math was wrong. Or the dice were.

Grimsley.greeting: The teacher from Aspertia. I'll bet on your lesson plan, Cheren. Unova's Elite and its finest Leader.
Grimsley.trainerWins: I bet on your lesson plan and won big. Thank you, Teacher.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Lost the bet, but I'd place it again.

Cheren.greeting: Colress worked with Team Plasma. Today he's on my side. Unova has changed a lot, hasn't it?
Cheren.trainerWins: Unova has changed. So has Colress. We won together.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Changed, but not enough to win. Hmm.

Colress.greeting: Cheren, the logical Leader. Your Normal types are an excellent control group for my research.
Colress.trainerWins: A successful control group! Delightful data!
Colress.trainerLoses: The control group failed! How fascinating!

Roxie.greeting: Burgh paints, I sing! Unova's art scene is taking over this battle! Get ready for the encore!
Roxie.trainerWins: The encore was a smash! Unova's art scene rules!
Roxie.trainerLoses: No encore. Our show got cancelled!

Burgh.greeting: Roxie's music is so raw! Her poison and my bugs, a punk-rock painting! Unova, inspire me!
Burgh.trainerWins: A punk-rock masterpiece! Inspiring!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The painting smeared. Still, raw art!

Roxie.greeting: Elesa's a supermodel, I'm a rock star! Unova's celebrities are on tour, and you're the opening act!
Roxie.trainerWins: You were the opening act, and we were the headliners!
Roxie.trainerLoses: We got upstaged by the opening act!

Elesa.greeting: Roxie's stage presence is electrifying! Nimbasa's runway and Virbank's stage, together!
Elesa.trainerWins: The runway and the stage, both standing ovations!
Elesa.trainerLoses: The tour hit a bump. We'll be back!

Roxie.greeting: Clay's a grumpy old miner. I'm a grumpy young singer. Unova's grumpiest team, let's go!
Roxie.trainerWins: Grumpiest team in Unova, and the winners!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Now I'm even grumpier. Ugh!

Clay.greeting: Roxie's music is too loud for an old miner! But she's tough. Driftveil and Virbank, let's dig in!
Clay.trainerWins: Dug in and won! Tough kid, that Roxie!
Clay.trainerLoses: Hmph. Too loud AND we lost. Great.

Roxie.greeting: Skyla flies cargo, I fly on stage! Unova's coolest girls are taking off! Get hyped!
Roxie.trainerWins: Coolest girls in Unova, coolest win!
Roxie.trainerLoses: We crashed and burned! Not cool!

Skyla.greeting: Roxie's poison and my birds! We're gonna fly circles and leave a toxic trail! Unova, takeoff!
Skyla.trainerWins: Flew circles around you! Toxic trail complete!

Roxie.greeting: Drayden's a mayor, so he's probably gonna lecture me. Whatever. Unova's toughest, let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: No lecture needed! We rocked!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe I need that lecture now...

Drayden.greeting: Roxie, the young singer from Virbank. Unova's spirit comes in many forms. Let's battle.
Drayden.trainerWins: Unova's spirit triumphs in many forms. Well done.
Drayden.trainerLoses: A lesson in humility, for both of us.

Roxie.greeting: Marlon's a surfer, I'm a singer! Unova's chillest and loudest Leaders! Let's make some noise!
Roxie.trainerWins: We made noise AND waves! Unova rules!
Roxie.trainerLoses: We made noise, but you made more!

Marlon.greeting: Roxie's got some serious vibes, dude! Poison and Water, the Unova wave! Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: The Unova wave crushed it, dude!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out on the Unova wave, man.

Roxie.greeting: Chili's as loud as my band! Fire and poison, the hottest show in Unova! Let's go!
Roxie.trainerWins: The hottest show in Unova, sold out!
Roxie.trainerLoses: The show bombed! Literally on fire, though!

Chili.greeting: Roxie's songs are FIRE! Literally, if I'm in the crowd! Unova's loudest team-up starts now!
Chili.trainerWins: FIRE! Literally! We won!
Chili.trainerLoses: Our flames went out! Not cool!

Roxie.greeting: Cress is too fancy for a punk show. But he's on my team today, so let's poison 'em!
Roxie.trainerWins: Fancy or not, we poisoned 'em! Nice, Cress!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Too fancy, too slow! Ugh!

Cress.greeting: Roxie's music is quite... unrefined. Yet strangely invigorating. Shall we, Unova's punk?
Cress.trainerWins: Unrefined, yet victorious. Strangely satisfying.

Roxie.greeting: Cilan says my battles taste spicy. Cool! Grass and poison, the Unova special!
Roxie.trainerWins: Spicy and victorious! The Unova special rocks!
Roxie.trainerLoses: The special got sent back to the kitchen!

Cilan.greeting: Roxie's battle style is a bold, toxic flavor! Paired with Grass, a perfect Unova pairing!
Cilan.trainerWins: A bold, toxic triumph! Delicious!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The flavor was too bold... for us.

Roxie.greeting: Lenora's a museum director. Kinda old school. But she hits hard! Unova's best, let's go!
Roxie.trainerWins: Old school hits hard! We won!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Even old school couldn't save us!

Lenora.greeting: Roxie, Virbank's rock star! History will remember this Unova team-up. Let's battle!
Lenora.trainerWins: History will remember this win!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History will remember this loss too. Ah well!

Roxie.greeting: Brycen was a movie star! I'm a rock star! Unova's celebrity team-up! Get ready!
Roxie.trainerWins: Rock star and movie star, number one!
Roxie.trainerLoses: The celebrity team-up flopped!

Brycen.greeting: Roxie's stage energy rivals any film set. Unova's performers, together. Hm!

Roxie.greeting: Bianca's so clumsy, she tripped on my guitar cable! Still, she's tough. Unova, let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: Tough AND clumsy! Victory party at my show!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Bianca tripped on my cable again... and we lost!

Bianca.greeting: Roxie's band is so cool! I'm gonna battle super hard so she plays at our victory party!
Bianca.trainerWins: Victory party! Roxie's playing! Yay!
Bianca.trainerLoses: No victory party... Sorry, Roxie!

Roxie.greeting: Grimsley's a gambler? Cool. Bet on my poison, old man! Unova's toughest team!
Roxie.trainerWins: Bet on my poison and won, old man!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Lost the bet. Ugh!

Grimsley.greeting: Roxie's poison is a sure thing. I'll bet it all on this Unova partnership.
Grimsley.trainerWins: A sure thing, as promised.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: My sure thing turned sour.

Roxie.greeting: Colress is a total nerd. But his Steel types are tough! Unova's weirdest team, let's go!
Roxie.trainerWins: Weirdest team, best win!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Weirdest team, worst loss!

Colress.greeting: Roxie's poison could be an interesting variable. Let's test this Unova combination.
Colress.trainerLoses: The variable failed us. How intriguing.

Burgh.greeting: Elesa turns every battle into a runway, and I turn it into a canvas! Castelia and Nimbasa, inspire me!
Burgh.trainerWins: Inspired! A runway and a canvas, both victorious!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The inspiration slipped away... like a smudge!

Elesa.greeting: Burgh promised to paint me mid-battle. Hold still, challenger. You're in the picture too.
Elesa.trainerWins: You were in the picture too, challenger. As the one who lost.
Elesa.trainerLoses: Burgh's painting doesn't end how I hoped.

Burgh.greeting: Clay's mines are full of the most wonderful earthy colors! Bugs and Ground, a Unova landscape!
Burgh.trainerWins: A Unova landscape, earthy and triumphant!
Burgh.trainerLoses: My landscape got buried!

Clay.greeting: Burgh wants to paint my mine. Fine, after we bury this challenger. Driftveil don't do art breaks.
Clay.trainerWins: Challenger's buried. Now go paint my mine.
Clay.trainerLoses: Hmph. No art break AND a loss.

Burgh.greeting: Skyla's birds keep eyeing my bugs! Ladies, eyes on the challenger, please. Unova's sky and garden!
Burgh.trainerWins: Eyes on the challenger worked! What a scene!
Burgh.trainerLoses: My bugs got distracted by Skyla's birds...

Skyla.greeting: Burgh's team sewed me a new scarf for flying! Bugs and birds, let's take this battle to the skies!
Skyla.trainerWins: New scarf, new win! Thanks, Burgh!
Skyla.trainerLoses: My scarf got windblown... and so did we!

Burgh.greeting: Drayden's dragons are pure sculpture. Bugs and dragons, the smallest and grandest of Unova's art!
Burgh.trainerWins: The smallest and grandest of Unova's art, victorious!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The art has fallen. A tragic piece!

Drayden.greeting: Burgh sees beauty everywhere, even in a challenger's defeat. Opelucid and Castelia, let us begin.
Drayden.trainerWins: Even defeat has beauty. Yours, today.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Burgh will paint this loss, I imagine.

Burgh.greeting: Marlon's waves have such rhythm! I've painted Humilau's sea three times. Today, I'll paint a win!
Burgh.trainerWins: I painted the win, just as I said!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The painting washed away with the tide!

Marlon.greeting: Burgh paints the sea, I ride it! Bugs on the waves, man. That's art you can surf on!
Marlon.trainerWins: Art you can surf on, dude! Gnarly!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out, man. Paint that one, Burgh.

Burgh.greeting: Chili, my bugs are a little nervous about your fire. Aim it at the challenger, my friend!
Burgh.trainerWins: My bugs are unburned and victorious!
Burgh.trainerLoses: My bugs survived the fire, but not the challenger!

Chili.greeting: Don't worry, Burgh, I'll keep my flames on the other side of the field! Castelia, let's heat it up!
Chili.trainerWins: Flames on the right side! We won!
Chili.trainerLoses: My flames hit the wrong side... the losing side!

Burgh.greeting: Cress has the grace of a watercolor. Bugs and Water, a calm Castelia harbor scene!
Burgh.trainerWins: A calm harbor scene, and a fine win!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The harbor flooded! Oh dear!

Cress.greeting: Burgh's artistry is refreshing. Allow me to add a splash of Striaton Water to his canvas.
Cress.trainerWins: A splash of Striaton Water on a winning canvas.
Cress.trainerLoses: The canvas got too wet. Pity.

Burgh.greeting: Cilan's Grass types would be my Bug types' lunch, but today they share a table! Unova's garden party!
Burgh.trainerWins: Garden party success! Bugs and Grass, sharing the win!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The garden party got rained out!

Cilan.greeting: Burgh! Bugs and Grass, the freshest farm-to-battle pairing in Unova! It's evaluation time!
Cilan.trainerWins: A fresh, farm-to-battle victory! Delicious!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The pairing wilted. Back to the farm.

Burgh.greeting: Lenora promised to hang one of my paintings in her museum if we win. Inspiration, overflowing!

Chili.greeting: Brycen's ice and my fire! Hot, cold, hot, cold! They won't know what hit 'em!

Brycen.greeting: Chili's flames could melt Icirrus in a day. Point them at the challenger, young man. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: The flames hit their mark. Well done. Hm!

Chili.greeting: Bianca orders the same dessert every time she visits our restaurant! Let's earn another one, Bianca!
Chili.trainerWins: Dessert's on me, Bianca! We earned it!
Chili.trainerLoses: No dessert this time, Bianca... Sorry!

Bianca.greeting: Chili's restaurant makes the best cake in Unova! Okay, win first, cake later! Let's go!
Bianca.trainerWins: Win first, cake later! Cake time!
Bianca.trainerLoses: No win, no cake... Waah!

Chili.greeting: Grimsley says he'll bet his lunch money on us! Good thing I'm never gonna lose! Let's go!
Chili.trainerWins: Your lunch money's safe, Grimsley! Never lose!
Chili.trainerLoses: Uh oh. Grimsley, I owe you lunch money...

Grimsley.greeting: Chili charges in like a gambler with a hot streak. I'll ride it as long as it lasts.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The hot streak paid out. Splendid.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: The streak cooled. Lunch is on Chili.

Chili.greeting: Colress asked how hot my flames get. Hotter than his lab equipment, I bet! Let's go!
Chili.trainerWins: Hotter than the lab! Told ya!
Chili.trainerLoses: My flames weren't hot enough today!

Colress.greeting: Chili's flames could forge steel. Fire and machinery: a furnace and its gears.
Colress.trainerWins: Furnace and gears, perfectly in sync!
Colress.trainerLoses: The furnace overheated. Fascinating failure.

Cress.greeting: Lenora's museum café serves a superb Unova blend. Today, I'll serve a superb victory alongside her.
Cress.trainerWins: A superb victory, served alongside a superb partner.

Lenora.greeting: Cress has such lovely manners! The Nacrene Museum would hire him in a heartbeat. Let's battle!
Lenora.trainerWins: Such manners, and such a victory!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Manners can't win every battle. Ah well!

Cress.greeting: Brycen's ice and my water, a cool composure from both of us. A most elegant pairing.
Cress.trainerWins: A cool, elegant finish. Most satisfying.

Brycen.greeting: Cress keeps a calm head, like a good stunt performer. Water and Ice, a cold, clean finish. Hm!

Cress.greeting: Bianca, please mind the stairs, and your Poké Balls. Very good. Now, shall we begin?
Cress.trainerWins: No stairs tripped, no balls dropped. Excellent, Bianca.
Cress.trainerLoses: A small mishap, Bianca. No matter.

Bianca.greeting: Cress always pulls out my chair at the restaurant! He's such a gentleman! Let's win for him!
Bianca.trainerWins: Cress is such a gentleman! We won for him!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I couldn't win for Cress... Sorry!

Cress.greeting: Grimsley's gambles are more calculated than they appear. I can respect a careful risk.
Cress.trainerWins: A careful risk, and a fine reward.
Cress.trainerLoses: The risk did not pay. A lesson, perhaps.

Grimsley.greeting: Cress plays every hand with perfect composure. A partner who never shows his cards. Splendid.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Never showed his cards, and won the hand.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: The cards betrayed us both.

Cress.greeting: Colress analyzes battles as carefully as I steep tea. A precise partnership, I'd say.
Cress.trainerWins: A precise result, perfectly steeped.

Colress.greeting: Cress has a methodical mind. Water and Steel, an elegant experiment awaits.
Colress.trainerLoses: The experiment failed! How interesting!

Cilan.greeting: Lenora's battles have the flavor of history! Like an heirloom recipe! It's evaluation time!
Cilan.trainerWins: A historic flavor! It's delicious!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The heirloom recipe spoiled! Oh no!

Lenora.greeting: Cilan is evaluating everything again! Then evaluate this: a historic win for Unova!
Lenora.trainerWins: A historic win for Unova! I knew it!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Cilan, evaluate THIS loss. Ouch.

Cilan.greeting: Brycen's battles taste cool and crisp, like a mint sorbet! Grass and Ice, a refreshing course!
Cilan.trainerWins: A refreshing course, perfectly served!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The sorbet melted! Evaluation: runny!

Brycen.greeting: Cilan's Grass types and my Ice types. A garden in winter. An unusual scene, but a strong one. Hm!

Cilan.greeting: Bianca's battles are sweet and bubbly, like berry soda! It's evaluation time!
Cilan.trainerWins: A sweet, bubbly victory! It's delicious!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The soda fizzled! Evaluation: flat!

Bianca.greeting: Cilan says I taste like berry soda! Hehe! I'll take it! Let's do our best!
Bianca.trainerWins: Berry soda wins! Hehe!
Bianca.trainerLoses: The soda spilled... and so did we!

Cilan.greeting: Grimsley's battles taste bold and bitter, like dark chocolate! A daring flavor! Evaluation time!
Cilan.trainerWins: A bold, daring triumph! It's delicious!
Cilan.trainerLoses: Too bitter, it seems! Evaluation: harsh!

Grimsley.greeting: Cilan's palate reads people better than any poker face. I'll trust his taste in partners.
Grimsley.trainerWins: His taste never lies. A winning partner.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Even good taste loses a hand now and then.

Cilan.greeting: Colress's battles taste precise and a little metallic! A molecular gastronomy! Evaluation time!
Cilan.trainerWins: Molecular gastronomy, perfected!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The experiment curdled! Evaluation: odd!

Colress.greeting: Cilan evaluates battles by flavor. Unscientific, yet often correct. Let's test his method.
Colress.trainerLoses: His method failed. Science prevails, then.

Lenora.greeting: Brycen's old films are part of our museum's Unova culture exhibit! Let's make a new classic!
Lenora.trainerWins: A new classic for the museum!
Lenora.trainerLoses: This one stays out of the exhibit!

Brycen.greeting: Lenora preserves Unova's past. I once played it on screen. Today we make it real. Hm!

Lenora.greeting: Bianca's research for Professor Juniper is important work! Let's battle for science and history!
Lenora.trainerWins: Science and history win together!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Science and history learned something today!

Bianca.greeting: Lenora gave me a museum tour once! I tripped on a fossil... it was fine! Let's win!
Bianca.trainerWins: Lenora's tour paid off! We won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I tripped on a fossil AND lost...

Lenora.greeting: Grimsley, history is full of risky bets. Let's make sure this one ends up in the history books!
Lenora.trainerWins: Into the history books, just like I said!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History books have losers too, it seems!

Grimsley.greeting: Lenora's research is thorough. A partner who studies the odds is a partner worth betting on.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Study the odds, and they favor you. Splendid.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: The odds were studied. And ignored.

Lenora.greeting: Colress, your research once served Team Plasma. Today, let's research a victory together.
Lenora.trainerWins: Research complete: victory!
Lenora.trainerLoses: Research complete: defeat. Back to the books.

Colress.greeting: Lenora's museum holds Unova's past. I study Pokémon's future. Together, we cover all of time.
Colress.trainerLoses: Even all of time couldn't save us.

Brycen.greeting: Bianca's cheer is like a fan at a film premiere. Let's give her a show worth watching. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: A show worth watching, for our fan. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: The show disappointed our fan. Hm.

Bianca.greeting: Brycen was Brycen-Man! I watched all his movies with my dad! Let's win, partner!
Bianca.trainerWins: Brycen-Man wins again! Like the movies!
Bianca.trainerLoses: Brycen-Man lost... that's not how the movie ends!

Brycen.greeting: Grimsley's gambles are like a stunt with no safety net. Thrilling, as long as it lands. Hm!

Grimsley.greeting: Brycen faced danger on film sets for years. Cold nerves. My favorite kind of partner.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Cold nerves, a clean win. My favorite.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Cold nerves, cold loss.

Brycen.greeting: Colress's machines would make fine movie props. Ice and Steel, a cold, hard scene. Hm!

Colress.greeting: Brycen's Ice types endure extreme conditions. Remarkable resilience. Let's push it further.
Colress.trainerLoses: Pushed too far, it seems. Data noted.

Bianca.greeting: Grimsley's an Elite Four member! Eek! I'm so nervous! But I'll do my very best!
Bianca.trainerWins: I did my very best, and we won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I was so nervous... I'm sorry, Grimsley!

Grimsley.greeting: Bianca's luck is completely unpredictable. In a gamble, that's the best kind. Let's play.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The unpredictable paid off. What luck!
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Luck ran out. Such is the game.

Bianca.greeting: Colress is a scientist too! Professor Juniper would love to hear about his research!
Bianca.trainerWins: Professor Juniper will love hearing about this win!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I'll tell the Professor we tried our best...

Colress.greeting: Bianca works for Professor Juniper? Then she understands. Let's draw out our Pokémon's potential.
Colress.trainerLoses: Potential untapped today. Intriguing.

Grimsley.greeting: Colress calls every battle an experiment. I call it a gamble. In Alola, we're both far from home.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Far from home, and still winning. Splendid.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Far from home, and far from winning.

Colress.greeting: Grimsley thrives on uncertainty. I thrive on reducing it. Together, an interesting result.
Colress.trainerLoses: An interesting result: defeat!

Sina.greeting: Dexio and I came from Kalos together, and we battle together too! Professor Sycamore would be proud!
Sina.trainerWins: Professor Sycamore WOULD be proud! We won!
Sina.trainerLoses: The Professor will still be proud of our effort, right?

Dexio.greeting: Sina is cheerful enough for both of us. I'll handle the strategy. Kalos's research team, ready.
Dexio.trainerLoses: My strategy needs revision. Sina, stay cheerful.

Plumeria.greeting: Guzma, try not to wreck the tree before we wreck this kid. Team Skull's taking this one.

Plumeria.trainerLoses: Guzma, you wrecked the tree. And us.

Plumeria.greeting: A Trial Captain on my team? Don't tell my grunts. Just keep that fire pointed at the kid.

Plumeria.trainerLoses: Even a Captain couldn't save us.

Kiawe.greeting: Plumeria, Team Skull and a Trial Captain? Fine! For Alola, I'll dance the fire dance at your side!

Kiawe.trainerLoses: My fire dance failed even beside Team Skull!

Plumeria.greeting: Mallow, huh? My grunts can't stop talking about your cooking. Make this kid eat their words.

Mallow.greeting: Plumeria's tough, but she protects her friends. I respect that! Today's special: Alolan teamwork!
Mallow.trainerWins: Alolan teamwork, served hot!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Today's special got sent back!

Guzma.greeting: A Trial Captain?! Big bad Guzma never needed your trials! But fine, let's wreck this kid together!
Guzma.trainerWins: Wrecked the kid! Big bad Guzma never needed trials!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Wrecked by the kid! Ugh! No trials!

Kiawe.greeting: Guzma once tried to take the trials too. Show me what you've got now. Akala's flames are with you!

Guzma.greeting: The Lush Jungle captain, huh? Big bad Guzma'll smash 'em, you clean up the mess. Deal?
Guzma.trainerWins: Smashed 'em! Mallow cleaned up! Deal's a deal!

Mallow.greeting: Guzma, if you wreck my jungle again, I'm feeding you my spiciest dish! Now, let's battle!
Mallow.trainerWins: No spicy dish needed! We won!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Guzma, you're getting the spicy dish anyway!

Kiawe.greeting: Mallow and I are both Akala Trial Captains! Fire and Grass, Alola's island spirit burns bright!

Mallow.greeting: Kiawe, your fire would make perfect grilled Alolan sausages! Akala's captains, let's cook!
Mallow.trainerWins: Grilled sausages AND a win! Let's cook!
Mallow.trainerLoses: The sausages burned! So did we!

Brock.greeting: Roxanne studied my Gym's battles in her textbooks. Two Rock-type Leaders, rock-solid together!

Roxanne.greeting: Brock's battles were in my study notes! Today, Kanto and Hoenn's Rock types write a new chapter.
Roxanne.trainerWins: A new chapter, written in victory!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: The chapter ends in defeat. I'll revise my notes.

Brock.greeting: Roark digs up fossils, just like Pewter's museum! Rock types from Kanto and Sinnoh, let's go!
Brock.trainerWins: Rock types from Kanto and Sinnoh, unbreakable!

Roark.greeting: Brock's the original Rock-type Leader! I'm honored. Oreburgh and Pewter, rock-hard teamwork!
Roark.trainerWins: Honored to win with the original!
Roark.trainerLoses: Even the original couldn't save us.

Roxanne.greeting: Roark revives living fossils! I've read all about them. Rock types from Hoenn and Sinnoh, together!
Roxanne.trainerWins: Living fossils and textbook notes, victorious!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: My geology notes didn't cover this. Oops.

Roark.greeting: Roxanne's notes on Rock types are better than my mining manuals! Let's dig in, Rustboro!
Roark.trainerWins: Dug in and won, Rustboro!
Roark.trainerLoses: Dug too deep. Lost.

Misty.greeting: Juan taught Wallace everything about Water types! I want to learn his secrets, after we win!
Misty.trainerWins: We won! Now, Juan, tell me your secrets!
Misty.trainerLoses: We lost... I guess the secrets stay secret.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Misty! The Cerulean mermaid! Kanto's waters and Hoenn's, a sparkling duet!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, a sparkling duet! Magnifique!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the duet ended off-key.

Misty.greeting: Crasher Wake's so loud! But he loves Water types as much as I do. Cerulean and Pastoria, splash!
Misty.trainerWins: Cerulean and Pastoria made a splash!
Misty.trainerLoses: Too much splash, not enough win!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Misty! The Cerulean tomboy mermaid! Water-type tag team, Crasher Wake style! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! The Water-type tag team triumphs!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Splashed out!

Misty.greeting: Marlon surfs better than I swim, and I swim like a mermaid! Cerulean and Humilau, Water types forever!
Misty.trainerWins: Water types forever! We won!
Misty.trainerLoses: Our tsunami fizzled out!

Marlon.greeting: Misty's a total Water-type pro! Kanto's waves and Unova's waves, man, that's a tsunami!

Misty.trainerLoses: Not even a ripple. Sorry, Cress.

Cress.greeting: Misty's devotion to Water types is admirable. Allow me to serve alongside Cerulean's finest.

Cress.trainerLoses: A humbling end. Forgive me, Misty.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Crasher Wake! Such powerful waves! Sootopolis elegance and Pastoria strength, a Water ballet!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, the Water ballet triumphs!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, the ballet has fallen flat!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Juan! The master of Water types! The Crasher Wake bows! Then we crush! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Bowed, then crushed!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Bowed, then crushed... us!

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Marlon! A surfer of Unova's seas! Let us make waves into art, my young friend.

Marlon.greeting: Juan's so fancy with his Water types, man! Sootopolis and Humilau, the biggest wave yet!
Marlon.trainerWins: Biggest wave yet, man!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out on the biggest wave, dude.

Juan.greeting: Ahh, Cress! Such refinement in a Water-type master! A duet of elegance, Hoenn and Unova!
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, elegance prevails!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, elegance alone isn't enough!

Cress.greeting: Juan's artistry with Water types is unmatched. I would be honored to learn from him. Shall we?
Cress.trainerWins: An honor, and a lesson in victory.

Crasher Wake.greeting: Marlon! The Humilau surfer! Water-type tag team, Sinnoh and Unova! The Crasher Wake rides!

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! The Crasher Wake wipes out!

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Order cancelled!

Cress.greeting: Crasher Wake's enthusiasm is overwhelming. Still, Water types are Water types. Shall we?
Cress.trainerWins: Overwhelming, yet effective. Splendid.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Wattson, you old sparkplug! Vermilion and Mauville, the most electrifying team on the planet!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Lt. Surge! Kanto's lightning and Hoenn's thunder! Shocking, isn't it?!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Volkner looks bored, kid! Let's give him a jolt! Vermilion and Sunyshore, full voltage!

Volkner.trainerWins: Strong team. Strong win. Fine.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Elesa's a supermodel AND an Electric-type pro! Vermilion and Nimbasa, maximum voltage, kid!

Elesa.greeting: Lt. Surge's thunder and my sparks! Kanto's lightning and Unova's spotlight, dazzling!
Elesa.trainerWins: Dazzling! Kanto's lightning and Unova's spotlight!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Volkner! Mauville's power and Sunyshore's solar panels! A shocking team!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Elesa's runway glows brighter than Mauville's arcade! Both our cities run on electricity!

Elesa.greeting: Wattson's laugh is pure static! Mauville and Nimbasa, let's give them a dazzling shock!
Elesa.trainerWins: A dazzling shock, delivered!

Volkner.greeting: Elesa. Unova's Electric-type star. Finally, someone who might make this interesting.

Elesa.greeting: Volkner looks bored? I'll fix that. Sunyshore's lighthouse and Nimbasa's spotlight, full charge!

Erika.greeting: Gardenia's flowers have the loveliest fragrance. Celadon and Eterna, a garden in full bloom.

Gardenia.greeting: Cilan says my battles taste fresh, like a forest salad! Eterna and Striaton, let's grow!

Gardenia.trainerLoses: We didn't grow fast enough...

Cilan.greeting: Gardenia's battles have a fresh, forest-green flavor! A Grass-type feast! Evaluation time!
Cilan.trainerWins: A fresh forest feast! It's delicious!
Cilan.trainerLoses: The salad wilted! Evaluation: limp!

Gardenia.greeting: Mallow's Lush Jungle is like Eterna Forest, but sunnier! Grass types, Sinnoh and Alola!
Gardenia.trainerWins: Sinnoh and Alola bloomed together!

Mallow.greeting: Cilan's a connoisseur? Let's cook up a win! Grass types, Unova and Alola, the ultimate menu!

Plumeria.greeting: Roxie's got attitude. I like it. Poison types, let's show this kid what toxic really means.

Anabel.trainerLoses: The bond held. The battle didn't.

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Flannery took over her grandpa's Gym, and I rebuilt mine after a volcano blew it up! Fire-type Leaders never quit!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Fire-type Leaders never quit, and we won!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Even an eruption couldn't stop me... but you did!

Flannery.greeting: Blaine kept his Gym going even after Cinnabar's volcano erupted! That's the Leader I want to be! Let's heat it up!
Flannery.trainerWins: That's the Leader I want to be! We won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I want to be like Blaine... starting with not losing!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Quiz time, Chili! Which burns hotter, Cinnabar's volcano or Striaton's kitchen? Let's test it on the challenger!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! The challenger got roasted! Quiz complete!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Wrong answer! We got roasted!

Chili.greeting: Blaine's quizzes are awesome! Answer: the challenger's about to get roasted! Fire types, let's go!
Chili.trainerWins: Roasted, just like I said!

Blaine.greeting: Hah! Kiawe dances on Wela Volcano, and I built my Gym on Cinnabar's! Two volcano men, burning bright!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Two volcano men, burning bright!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Our volcanoes went dormant!

Kiawe.greeting: Blaine's Gym survived an eruption, and his fire never went out! Akala's captain salutes you! Let's burn!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: My fire dance fell short beside the master...

Flannery.greeting: Chili's even more fired up than me! Lavaridge's hot springs and Striaton's hot sauce, let's get spicy!
Flannery.trainerWins: Spicy AND victorious!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Too spicy for us, I guess!

Chili.greeting: Flannery gets it! Fire's all about passion! Lavaridge and Striaton, crank up the heat!
Chili.trainerWins: Cranked up the heat! We won!

Flannery.greeting: Kiawe's fire dance is so cool! Maybe I'll try it at the Lavaridge hot springs! Let's burn it up!
Flannery.trainerWins: Volcano Trainers win! I'm trying the fire dance!
Flannery.trainerLoses: My fire dance needs work... we lost!

Kiawe.greeting: Flannery's spirit burns like Wela Volcano itself! Lavaridge and Akala, volcano Trainers unite!

Chili.greeting: Kiawe's a fire dancer, and I'm a fire waiter! Same energy! Let's serve up some flames!
Chili.trainerWins: Flames served hot! Victory!

Kiawe.greeting: Chili's passion rivals the flames of Wela Volcano! Fire types, our blaze will not die out!

Giovanni.greeting: Clay built an empire from his mines. I built mine by... other means. Ground types respect only strength.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Strength respected. Business concluded.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Strength failed. Unacceptable.

Clay.greeting: Team Rocket's boss, huh? Hmph. Business is business, and my Ground types don't care who's watchin'. Let's dig.
Clay.trainerWins: Business is business. And business is good.
Clay.trainerLoses: Business went bust. Hmph.

Falkner.greeting: Winona's birds fly like clouds. My father would have loved to see them. Violet and Fortree, take wing!
Falkner.trainerWins: Violet and Fortree took wing! My father would be proud!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We were grounded today. Even the clouds fell.

Winona.greeting: Falkner defends the honor of Flying types, as I do. Johto's skies and Hoenn's, soaring as one.

Falkner.greeting: Skyla flies real planes! My birds are a little jealous. Flying-type Leaders, let's soar!
Falkner.trainerWins: Flying-type Leaders soared! Great flying, Skyla!
Falkner.trainerLoses: My birds are jealous of your plane... and that challenger.

Skyla.greeting: Falkner's birds are so well trained! Violet City's finest and Mistralton Cargo, cleared for takeoff!
Skyla.trainerWins: Cleared for takeoff, landed a win!

Winona.greeting: Skyla's cargo planes and my birds ride the same winds. Fortree and Mistralton, together in the sky.
Winona.trainerWins: Same winds, same victory. Well flown, Skyla.
Winona.trainerLoses: The winds turned against us both.

Skyla.greeting: Winona's so graceful in the air! I'm more of a loop-the-loop flyer. Fortree and Mistralton, let's take off!
Skyla.trainerWins: Loop-the-loop to victory!

Bugsy.greeting: Burgh paints Bug types, and I research them! Azalea and Castelia, the Bug-type experts' summit!
Bugsy.trainerWins: The Bug-type experts' summit, victorious!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: My research needs more data!

Burgh.greeting: Bugsy knows every Bug type by heart, and I know them by color! Together, a Bug-type masterpiece!
Burgh.trainerWins: A Bug-type masterpiece!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The masterpiece got squashed!

Bugsy.greeting: Guzma's Bug types are amazing! Can I take notes on them after the battle? Bug types, let's go!
Bugsy.trainerWins: I wrote it down: destruction! Of the challenger!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: I'll take notes on how we got destroyed instead...

Guzma.greeting: A Bug-type nerd, huh? Fine. Watch big bad Guzma and write this down: destruction!
Guzma.trainerWins: Big bad Guzma smashed it! Write THAT down!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Big bad Guzma got smashed! Don't write that!

Burgh.greeting: Guzma's Bug types are a sculpture of pure power! How inspiring!
Burgh.trainerWins: A sculpture of pure power, and pure victory!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The sculpture crumbled!

Guzma.greeting: An artist with Bug types? Whatever. Paint a picture of big bad Guzma smashin' this kid!
Guzma.trainerWins: Big bad Guzma, smashin' it! Paint that!

Whitney.greeting: Norman's team is huge! Me and my cuties are gonna roll right alongside 'em! Normal types, go!
Whitney.trainerWins: We rolled right over 'em! Normal types rule!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We got rolled over! Waah!

Norman.greeting: Whitney's team has humbled many challengers. Goldenrod and Petalburg, let's show what Normal types can do.
Norman.trainerWins: Normal types humbled another challenger. Well done, Whitney.
Norman.trainerLoses: We were humbled today. Train harder.

Whitney.greeting: Cheren's so serious! Are you gonna grade me, Teach? Normal types are cute AND strong!
Whitney.trainerWins: Cute AND strong! What's my grade, Teach?
Whitney.trainerLoses: Do I get extra credit for trying?

Cheren.greeting: Whitney's team is the textbook example of underestimated Normal types. Today's lesson begins.
Cheren.trainerWins: Textbook. Whitney gets top marks.
Cheren.trainerLoses: The lesson didn't go to plan. Revising.

Whitney.greeting: Lenora runs a museum AND a Normal-type Gym? That's so cool! Goldenrod and Nacrene, let's go!
Whitney.trainerWins: Goldenrod and Nacrene win! History made!
Whitney.trainerLoses: No history books for this one... Waah!

Lenora.greeting: Whitney's Gym is famous for humbling new Trainers! Let's add that to the history books! Normal types, together!
Lenora.trainerWins: Another newcomer humbled! Into the history books!
Lenora.trainerLoses: The history books will say we tried!

Norman.greeting: Cheren teaches young Trainers. I raised one. Normal types, like students, show their strength with patience.
Norman.trainerWins: Patience showed our strength. Well done, Cheren.
Norman.trainerLoses: Patience wasn't enough today. We learn.

Cheren.greeting: Norman's team is a lesson in raw power. Petalburg and Aspertia, Normal types, side by side.
Cheren.trainerWins: A lesson in raw power, delivered. Thank you, sir.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Raw power fell short. A lesson for us both.

Norman.greeting: Lenora understands that Normal types are anything but ordinary. Petalburg and Nacrene, let's prove it.
Norman.trainerWins: Anything but ordinary, as proven.
Norman.trainerLoses: Ordinary today, I'm afraid.

Lenora.greeting: Norman's battles are the stuff of Hoenn legend! Let's make some Unova history too! Normal types, together!
Lenora.trainerWins: Hoenn legend and Unova history, made together!
Lenora.trainerLoses: History won't remember this one fondly!

Morty.greeting: Fantina's Ghost types move like dancers. Ecruteak and Hearthome, a mystical pairing.
Morty.trainerWins: A mystical victory, as I foresaw.
Morty.trainerLoses: The spirits turned away from us.

Fantina.greeting: Morty, the Ecruteak mystic! Ghost types of Johto and Sinnoh, a séance magnifique!
Fantina.trainerWins: Une séance magnifique! Victory!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The séance has ended in sorrow!

Chuck.greeting: Brawly trains in the sea, I train under waterfalls! Same water, same spirit! Fighting types, HYAH!
Chuck.trainerWins: HYAH! Same spirit, same win!
Chuck.trainerLoses: HYAH! Knocked out ourselves!

Brawly.greeting: Chuck's waterfall training is legendary! Cianwood's surf and Dewford's waves, let's knock 'em out!
Brawly.trainerWins: Knocked 'em out! Waves and waterfalls!
Brawly.trainerLoses: We got knocked out instead!

Chuck.greeting: Maylene trains barefoot! Excellent! Toughen those soles! Fighting types, Cianwood and Veilstone!
Chuck.trainerWins: Wahahah! Tough soles, tough win!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Even tough soles slip!

Maylene.greeting: Chuck's training is so intense... I want to try the waterfall too! After we win! Fighting types, let's go!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I lost... maybe I need the waterfall now!

Brawly.greeting: Maylene's team has some serious aura! Dewford's waves and Veilstone's fists, let's do this!
Brawly.trainerWins: Serious aura, serious win!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The aura wasn't enough, dude.

Maylene.greeting: Brawly's so cool and confident. I'll do my best too! Fighting types from Hoenn and Sinnoh, together!
Maylene.trainerWins: I did my best, and we won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I did my best... it wasn't enough.

Jasmine.greeting: Byron's steel and mine... we'll be like a wall. Olivine and Canalave are both harbor towns, too.
Jasmine.trainerWins: Like a wall. Olivine and Canalave held firm.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: The wall broke... I'm sorry, Byron.

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! Jasmine! Two harbor-town Steel-type Leaders! Our defense is unbreakable!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Unbreakable defense!

Jasmine.greeting: Colress says my Steel types have great potential. I... think so too. Let's do our best together.
Jasmine.trainerWins: My Steel types reached their potential. Thank you, Colress.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We didn't reach it today...

Colress.greeting: Jasmine's bond with her Steel types is quiet but powerful. Let's see how far it can go.
Colress.trainerLoses: The potential remains untapped. Curious.

Byron.greeting: Gahahah! A scientist who loves Steel types! Canalave's mines could use your gadgets, Colress!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahahah! Gadgets and steel, victorious!

Colress.greeting: Byron's Steel types were forged by years in the mines. Fascinating. Let's measure their full potential.
Colress.trainerLoses: The measurement says: defeat. Intriguing.

Pryce.greeting: Candice is full of youthful fire, for an Ice-type Trainer. Mahogany and Snowpoint, winter's might.
Pryce.trainerWins: Youthful fire and winter's might. A fine pairing.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Winter loses, now and then.

Candice.greeting: Pryce! The Ice-type grandmaster! FOCUS, Candice! Let's give 'em a blizzard!
Candice.trainerLoses: The blizzard melted! Focus harder!

Pryce.trainerWins: The mountains chose well. A victory.
Pryce.trainerLoses: The mountains are cold tonight.

Brycen.greeting: Pryce has endured more winters than I have. I'll follow his lead. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: Following his lead, to victory. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: Even his lead couldn't save us. Hm.

Pryce.greeting: Young Sina's cheer melts even an old man's frost. Ice types, Johto and Kalos.
Pryce.trainerWins: Even an old man's frost can win. Well done, Sina.
Pryce.trainerLoses: The frost melted today.

Sina.greeting: Pryce is an Ice-type legend! I'm going to study how he battles! Let's freeze 'em!
Sina.trainerWins: I studied how Pryce battles, and we won!
Sina.trainerLoses: I'll study how Pryce loses, too, I guess...

Candice.greeting: Brycen-Man was my favorite movie hero! FOCUS! Snowpoint and Icirrus, ice cold!
Candice.trainerLoses: My movie hero lost! Focus, next time!

Brycen.greeting: Candice's energy could melt a glacier. Point it at the challenger. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: A glacier, melted. The challenger's. Hm!

Candice.greeting: Sina loves Ice types as much as I do! FOCUS! Snowpoint and Kalos, let's make it snow!
Candice.trainerLoses: The snow melted! Focus, next time!

Sina.greeting: Candice's energy is contagious! Ice types from Sinnoh and Kalos, let's freeze this battle!
Sina.trainerWins: Froze the battle! Great job, Candice!

Brycen.greeting: Sina's cheer warms even an icy heart. Icirrus and Kalos, together. Hm!
Brycen.trainerWins: An icy heart, warmed by victory. Hm!
Brycen.trainerLoses: An icy heart, chilled by defeat. Hm.

Sina.greeting: Brycen was in movies? Dexio has to see this! Ice types, let's go!
Sina.trainerWins: Dexio's going to want to see this! We won!

Clair.greeting: Drayden. Opelucid's dragon master. Finally, a partner worthy of Blackthorn's dragons.
Clair.trainerWins: A worthy partner, and a worthy win.
Clair.trainerLoses: Even the worthy fall. Irritating.

Drayden.greeting: Clair has the pride of a true dragon tamer. Blackthorn and Opelucid, let us show you a dragon's might.
Drayden.trainerWins: A dragon's might, shown. Well done, Clair.
Drayden.trainerLoses: A dragon's might, humbled.

Lorelei.trainerWins: Frozen out, as promised. Thank you, Agatha.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Old colleagues, old mistakes. Hmph.

Agatha.greeting: Lorelei always was the chilly one. Leave the real chills to me, dearie.
Agatha.trainerWins: The real chills came through, dearie.
Agatha.trainerLoses: Chilly and beaten. How embarrassing.

Lorelei.greeting: Blaine, try not to melt my strategy with your volcano talk.
Lorelei.trainerWins: My strategy survived the volcano talk. Good.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Melted strategy. As I feared.

Blaine.greeting: Quiz time, Lorelei! What melts ice fastest? Hah! Don't answer, just watch!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! What melts ice fastest? The challenger's chances!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Melted myself!

Lorelei.trainerLoses: The wall cracked. A pity.

Brock.greeting: Lorelei of the Elite Four! I'll hold the line so your ice can do its work.
Brock.trainerWins: The line held! Your ice did its work, Lorelei!

Lorelei.greeting: Bruno, warm up quietly, please. I need you focused, not shouting.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Focused, and victorious. Thank you, Bruno.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Too much shouting. Too little winning.

Bruno.greeting: Hoo hah! Lorelei! The Indigo Plateau's old guard rides again!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! The old guard rides on!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! The old guard fell!

Lorelei.greeting: Brycen, I hear you once starred in films. Let's give this battle a chilling final scene.
Lorelei.trainerWins: A chilling final scene. Perfect.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: The final scene thawed.

Brycen.greeting: Lorelei of Kanto. Ice from two regions, one very cold welcome.
Brycen.trainerLoses: A cold farewell for us. Hm.

Lorelei.greeting: Candice, your energy could melt a glacier. Aim it at our opponent, please.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Your energy was well aimed. Good.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Your energy... scattered. As did my plan.

Candice.greeting: Lorelei! An ice legend from Kanto! I'm so focused right now, I promise!
Candice.trainerWins: I was SO focused! We won!
Candice.trainerLoses: I lost focus! I'm so sorry!

Lorelei.greeting: Erika, try to stay awake. This will be a cold, quick battle.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Cold and quick, as I said. Well done, Erika.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Erika slept through our loss, I think.

Erika.greeting: Lorelei... how refreshing to have a cool breeze beside me in this heat.
Erika.trainerWins: A refreshing victory. How lovely.
Erika.trainerLoses: The breeze turned cold. Oh dear.

Lorelei.greeting: Giovanni. I'll battle beside you, but I'm keeping one eye on you.
Lorelei.trainerWins: We won. I'm still watching you, Giovanni.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: We lost, and I'm still watching you.

Giovanni.greeting: The Elite Four's ice. Freeze them in place; I'll handle the rest.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Frozen and handled. Efficient.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Unhandled. Unacceptable.

Lorelei.greeting: Glacia, two ice masters from two Leagues. Our opponent may need a blanket.

Lorelei.trainerLoses: We're the ones who need a blanket.

Glacia.greeting: Lorelei, how lovely. Let's show them what true cold feels like.
Glacia.trainerWins: True cold, felt by all. Lovely.

Lorelei.greeting: Janine, your father speaks very highly of you. Let's see why.

Lorelei.trainerLoses: Your father will understand. Losses teach.

Janine.greeting: Lorelei! Father says you're the coolest trainer he knows. Literally!
Janine.trainerWins: The coolest trainer, and a cool win!
Janine.trainerLoses: Even the coolest trainer can't win every time!

Lorelei.greeting: Koga, ice and poison. Please, no smoke bombs near my glasses.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Ice, poison, and no smoke bombs. Excellent.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: A smoke bomb went off, didn't it? We lost.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Lorelei! The Plateau's frost and a ninja's venom. A fearsome blend!

Lorelei.greeting: Lance, it's like the old days at the Plateau. Try not to steal the whole spotlight.

Lorelei.trainerLoses: The old days ended in defeat this time.

Lance.greeting: Lorelei, your ice and my dragons, side by side once more. Just like old times.
Lance.trainerWins: Ice and dragons, still unbeatable together.
Lance.trainerLoses: Old times, old friends, new loss.

Lorelei.greeting: Lt. Surge, please lower your voice. Ice requires concentration.

Lorelei.trainerLoses: Too loud to concentrate. As I feared.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Ice and lightning, soldier! Lorelei, let's freeze 'em and fry 'em!
Lt. Surge.trainerLoses: Ha! Got frozen AND fried ourselves!

Lorelei.greeting: Misty, water freezes. Let's use that to our advantage.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Water froze. Advantage taken.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: The water stayed liquid. Pity.

Misty.greeting: Lorelei! Your ice and my water? We'll build one giant iceberg!
Misty.trainerWins: One giant iceberg, victory!
Misty.trainerLoses: The iceberg melted!

Lorelei.greeting: Pryce, your decades on the ice put my years to shame. I'm honored.
Lorelei.trainerWins: An honor, and a win. Thank you, Pryce.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Even decades of ice can crack.

Pryce.greeting: Lorelei. Young ice, old ice. Together, they don't crack.
Pryce.trainerWins: Young ice, old ice, unbroken.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Cracked, at last. Hmph.

Lorelei.greeting: Sabrina, I suppose you already know how this battle ends.
Lorelei.trainerWins: You knew, didn't you? Victory.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: You knew this too, I suppose.

Sabrina.greeting: Lorelei. I foresee frost. A great deal of frost.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Frost, as foreseen. Victory.

Lorelei.greeting: Sina, Alolan ice? I'm curious to see how it holds up in this heat.
Lorelei.trainerWins: Alolan ice holds up. Impressive.
Lorelei.trainerLoses: Melted in the heat, I'm afraid.

Sina.greeting: Lorelei, an ice master from Kanto! Dexio is going to be so jealous!
Sina.trainerWins: Dexio will be SO jealous! We won!
Sina.trainerLoses: Dexio won't be jealous of this loss...

Bruno.greeting: Agatha! Your ghosts and my fists. A strange team, but a strong one!
Bruno.trainerWins: A strange team, a strong win! Hoo hah!

Agatha.greeting: Bruno, try not to punch anything I need. Hah!
Agatha.trainerWins: Nothing important punched. Good boy.
Agatha.trainerLoses: You punched something important. Our chances.

Bruno.greeting: Blaine! Burn them hot, and I'll hit them hard!
Bruno.trainerWins: Burned hot, hit hard! Victory!

Blaine.greeting: Bruno! Which is tougher, my quizzes or your punches? Trick question: neither, today!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Neither was tougher than our teamwork!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! The challenger was toughest of all!

Bruno.greeting: Brawly! A surfer with fists like stone. Show me your power!
Bruno.trainerWins: Power shown! Well fought, Brawly!

Brawly.greeting: Whoa, Bruno! Big waves, big muscles! Let's crash this battle!
Brawly.trainerWins: Crashed this battle, dude!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Got crashed ourselves!

Bruno.greeting: Brock! Rock-solid as always. Stand firm beside me!
Bruno.trainerWins: Rock-solid! Hoo hah!

Brock.greeting: Bruno, I'm taking notes on your training regimen after this!
Brock.trainerWins: Taking notes on that win, Bruno!
Brock.trainerLoses: Taking notes on that loss, too...

Bruno.greeting: Bugsy! Small but sharp, like a well-placed jab!
Bruno.trainerWins: A well-placed jab! Victory!

Bugsy.greeting: Bruno, I've researched your training methods. Very effective, statistically!

Bugsy.trainerLoses: Statistically, we lost.

Bruno.greeting: Chuck! Waterfall training never gets old, does it? Hoo hah!

Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Back to the waterfall!

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! Bruno! Two fighting men, four fists! Let's go!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Four fists of victory!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Four fists, zero wins!

Bruno.greeting: Clair! Your dragons and my discipline. Let's crush them!
Bruno.trainerWins: Crushed them! Well done, Clair!
Bruno.trainerLoses: We were the ones crushed! Hmph!

Clair.greeting: Bruno. Just keep pace with my dragons, and we'll be fine.
Clair.trainerWins: You kept pace. Fine. We won.
Clair.trainerLoses: You couldn't keep pace. Neither could I.

Bruno.greeting: Erika! Stay alert! No napping in the middle of a battle!
Bruno.trainerWins: No napping, and a win! Excellent!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! Did you nap, Erika?!

Erika.greeting: Bruno... please don't shout. I'm quite awake, thank you.
Erika.trainerWins: Quite awake, and quite victorious. Thank you.
Erika.trainerLoses: Perhaps I should have napped. Oh dear.

Bruno.greeting: Falkner! You take the skies, I'll take the ground!
Bruno.trainerWins: Skies and ground, both ours!

Falkner.greeting: Bruno, the Elite Four's mightiest fists. I'm honored to fly beside you.
Falkner.trainerWins: An honor, and a victory!
Falkner.trainerLoses: I let the mightiest fists down...

Bruno.greeting: Giovanni. I don't trust you, but I'll battle beside you. Hmph!
Bruno.trainerWins: We won. I still don't trust you. Hmph!
Bruno.trainerLoses: We lost. I still don't trust you. Hmph!

Giovanni.greeting: Bruno. All muscle. Good. I need the muscle.
Giovanni.trainerWins: The muscle delivered. Good.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Muscle wasn't enough.

Bruno.greeting: Hala! A Kahuna with power to match my own! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Power matched, victory gained! Hoo hah!

Hala.greeting: Hoh! Bruno, your training is legendary! Let's see it up close!

Bruno.trainerLoses: Your father will want a word. Train harder!

Janine.greeting: Bruno! Father's old colleague! I'll keep up, I promise!
Janine.trainerWins: I kept up! We won!
Janine.trainerLoses: I couldn't keep up... sorry, Bruno!

Bruno.greeting: Jasmine. Gentle, yet tough as steel. I respect that.

Jasmine.greeting: Um... Bruno, please don't be too rough with our opponent.

Bruno.greeting: Koga! Ninja and fighter, guarding the Plateau together once more!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! The Plateau's guard holds!

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Bruno, your fists and my poison. None shall stand!

Bruno.greeting: Lance! The Plateau's old guard, back together! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hoo hah! The old guard, victorious!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hoo hah! The old guard falls!

Lance.greeting: Bruno, it's good to fight beside you again, old friend.
Lance.trainerWins: Good to win beside you, old friend.
Lance.trainerLoses: Good to fight beside you, even in defeat.

Bruno.greeting: Surge! A soldier's discipline matches a fighter's! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Discipline wins! Hoo hah!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Bruno! My drill sergeant would've loved you! Fall in, soldier!

Bruno.greeting: Marshal! I hear Alder trained you well. Show me!
Bruno.trainerWins: Alder trained you well! Proven!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Train harder, Marshal! As will I!

Marshal.greeting: Bruno of the Elite Four. Your discipline is famous in Unova too. Let us begin.
Marshal.trainerWins: Your discipline, shared. A worthy victory.
Marshal.trainerLoses: Discipline alone could not win. A lesson.

Bruno.greeting: Maylene! Barefoot and fearless! I like your style!
Bruno.trainerWins: Fearless and victorious! Hoo hah!

Maylene.greeting: Bruno! I've studied your fighting style for years! Let's do this!
Maylene.trainerWins: Years of study paid off! We won!
Maylene.trainerLoses: I studied for years... and still lost!

Bruno.greeting: Misty! Cerulean's tomboyish mermaid! Strong water, strong will!
Bruno.trainerWins: Strong water, strong win!

Misty.greeting: Bruno, don't splash around too much. That's my job!
Misty.trainerWins: No extra splashing! Good job, Bruno!
Misty.trainerLoses: Too much splashing! From Bruno!

Bruno.greeting: Morty! You see the future? Then you know we'll win!
Bruno.trainerWins: You foresaw it! Victory!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Didn't see this one, did you?!

Morty.greeting: Bruno... I sense great strength. And great volume.
Morty.trainerWins: Great strength, and great volume. Victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: Great volume. Little victory.

Bruno.greeting: Pryce! An elder of battle. I'll match your patience with power!
Bruno.trainerWins: Patience and power, unbeatable!

Pryce.greeting: Bruno. You remind me of my younger days. Hot-headed, and strong.
Pryce.trainerWins: Hot-headed and strong, and victorious.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Hot-headed, and humbled.

Bruno.greeting: Sabrina! Mind and muscle, together at last!
Bruno.trainerWins: Mind and muscle, victorious!

Sabrina.greeting: Bruno. I sense your next move: something very loud.
Sabrina.trainerWins: Something very loud: our victory.

Bruno.greeting: Whitney! No tears today, win or lose! Fight hard!
Bruno.trainerWins: No tears, and a win! Well fought!
Bruno.trainerLoses: No tears now! Fight harder next time!

Whitney.greeting: Bruno, you're so strong! Don't let me lose, okay?
Whitney.trainerWins: Bruno didn't let me lose! Yay!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Bruno let me lose! Waah!

Bruno.greeting: Will! The Johto Elite Four stands together!
Bruno.trainerWins: The Johto Elite Four stands! Hoo hah!

Will.greeting: Bruno, try to be subtle. Just this once.

Agatha.greeting: Acerola! A young lady who loves spooky things. You remind me of myself, long ago.
Agatha.trainerWins: You remind me of myself, and we won. Good girl.
Agatha.trainerLoses: Losing reminds me of my youth, too. Hah!

Acerola.greeting: Agatha! A grandma who loves ghosts! Can I call you Granny? Hee hee!
Acerola.trainerWins: Granny Agatha and me, the spookiest win!
Acerola.trainerLoses: Granny Agatha, we lost! Hee hee... ugh.

Agatha.greeting: Blaine, you old coot! Still asking riddles at your age?
Agatha.trainerWins: Still asking riddles, and still winning!
Agatha.trainerLoses: The riddle's on us today, old coot.

Blaine.greeting: Agatha! Riddle me this: which of us is older? Hah! Better not answer!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Riddle answered: we won!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Riddle unsolved! We lost!

Agatha.greeting: Brock, dear boy. Stand still and let my ghosts do the work.
Agatha.trainerWins: You stood still, and my ghosts did the work.
Agatha.trainerLoses: You stood still... too still, dear boy.

Brock.greeting: Agatha, ma'am! I'll keep you safe out there!
Brock.trainerWins: You were safe out there, ma'am! We won!
Brock.trainerLoses: I couldn't keep you safe, ma'am... we lost.

Agatha.greeting: Erika, you look half asleep. My ghosts will wake you up!
Agatha.trainerWins: Woke you up, didn't they? A win!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Even my ghosts couldn't wake you, dear.

Erika.greeting: Agatha, your ghosts are rather charming in their own way.
Erika.trainerWins: Charming ghosts, and a charming win.
Erika.trainerLoses: Charming, but not enough. Oh dear.

Agatha.greeting: Fantina, you dance with your ghosts. I just scare people with mine!
Agatha.trainerWins: You dance, I scare. It worked!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Dancing didn't save us. Neither did scaring.

Fantina.greeting: Agatha! Ze ghosts, zey adore you! Come, let us dance!
Fantina.trainerWins: Magnifique! We danced to victory!
Fantina.trainerLoses: The dance has ended, Agatha. Hélas!

Agatha.greeting: Giovanni. I've outlived plenty of crooks. Behave yourself.
Agatha.trainerWins: You behaved. And we won. Good.
Agatha.trainerLoses: You behaved. We still lost. Hah!

Giovanni.greeting: Agatha. Even I respect that much experience.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Experience prevails. Respected.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Even experience fails. Disappointing.

Agatha.greeting: Janine, your father was quite the rascal in his day.
Agatha.trainerWins: Sneaky and victorious, just like your father!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Your father would've gotten away with it.

Janine.greeting: Agatha! Ghosts and ninjas, both sneaky! We'll be perfect together!
Janine.trainerWins: Sneaky ghosts AND ninjas! Perfect!
Janine.trainerLoses: Even sneaky wasn't enough!

Agatha.greeting: Koga, you old sneak. Still hiding behind smoke?
Agatha.trainerWins: Hiding behind smoke works. Still.
Agatha.trainerLoses: Your smoke blew back in our faces, Koga.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Agatha, mistress of shadows. We are kindred spirits!

Agatha.greeting: Lance, still flying around in that cape, I see.
Agatha.trainerWins: Still flying, and still winning. Good.
Agatha.trainerLoses: Even capes can't catch every fall.

Lance.greeting: Agatha, it's an honor to stand beside you again.
Lance.trainerWins: An honor to win beside you, Agatha.

Agatha.greeting: Surge, my ghosts don't scare easy. Neither do I.
Agatha.trainerWins: My ghosts didn't scare. Neither did we!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Scared off for once. Hah!

Lt. Surge.greeting: Agatha! You're tougher than any soldier I ever served with!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Tougher than any soldier! We won!

Agatha.greeting: Misty dear, don't be frightened of my ghosts.
Agatha.trainerWins: Not frightened after all, eh, dear? We won!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Frightened into a loss, I see.

Misty.greeting: Agatha! Your ghosts are creepy... in a good way, I think!
Misty.trainerWins: Creepy in a good way! We won!
Misty.trainerLoses: Creepy in a bad way! We lost!

Agatha.greeting: Morty, the seer of Ecruteak. You see the ghosts too, don't you?
Agatha.trainerWins: The ghosts watched us win. Didn't they?
Agatha.trainerLoses: The ghosts are laughing at us, Morty.

Morty.greeting: Agatha... the spirits around you are ancient and powerful.
Morty.trainerWins: Ancient spirits, and a fresh victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: The ancient spirits are silent tonight.

Agatha.greeting: Phoebe, Mt. Pyre's ghost girl. Show this old lady your bond.
Agatha.trainerWins: Show this old lady your bond, she said. You did!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Your bond's strong, girl. Ours fell short.

Phoebe.greeting: Agatha! A ghost master from Kanto! The spirits are so excited!
Phoebe.trainerWins: The spirits are cheering! We won!
Phoebe.trainerLoses: The spirits are sad... we lost.

Agatha.greeting: Sabrina, your mind tricks against my ghosts. Who's spookier, eh?
Agatha.trainerWins: Spookier together. We won.
Agatha.trainerLoses: Spooked ourselves, I'd say.

Sabrina.greeting: Agatha. Our powers have always been at odds. Not today.
Sabrina.trainerWins: At odds no more. A victory.

Agatha.greeting: Shauntal, are you writing about me? Make me sound scarier.
Agatha.trainerWins: Make me sound scary in the victory chapter!
Agatha.trainerLoses: Leave this part out of your book, dear.

Shauntal.greeting: Agatha! A ghost master from Kanto! My next chapter is writing itself!
Shauntal.trainerWins: The chapter wrote itself: victory!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The chapter ends in tragedy!

Lance.greeting: Alder, Unova's free-spirited Champion. Let's show them two Champions at once.
Lance.trainerWins: Two Champions, one victory. A fine day.

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Lance, the dragon master! Two Champions, one wild battle!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! One wild win!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! One wild loss!

Lance.greeting: Blaine, keep the flames high. My dragons love the heat.
Lance.trainerWins: The flames stayed high. My dragons approve.
Lance.trainerLoses: The flames died down too soon.

Blaine.greeting: Lance! Quiz: what do dragons and volcanoes have in common? Fire! Let's win!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Fire! The answer and the victory!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! Wrong answer! We lost!

Lance.greeting: Brock, your steadiness gives my dragons room to fly.
Lance.trainerWins: Your steadiness let my dragons fly. Thank you.
Lance.trainerLoses: The line held, but my dragons fell.

Brock.greeting: Lance, the Champion himself! I'll hold the line!
Brock.trainerWins: I held the line for the Champion!
Brock.trainerLoses: I couldn't hold it, Lance. Sorry.

Lance.greeting: Bugsy, your research is impressive. Let's add some field data.
Lance.trainerWins: Field data collected: victory.

Bugsy.greeting: Lance! I've always wanted to study how you battle up close!
Bugsy.trainerWins: I studied the Champion up close, and we won!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: I studied up close... how we lost.

Lance.greeting: Chuck, your strength is matched only by your enthusiasm.
Lance.trainerWins: Strength and enthusiasm, victorious.

Chuck.greeting: Lance! WAHAHAH! Let's crush them together!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Crushed together!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! We got crushed!

Lance.greeting: Clair, cousin. Let's show them what Blackthorn's dragon clan can do.
Lance.trainerWins: Blackthorn's clan, unbeaten. Well done, Clair.

Clair.greeting: Lance. Don't you dare outshine me. We do this as equals.
Clair.trainerWins: As equals, and victors. Don't forget it, Lance.
Clair.trainerLoses: As equals, and defeated. Hmph.

Lance.greeting: Cynthia, Sinnoh's Champion. It's a privilege to battle beside you.
Lance.trainerWins: A privilege, and a win. Thank you, Cynthia.

Cynthia.greeting: Lance. Two Champions together. Our opponent is in for a long day.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A long day for our opponent indeed.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: A long day for us, it turns out.

Lance.greeting: Diantha, I've seen your films. Let's give them a real show.
Lance.trainerWins: A real show, and a real win.

Diantha.greeting: Lance, the dragon master! What a co-star. Shall we?
Diantha.trainerWins: What a co-star! And what a finale!
Diantha.trainerLoses: The finale didn't play out as written.

Lance.greeting: Drake, a dragon tamer from Hoenn. Let's see whose dragons roar louder.
Lance.trainerWins: My dragons roared loudest, together with yours.

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Lance! Two dragon masters in one battle! Glorious!

Lance.greeting: Drasna, your gentle way with dragons is admirable.
Lance.trainerWins: Gentle and victorious. Admirable.
Lance.trainerLoses: Even gentleness can't win every battle.

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Lance! The famous dragon master! What a treat!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh my. That treat turned sour.

Lance.greeting: Drayden, the dragon master of Opelucid. An honor.
Lance.trainerWins: An honor and a victory.
Lance.trainerLoses: Unova's dragon master beside me, and still we fell.

Drayden.greeting: Lance. Your name flies far. Let us see the dragons behind it.
Drayden.trainerWins: The dragons behind the name, proven.
Drayden.trainerLoses: The dragons fell short today.

Lance.greeting: Erika, your calm balances my dragons' fury.
Lance.trainerWins: Calm and fury, balanced. Victory.

Erika.greeting: Lance... please keep your dragons away from the flower beds.
Erika.trainerWins: The flower beds survived, and so did we.
Erika.trainerLoses: The flower beds are fine. We are not.

Lance.greeting: Falkner, take to the skies. My dragons will follow.
Lance.trainerWins: Skies and dragons, ours. Well flown.

Falkner.greeting: Lance! Flying beside dragons is a dream come true!
Falkner.trainerWins: A dream come true! We won!
Falkner.trainerLoses: A dream with a bad ending...

Lance.greeting: Giovanni. I've broken up your organization before. Don't make me regret this.
Lance.trainerWins: No regrets. Today.

Giovanni.greeting: Lance. Let's settle our differences on the opponent instead.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Differences settled, on the opponent.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Differences remain, and so does the loss.

Lance.greeting: Iris, Unova's young Champion. Your dragons have such spirit.
Lance.trainerWins: Such spirit, and such a win!
Lance.trainerLoses: Spirit isn't enough every time, Iris.

Iris.greeting: Lance! You're like a dragon superhero! Let's win together!
Iris.trainerWins: Dragon superhero wins! Yay!

Lance.greeting: Janine, your father would be proud to see you here.
Lance.trainerWins: Your father would be proud. I am.
Lance.trainerLoses: Your father would still be proud.

Janine.greeting: Lance! Father says you're the toughest Champion there is!
Janine.trainerWins: The toughest Champion wins! Father was right!
Janine.trainerLoses: We lost... Father won't believe it.

Lance.greeting: Jasmine, your steel and my dragons. A sturdy pair.
Lance.trainerWins: A sturdy pair, and a sturdy win.

Jasmine.greeting: Lance... I'll do my best not to slow you down.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I didn't slow you down! We won!
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I slowed us down... I'm sorry, Lance.

Lance.greeting: Karen, the Johto Elite Four at full strength.
Lance.trainerWins: The Johto Elite Four, at full strength and victorious.

Karen.greeting: Lance. Don't hog the spotlight, Champion.
Karen.trainerWins: You shared the spotlight. Good. We won.
Karen.trainerLoses: You hogged it, and we lost. Hmph.

Lance.greeting: Koga, a ninja beside the Champion. Strike true.
Lance.trainerWins: You struck true. Well done.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Lance! Let us show them the might of the Plateau!

Lance.greeting: Surge, let's coordinate. Dragons in the air, thunder on the ground.
Lance.trainerWins: Coordination complete. Victory.

Lt. Surge.greeting: Roger that, Lance! Air support and thunder, coming right up!
Lt. Surge.trainerWins: Air support and thunder, mission accomplished!

Lance.greeting: Misty, keep the waters rough. My dragons thrive in a storm.
Lance.trainerWins: The storm favored my dragons. Thank you, Misty.

Misty.greeting: Lance! I'll make the waves, you make them roar!
Misty.trainerWins: Waves and roars, victory!
Misty.trainerLoses: The waves went flat!

Lance.greeting: Morty, what do your visions say about this battle?
Lance.trainerWins: Your visions were right.

Morty.greeting: Lance... I see dragons soaring to victory.
Morty.trainerWins: Dragons soared to victory, as I saw.
Morty.trainerLoses: The vision changed. Dragons grounded.

Lance.greeting: Pryce, ice and dragons rarely mix. Let's prove that wrong.
Lance.trainerWins: Ice and dragons mixed well after all.

Pryce.greeting: Lance. Mind the cold, young dragon master.
Pryce.trainerWins: You minded the cold. Good. A win.
Pryce.trainerLoses: The cold got to us both.

Lance.greeting: Sabrina, your foresight and my dragons. A formidable combination.
Lance.trainerWins: A formidable combination, proven.

Sabrina.greeting: Lance. I already know how this ends. You'll like it.
Sabrina.trainerWins: You liked it, didn't you? Victory.
Sabrina.trainerLoses: I didn't see this coming. Truly.

Lance.greeting: Steven, Hoenn's stone-loving Champion. Let's make this battle shine.
Lance.trainerWins: This battle shone. Well done, Steven.

Steven.greeting: Lance, it's an honor. Your dragons are rarer than any stone I've found.
Steven.trainerWins: Rarer than any stone: a win beside Lance.

Lance.greeting: Wallace, your elegance meets my power. Interesting.
Lance.trainerWins: Elegance and power. Interesting, and victorious.

Wallace.greeting: Lance! A dragon master's might paired with my grace. Exquisite!
Wallace.trainerWins: Exquisite! A triumph of grace and might!

Lance.greeting: Whitney, keep your spirits up. We'll win this together.
Lance.trainerWins: Spirits up, and a win. Well done, Whitney.
Lance.trainerLoses: Chin up, Whitney. We'll win next time.

Whitney.greeting: Lance! You're so cool! I won't cry, I promise!
Whitney.trainerWins: Lance won with me! And I didn't cry!
Whitney.trainerLoses: I promised not to cry... Waah!

Lance.greeting: Will, focus your mind. My dragons will clear the way.
Lance.trainerWins: The way was cleared. Thank you, Will.
Lance.trainerLoses: My dragons couldn't clear it today.

Will.greeting: Lance, our Champion. I'll follow your lead... gracefully.
Anabel, the Salon Maiden. Our minds should be in perfect sync.

Anabel.greeting: Will. I can feel your focus. Let's read our opponent together.
Anabel.trainerWins: We read them right. A fine win, Will.
Anabel.trainerLoses: We read them wrong. Forgive me.

Will.greeting: Bugsy, your analytical mind would make a fine psychic.
Will.trainerWins: A fine psychic mind, and a fine win.
Will.trainerLoses: Your analysis failed us, Bugsy. As did my focus.

Bugsy.greeting: Will! I'd love to study how that mask affects your focus!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Data on the mask: it works! We won!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Data on the mask: it didn't help!

Will.greeting: Caitlin, a lady of elegance and mind. Shall we perform?

Caitlin.greeting: Will. Your mask is rather theatrical. I approve.

Will.greeting: Chuck, please try to think before you punch.

Chuck.greeting: Will! Thinking is overrated! WAHAHAH!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Thinking IS overrated! We won!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Maybe I should've thought!

Will.greeting: Clair, your pride is formidable. Let's aim it at our foes.

Clair.greeting: Will. Don't slow me down with your poses.
Clair.trainerWins: No poses slowed me down. Good.
Clair.trainerLoses: The poses slowed us. Clearly.

Will.greeting: Dexio, a student of the mind. Let's show them true focus.
Will.trainerWins: True focus, shown. Well done, Dexio.

Dexio.greeting: Will of the Elite Four! I've studied your psychic techniques for years!
Dexio.trainerWins: Years of study paid off beside Will himself!
Dexio.trainerLoses: I studied for years... and still lost.

Will.greeting: Falkner, soar high. My mind will guide your path.
Will.trainerWins: My mind guided your path to victory.

Falkner.greeting: Will, your psychic power and my birds. Let's take to the sky!
Falkner.trainerWins: Psychic power and birds, soaring!
Falkner.trainerLoses: Grounded, even with psychic help!

Will.greeting: Jasmine, your quiet strength steadies the mind.

Jasmine.greeting: Will... your mask is a little scary. But I trust you.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I trusted you, Will... and we won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Will. I couldn't help enough.

Will.greeting: Karen, the Johto Elite Four united. Let's be elegant about it.

Karen.greeting: Will. Less posing, more battling.
Karen.trainerWins: Less posing worked. We won.
Karen.trainerLoses: More posing, more losing. Told you.

Will.greeting: Koga, a ninja's patience and my focus. Perfect harmony.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Will! Strike from the mind, strike from the shadows!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! Mind and shadow struck true!

Will.greeting: Lucian, a fellow scholar of the mind. Shall we study our opponent?

Lucian.greeting: Will. I'll mark my page and give you my full attention.
Lucian.trainerWins: I'll mark this page: victory.
Lucian.trainerLoses: I'll mark this page too. A sad chapter.

Will.greeting: Morty, a seer and a psychic. Our opponent can hide nothing.
Will.trainerWins: Nothing hidden, nothing lost. A win.

Morty.greeting: Will. I see your mask... and the focus behind it.
Morty.trainerWins: The focus behind the mask won us this.
Morty.trainerLoses: The mask couldn't hide that defeat.

Will.greeting: Pryce, your patience is the mark of a true master.
Will.trainerLoses: Even masters fall, now and then.

Pryce.greeting: Will. Your mind is sharp. Keep it cool.
Pryce.trainerWins: Sharp and cool. A fine win.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Sharp, but not cool enough today.

Will.greeting: Sabrina, the strongest mind in Kanto. Let's combine our power.

Sabrina.greeting: Will. I foresaw you'd say that. Let's begin.
Sabrina.trainerWins: As foreseen. Well done, Will.

Will.greeting: Whitney, stay calm. A calm mind wins battles.
Will.trainerWins: A calm mind won. Well done, Whitney.
Will.trainerLoses: A calm mind lost. Rare, but it happens.

Whitney.greeting: Will, you're kinda creepy... but cool! Let's win!
Whitney.trainerWins: Creepy and cool AND we won!
Whitney.trainerLoses: Creepy, cool, and we lost! Waah!

Koga.greeting: Blaine! Two old Kanto Gym Leaders! Let us burn and poison!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha... we went up in smoke.

Blaine.greeting: Koga! Ninja quiz: what vanishes in a puff of smoke? Our opponents! Hah!
Blaine.trainerWins: Hah! Vanished in a puff of smoke! Correct!
Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! WE vanished in smoke!

Koga.greeting: Brock, the rock of Pewter. Hold firm while I strike!
Koga.trainerWins: The rock held, my strike landed.
Koga.trainerLoses: The rock held, but my strike missed.

Brock.greeting: Koga! I'll be your shield. You handle the sneaky stuff!
Brock.trainerWins: I shielded, you snuck! We won!
Brock.trainerLoses: I shielded, but it wasn't enough.

Koga.greeting: Bugsy, your insects and my poison. A deadly pairing.

Bugsy.greeting: Koga! Did you know some insects are natural ninjas? Fascinating!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Natural ninjas, victorious! Fascinating!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Natural ninjas, defeated! Still fascinating!

Koga.greeting: Chuck, your fists are loud. My strikes are silent. Together, unstoppable.

Chuck.greeting: Koga! A real ninja! I've always wanted to train with one!
Chuck.trainerWins: I trained with a real ninja, and we won!
Chuck.trainerLoses: Even a ninja couldn't save us! WAHAHAH!

Koga.greeting: Clair, let my poison wear them down for your dragons.
Koga.trainerWins: Worn down, then finished. As planned.

Clair.greeting: Koga. Do your ninja tricks. I'll finish them off.
Clair.trainerWins: Your tricks worked. Fine. I finished them.
Clair.trainerLoses: Your tricks failed. So did my dragons.

Koga.greeting: Erika, poison and flowers. Nature's most dangerous combination.

Erika.greeting: Koga... I do hope your poison won't wilt my flowers.
Erika.trainerWins: My flowers survived, and we won. How nice.
Erika.trainerLoses: My flowers wilted... and so did we.

Koga.greeting: Falkner, strike from above. I strike from the shadows.
Koga.trainerWins: From above and from the shadows! Victory!
Koga.trainerLoses: Neither shadow nor sky could save us.

Falkner.greeting: Koga! Your stealth and my speed. They won't see us coming!
Falkner.trainerWins: They never saw us coming!
Falkner.trainerLoses: They saw us coming...

Koga.greeting: Giovanni. Two Kanto Gym Leaders with... complicated pasts.

Giovanni.greeting: Koga. Your ninja skills would have served me well, once.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Your skills served well. Once more.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Your skills failed me. Once more.

Koga.greeting: Janine, my daughter! Show your father how much you've grown!
Koga.trainerWins: You've grown so much, Janine! A fine win!
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha... even I couldn't carry us today. We train together tomorrow.
