Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Two loud old men, quieted!

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Drake! Let's shake things up!

Drake.greeting: Winona! Birds and dragons rule the sky!

Winona.greeting: Drake, your dragons fly with real power. Let's soar together.
Winona.trainerWins: We soared together. Well flown, Drake.

Steven.greeting: Alder, Unova's Champion. I hear you wander as much as I do.
Steven.trainerWins: Two wanderers, one win. Let's go rock hunting.
Steven.trainerLoses: We wandered right into a loss.

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Steven! A fellow wanderer! Find any good rocks lately?
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Found a good rock: victory!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Tripped over a rock, it seems!

Steven.greeting: Anabel, I've heard about your talents at the Battle Frontier. Impressive.
Steven.trainerWins: A rare victory, indeed. Thank you, Anabel.

Anabel.greeting: Steven. I sense your love for rare things. Let's add a rare victory.
Anabel.trainerWins: The rare victory, added.

Steven.greeting: Brawly, Dewford has some of the best caves for stone hunting.
Steven.trainerWins: Let's go stone hunting in Dewford to celebrate.
Steven.trainerLoses: Even Granite Cave couldn't save us.

Brawly.greeting: Steven! You found rocks in Granite Cave, right? Let's rock this battle!
Brawly.trainerWins: Rocked this battle!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Got rocked instead!

Steven.greeting: Byron, a man who knows his steel and stone. A pleasure.
Steven.trainerWins: A pleasure, and a win.

Byron.greeting: Steven! Gahaha! A fellow steel lover! Let's dig in!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahaha! Dug in and won!

Steven.greeting: Colress, your scientific mind would appreciate my stone collection.
Steven.trainerWins: Fascinating, and victorious. My collection awaits you.

Colress.greeting: Steven. Steel, science, and stones. A fascinating combination.
Colress.trainerLoses: A fascinating failure!

Steven.greeting: Cynthia, a Champion who studies myths. Shall we make one?
Steven.trainerWins: A myth made. Well done, Cynthia.
Steven.trainerLoses: Not every myth has a happy ending.

Cynthia.greeting: Steven. I hear you collect rare stones. I collect rare battles.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A rare battle, collected.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: This one won't go in my collection.

Steven.greeting: Diantha, Kalos's Champion. Your screen presence is quite something.
Steven.trainerWins: Quite a performance, and quite a win.

Diantha.greeting: Steven, the Hoenn Champion. Let's give them a performance to remember.
Diantha.trainerWins: A performance to remember! Bravo!
Diantha.trainerLoses: A performance best forgotten.

Steven.greeting: Flannery, Lavaridge's hot springs are lovely. Let's bring that heat.
Steven.trainerWins: The heat was brought. Thank you, Flannery.

Flannery.greeting: Steven! Let's turn up the heat on these two!
Flannery.trainerWins: Turned up the heat! We won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: We got burned!

Steven.greeting: Iris, the young Champion of Unova. Your energy is remarkable.
Steven.trainerWins: Super Champions indeed! Well done, Iris.

Iris.greeting: Steven! You're a Champion too? Let's be super Champions together!
Iris.trainerWins: Super Champions win! Yay!

Steven.greeting: Jasmine, your steel has a quiet strength. I appreciate that.
Steven.trainerWins: Quiet strength, polished victory.

Jasmine.greeting: Steven... um, your steel is so polished. Let's do our best.
Jasmine.trainerWins: We did our best... and we won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We did our best... and we lost.

Steven.greeting: Juan, Sootopolis's master. Wallace speaks so highly of you.
Steven.trainerWins: Wallace's teacher, my partner. A fine win.
Steven.trainerLoses: Wallace will hear about this, I'm sure.

Juan.greeting: Steven. My former student has excellent taste in friends.
Juan.trainerWins: Excellent taste in friends, and in victory.
Juan.trainerLoses: Excellent taste, poor result.

Steven.greeting: Molayne, a fellow steel enthusiast from Alola. Let's see your steel shine.
Steven.trainerWins: Your steel shone brightly, Molayne.

Molayne.greeting: Steven! Your reputation reaches all the way to Hokulani. Let's do this.

Steven.greeting: Norman, Petalburg's Gym Leader. Let's show them Hoenn's strength.
Steven.trainerWins: Hoenn's strength, shown. Well done, Norman.

Norman.greeting: Steven. A Champion beside me. I'll do my best.
Norman.trainerWins: I did my best, and we won. Thank you, Steven.
Norman.trainerLoses: I did my best. It wasn't enough.

Steven.greeting: Roxanne, Rustboro is close to my father's company. We're practically neighbors.
Steven.trainerWins: Neighbors and winners. Well done, Roxanne.

Roxanne.greeting: Steven! I've read so much about your stone research!
Roxanne.trainerWins: I studied his research, and we won!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: My studies didn't cover this loss!

Steven.greeting: Wallace, my friend. It's been too long since we battled side by side.
Steven.trainerWins: Side by side again, and victorious.
Steven.trainerLoses: Side by side again, and defeated.

Wallace.greeting: Steven! My dear friend! Let us make this battle as dazzling as your stones.
Wallace.trainerWins: As dazzling as your stones, Steven! Bravo!
Wallace.trainerLoses: Our dazzle has dimmed, dear friend.

Steven.greeting: Wally, you've grown into a fine trainer. Let's see how far you've come.
Steven.trainerWins: You've come far, Wally. Very far.

Wally.greeting: Steven! I'll show you how strong I've become!
Wally.trainerWins: I showed you how strong I've become!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'll show you next time, Steven...

Steven.greeting: Wattson, Mauville's power keeps Hoenn running. Let's power up.
Steven.trainerWins: Powered up, and victorious.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Steven! Let's shock them with some steel!

Steven.greeting: Wikstrom, a knight of steel. A fine companion for a stone collector.
Steven.trainerWins: An unbreakable wall, as promised.

Wikstrom.greeting: Well met, Steven! Your steel and mine shall form an unbreakable wall!

Steven.greeting: Winona, Fortree's skies are beautiful. Let's take them.
Steven.trainerWins: Fortree's skies, taken. Well flown.

Winona.greeting: Steven, Fortree's skies welcome you. Let's soar to victory together.
Winona.trainerLoses: Even the sky turned against us.

Wallace.greeting: Alder, your free spirit is quite refreshing. Let's make it beautiful.

Alder.greeting: Ha ha! Wallace! Fancy clothes, strong battles! I like it!
Alder.trainerWins: Ha ha! Fancy clothes, strong win!
Alder.trainerLoses: Ha ha! Fancy clothes, big loss!

Wallace.greeting: Anabel, your poise is admirable. Let's create something elegant.

Anabel.greeting: Wallace. I can sense your grace. Let's begin.
Anabel.trainerWins: Grace, and a win. Thank you.

Wallace.greeting: Brawly, the waves and you are one. Let's ride them together.

Brawly.greeting: Wallace! Water buddies! Let's make a splash!
Brawly.trainerWins: Water buddies win!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Water buddies, wiped out!

Wallace.greeting: Crasher Wake, your water is a torrent. Mine is a stream. Let's flood them.

Crasher Wake.greeting: Wallace! The water master of Hoenn! Let's make a tidal wave!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Tidal wave of victory!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Tidal wave of defeat!

Wallace.greeting: Cress, a gentleman of water. How refined.

Cress.greeting: Wallace. Your water is as elegant as my tea service. Let's begin.
Cress.trainerWins: As elegant as tea, and as satisfying.

Wallace.greeting: Cynthia, two Champions together. Let's make it a masterpiece.

Cynthia.greeting: Wallace. Your elegance is legendary. Let's show them.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Legendary elegance, and a legendary win.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Even legends fall.

Wallace.greeting: Diantha, a film star and a contest star. Let's dazzle them.

Diantha.greeting: Wallace! Your style is impeccable. Let's give them a show!
Diantha.trainerWins: What a show! Impeccable!
Diantha.trainerLoses: The show closed early.

Wallace.greeting: Flannery, your fire and my water. Opposites, yet elegant.

Flannery.greeting: Wallace! Fire and water? We'll steam them like Lavaridge's springs!
Flannery.trainerWins: Steamed them like the springs!
Flannery.trainerLoses: Got steamed ourselves!

Wallace.greeting: Iris, a young Champion. Your energy is so bright.

Iris.greeting: Wallace! You're so sparkly! Let's win together!
Iris.trainerWins: Sparkly win! Yay!

Wallace.greeting: Master Juan, it's an honor to battle beside my teacher.
Wallace.trainerLoses: Forgive me, master. We fell short.

Juan.greeting: Wallace, my former student. Let us show them what true elegance means.
Juan.trainerWins: Ahh, my student shines! Bravo!
Juan.trainerLoses: Ahh, even my student falters.

Wallace.greeting: Marlon, the sea's free spirit. Let's make waves together.

Marlon.greeting: Yo, Wallace! Water buddies! Let's crash this battle!
Marlon.trainerWins: Crashed this battle, buddy!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Got crashed, buddy.

Wallace.greeting: Misty, a fellow water master. Let's show them how it's done.

Misty.greeting: Wallace! Your water is so beautiful! Let's do this!
Misty.trainerWins: Beautiful water, beautiful win!
Misty.trainerLoses: Beautiful water, sad loss!

Wallace.greeting: Norman, your strength and my grace. A fine pairing.

Norman.greeting: Wallace. Let's show them Hoenn's strength.
Norman.trainerWins: Hoenn's strength, shown. Well done.
Norman.trainerLoses: Not enough strength today.

Wallace.greeting: Roxanne, your intellect and my elegance. Let's begin.

Roxanne.greeting: Wallace. I've studied your contest techniques. Fascinating.
Roxanne.trainerWins: My study of contest techniques, confirmed!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: My study missed something important.

Wallace.greeting: Siebold, a chef and an artist. Your water must be exquisite.

Siebold.greeting: Wallace. A fellow aesthete. Let us create a masterpiece in water.

Wallace.greeting: Wally, I'm so proud of how far you've come.
Wallace.trainerWins: So proud of you, Wally. We won!

Wally.greeting: Wallace! You were Champion once! I'll make you proud!
Wally.trainerWins: I made Wallace proud! I did it!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'll make you proud next time, Wallace...

Wallace.greeting: Wattson, your energy is contagious. Let's make it beautiful.
Wallace.trainerLoses: Shocking, and not in a good way.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Wallace! Let's shock them with style!

Wallace.greeting: Winona, your birds and my water. Let's paint the sky.

Winona.greeting: Wallace, let's create a beautiful battle together.
Winona.trainerWins: A beautiful battle, and a win.
Winona.trainerLoses: A beautiful battle, and a loss.

Aaron.greeting: Bertha! The Sinnoh Elite Four's grandma! I'll protect you, I promise!
Aaron.trainerWins: I protected Grandma! We won!
Aaron.trainerLoses: I couldn't protect you, Bertha... I'm sorry!

Bertha.greeting: Aaron, dear, you and your little bugs are so full of life. Grandma's proud.
Bertha.trainerWins: Grandma's proud, dear. Very proud.
Bertha.trainerLoses: Grandma's still proud, dear. Always.

Aaron.greeting: Bugsy! A fellow bug lover! Let's prove bugs are the best!
Aaron.trainerWins: Bugs ARE the best! Proven!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Bugs are still the best! Just not today!

Bugsy.greeting: Aaron! I've read your notes on bug training. Let's gather some field data together!
Bugsy.trainerWins: Field data: victory! Fascinating!
Bugsy.trainerLoses: Field data: defeat. Still fascinating!

Aaron.greeting: Burgh! You paint bugs, I battle with them! Both are beautiful!
Aaron.trainerWins: Both beautiful AND victorious!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Beautiful, but beaten.

Burgh.greeting: Aaron! Your passion is the perfect color for my next canvas. Let's paint a win!
Burgh.trainerWins: A winning canvas! Inspiring!
Burgh.trainerLoses: The canvas cracked!

Aaron.greeting: Byron! Bugs can be tough as steel, you know! Watch!
Aaron.trainerWins: Tough as steel! Told you!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Not tough enough today...

Byron.greeting: Gahaha! Aaron! Show me those little critters can hold their own!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahaha! The critters held their own!

Aaron.greeting: Candice! My bugs hate the cold, so please aim your ice at them, not us!
Aaron.trainerWins: Ice aimed right, and we won! Thanks, Candice!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Ice everywhere... my bugs are freezing!

Candice.greeting: Aaron! Bugs AND focus? You've got the right idea! Let's go!
Candice.trainerLoses: Focus lost, bugs frozen!

Aaron.greeting: Crasher Wake! Your splashing makes my bugs nervous!
Aaron.trainerWins: My bugs weren't splashed, and we won!
Aaron.trainerLoses: My bugs got splashed... we lost!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Wahahah! Aaron! Don't worry, little buddy, I only splash the bad guys!

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Splashed ourselves!

Aaron.greeting: Cynthia! It's an honor to battle beside our Champion!
Aaron.trainerWins: I battled beside our Champion and won!
Aaron.trainerLoses: I let the Champion down...

Cynthia.greeting: Aaron. You've never once doubted your bugs. That's why you're strong.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Never doubted them, and they never doubted you.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Don't doubt them now, Aaron.

Aaron.greeting: Fantina! I've seen bugs dance in the moonlight. You'd love it!
Aaron.trainerWins: Now I'll show you bugs dancing in the moonlight!
Aaron.trainerLoses: No moonlight dance tonight...

Fantina.greeting: Aaron! Ze bugs, zey dance? Magnifique! Show me after we win!
Fantina.trainerWins: Magnifique! Show me ze dancing bugs!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Non, ze bugs will dance another night.

Aaron.greeting: Flint! Just don't burn my bugs, okay? They're very important!
Aaron.trainerWins: No burnt bugs, and a win!
Aaron.trainerLoses: A few singed wings... and a loss!

Flint.greeting: Aaron! Ha! I'll aim the fire away from your buddies, promise!
Flint.trainerWins: Ha! Fire aimed away, victory aimed true!
Flint.trainerLoses: Ha! My aim was off today!

Aaron.greeting: Gardenia! Bugs and plants go together perfectly!
Aaron.trainerWins: Bugs and plants, a perfect win!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Bugs and plants, trampled!

Gardenia.greeting: Aaron! My plants and your bugs, a whole little forest! Let's grow a win!
Gardenia.trainerWins: A whole forest of victory!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: Our little forest got cut down!

Aaron.greeting: Guzma! You like bugs too? Then you can't be all bad!
Aaron.trainerWins: See? You're not all bad! We won!
Aaron.trainerLoses: We lost... but you're still not all bad!

Guzma.greeting: Aaron, huh? A kid who actually gets bugs. Fine. Let's smash 'em together.

Aaron.greeting: Lucian! Can you put the book down for this one? Please?
Aaron.trainerWins: You put the book down, and we won!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Maybe the book would have helped...

Lucian.greeting: Aaron. I'll read up on bugs later. For now, you have my attention.

Aaron.greeting: Maylene! Bugs are small but strong, just like you!
Aaron.trainerWins: Small but strong, victorious!
Aaron.trainerLoses: Small, and not strong enough today.

Maylene.greeting: Aaron! You're right, size isn't everything! Let's hit them hard!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Size isn't everything... we still lost!

Aaron.greeting: Roark! I found the coolest beetles near your mine once!
Aaron.trainerWins: The beetles helped us win!
Aaron.trainerLoses: The beetles hid when we needed them!

Roark.greeting: Aaron! Bugs in my mine?! Ha, as long as they help us win!
Roark.trainerWins: Ha! Bugs in my mine, and a win!
Roark.trainerLoses: Bugs in my mine, and a loss. Ugh!

Aaron.greeting: Volkner! Come on, cheer up! Bugs never get bored, and neither should you!
Aaron.trainerWins: See? Bugs never get bored! We won!
Aaron.trainerLoses: You're bored again, aren't you? We lost.

Volkner.greeting: Aaron... your energy is a lot. Fine, I'll try to keep up.
Volkner.trainerWins: I kept up. And it wasn't boring.

Bertha.greeting: Byron, you old miner! Let's dig into this one together!
Bertha.trainerWins: Dug in, and won. Lovely, Byron.
Bertha.trainerLoses: Dug a hole for ourselves, dear.

Byron.greeting: Bertha! Gahaha! Two Sinnoh old-timers! Let's show the youngsters how it's done!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahaha! The youngsters were shown!

Bertha.greeting: Candice, dear, you're positively buzzing. Let's put that energy to work.
Bertha.trainerWins: All that buzzing put to good use, dear.
Bertha.trainerLoses: Too much buzzing, not enough battling.

Candice.greeting: Bertha! I'm so focused! Let's win this one for you, Grandma!
Candice.trainerLoses: Couldn't win for Grandma... sorry!

Bertha.greeting: Clay, a fellow lover of good, solid earth. Let's get our hands dirty!
Bertha.trainerWins: Got our hands dirty, and won!
Bertha.trainerLoses: Dirty hands, and nothing to show for it.

Clay.greeting: Bertha! A ground master from Sinnoh! Let's mine ourselves a victory!
Clay.trainerWins: Mined ourselves a victory!
Clay.trainerLoses: The mine collapsed on us!

Bertha.greeting: Crasher Wake, loud as ever! My old ears can still hear you from Pastoria!
Bertha.trainerWins: A muddy win! I heard it from here, dear!
Bertha.trainerLoses: A muddy loss, dear. Still loud!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Bertha! Wahahah! Sorry, Grandma! Let's make this a muddy win!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: Wahahah! Muddy victory, Grandma!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Mud in our faces!

Bertha.greeting: Cynthia, dear, it's so nice to battle beside our Champion for once.
Bertha.trainerWins: So nice, and so victorious, dear.
Bertha.trainerLoses: So nice, even in defeat.

Cynthia.greeting: Bertha. Your experience and my strategy. Our opponent doesn't stand a chance.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Experience and strategy, unbeaten.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Even experience and strategy can fail.

Bertha.greeting: Fantina, dear, your dancing is lovely. Shall we dance our way to a win?
Bertha.trainerWins: We danced to victory, dear!
Bertha.trainerLoses: The dance tripped us up, dear.

Fantina.greeting: Bertha! Ze lovely grandmother! Oui, we dance together!
Fantina.trainerWins: Oui! Victory, magnifique!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Non! The dance is over!

Bertha.greeting: Flint, keep that fire burning, dear, and mind your hair.
Bertha.trainerWins: Fire burning, hair intact. Lovely!
Bertha.trainerLoses: A little singed, dear. And beaten.

Flint.greeting: Bertha! You're the best grandma in the whole League! Let's go!
Flint.trainerWins: Best grandma in the League! We won!
Flint.trainerLoses: Even the best grandma loses sometimes!

Bertha.greeting: Gardenia, plants need good earth to grow. I'll provide it.
Bertha.trainerWins: Good earth, good growth, good win.
Bertha.trainerLoses: The soil was poor today.

Gardenia.greeting: Bertha! Your earth and my plants! We'll grow a victory!
Gardenia.trainerWins: Grew a victory! Thanks, Bertha!
Gardenia.trainerLoses: The victory didn't sprout!

Bertha.greeting: Giovanni. The earth doesn't care who you are. Neither do I.
Bertha.trainerWins: The earth didn't care. Neither did the challenger.
Bertha.trainerLoses: The earth stayed quiet, and so did our win.

Giovanni.greeting: Bertha. A master of the ground. I respect that much, at least.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Respect earned, and a victory.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Respect, but no victory.

Bertha.greeting: Lucian, put that book down and help Grandma out, would you?
Bertha.trainerWins: Bookmark well placed, dear. We won.
Bertha.trainerLoses: You should have kept reading, dear.

Lucian.greeting: Bertha. Very well. Bookmark in place, I'm all yours.

Bertha.greeting: Maylene, dear, don't you want some shoes? The sand's hot!

Bertha.trainerLoses: Get some shoes, dear. Please.

Maylene.greeting: Bertha! I fight better barefoot! Hot sand's just more training!
Maylene.trainerLoses: Barefoot and beaten...

Bertha.greeting: Roark, you've grown into such a fine young man. Your father must be proud.

Bertha.trainerLoses: Your father will understand, dear.

Roark.greeting: Bertha! Rocks and ground, like Oreburgh and the League! Let's go!
Roark.trainerWins: Rocks and ground, victorious!
Roark.trainerLoses: Rocks and ground, crumbled!

Bertha.greeting: Volkner, dear, cheer up! A battle with Grandma will do you good.
Bertha.trainerWins: See, dear? Grandma knows best.
Bertha.trainerLoses: Even Grandma can't fix everything.

Flint.greeting: Blaine! Fire buddies! Got a quiz about afros? Let's burn it up!

Blaine.greeting: Flint! Quiz: what's hotter than a volcano? Your hairdo! Hah!

Blaine.trainerLoses: Hah! The quiz answer was "us, losing"!

Flint.greeting: Byron! Fire melts steel! Just kidding, we're on the same side!

Byron.greeting: Gahaha! Flint! Let's forge a victory in your flames!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahaha! Forged in flames!

Flint.greeting: Candice! Fire and ice! Don't worry, I won't melt you!

Candice.greeting: Flint! Your fire's great, but focus is what wins! Let's go!

Chili.greeting: Flint! Your fire burns even hotter than my kitchen! Let's go!
Chili.trainerWins: Hotter than my kitchen! We won!

Flint.greeting: Crasher Wake! Fire and water! Full steam ahead!
Flint.trainerLoses: Steamed right out of the battle!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Wahahah! Flint! A steamy win coming right up!

Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: Wahahah! Steamy loss!

Flint.greeting: Cynthia! Let's show them Sinnoh's best, like the old days at the League!

Cynthia.greeting: Flint. Your fire never dims. Let's win this together.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Your fire never dimmed. A fine win.

Flint.greeting: Fantina! Fire and ghosts! Spooky hot!

Fantina.trainerLoses: Ze dance has burned out.

Flint.greeting: Flannery! Another fire lover! You've got real spark!

Flannery.trainerLoses: Cooled off completely!

Flint.greeting: Gardenia! Don't worry, I'll keep my fire away from your plants!

Gardenia.trainerLoses: My garden's fine. Our win isn't.

Flint.greeting: Kiawe! A fire dancer! Let's light up the whole island!

Kiawe.greeting: Flint! Your burning spirit could fuel a whole dance! Let's go!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: The dance ran out of fuel.

Flint.greeting: Lucian! Close the book and feel the heat!
Flint.trainerWins: Felt the heat, didn't you? We won!

Lucian.greeting: Flint. Very well. You've always been hard to ignore.

Flint.greeting: Malva! Two fire masters! Let's make headlines!

Flint.greeting: Maylene! Fire and fists, a knockout combo!

Maylene.greeting: Flint! Let's give them everything we've got!

Maylene.trainerLoses: Everything we had, and a loss!

Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh dear! Kalos and Unova dragons, both beaten!

Drayden.greeting: Drasna. Your gentle hand with dragons is rare. Let us battle.
Drayden.trainerWins: Your gentle hand guided us to victory.
Drayden.trainerLoses: Even gentle hands slip.

Drasna.greeting: Sina, dear! Your ice sparkles so beautifully! Let's win together!
Drasna.trainerWins: We won, Sina dear! Isn't that lovely?
Drasna.trainerLoses: We lost, dear. Still lovely, though!

Sina.greeting: Drasna! Your dragons look so friendly! Are they, though?
Sina.trainerWins: Your dragons ARE friendly! To us, anyway!
Sina.trainerLoses: Your dragons weren't friendly enough to them!

Diantha.greeting: Brycen! A fellow actor! I loved your films. Shall we share the stage?
Diantha.trainerWins: A final scene worth the applause.
Diantha.trainerLoses: A final scene. Curtains, sadly.

Brycen.greeting: Diantha. A true star of the screen. Let us give them a final scene.

Diantha.greeting: Cynthia, two Champions together. Let's make this a blockbuster.
Diantha.trainerWins: A blockbuster, indeed.
Diantha.trainerLoses: A box office flop, I'm afraid.

Cynthia.greeting: Diantha. Your poise is remarkable. Let's give them a show.
Cynthia.trainerWins: Quite a show, Diantha.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: The show didn't go as planned.

Diantha.greeting: Dexio! Professor Sycamore's assistant! Let's give them our best scene!
Diantha.trainerWins: Our best scene! You hit every cue!
Diantha.trainerLoses: We missed a few cues there, Dexio.

Dexio.greeting: Diantha! The Champion herself! I'll try not to miss my cue!
Dexio.trainerWins: I didn't miss my cue! We won!
Dexio.trainerLoses: I missed my cue... I'm sorry, Diantha!

Diantha.greeting: Sina! Your energy lights up the whole set! Let's shine together!
Diantha.trainerWins: We shined together!
Diantha.trainerLoses: Our light dimmed today.

Sina.greeting: Diantha! The Champion of Kalos! I'm your biggest fan!
Sina.trainerWins: My idol and I won! Eeee!
Sina.trainerLoses: My idol and I lost... still worth it!

Hala.greeting: Acerola! Ula'ula's little Captain! Hoh! Your spirit is as big as my belly!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! Big spirit, but a loss!

Acerola.greeting: Hala! You laugh so loud the ghosts at the old Megamart hide! Let's win!
Acerola.trainerWins: Even the Megamart ghosts heard us win!
Acerola.trainerLoses: The Megamart ghosts are laughing at us now...

Hala.greeting: Hoh! Brawly! A fighter who rides the waves! My grandson would love you!
Hala.trainerWins: Hoh! Gnarly, as you young ones say!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! Wiped out, as you young ones say!

Brawly.greeting: Hala! A Kahuna who fights with his fists? That's totally gnarly!
Brawly.trainerWins: Kahuna fists win, totally gnarly!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Even Kahuna fists wiped out!

Hala.greeting: Hoh! Chuck! I hear you train under waterfalls. Melemele has a few you'd like!
Hala.trainerWins: Hoh! Mighty punches! Melemele's waterfalls await!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! Back to the waterfalls for both of us!

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! Hala! Your laugh is as mighty as your punches!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Mighty as your laugh, Hala!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Not mighty enough!

Hala.greeting: Guzma, my boy. I always knew there was good in you. Show me today.
Hala.trainerWins: Hoh! I saw the good in you today, Guzma!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! The good was there, my boy. Just not the win.

Guzma.greeting: Hala. Don't start, old man. ...Fine. Let's win this.
Guzma.trainerWins: Don't get mushy, old man. ...We won.
Guzma.trainerLoses: Don't say it, old man. Yeah, we lost.

Hala.greeting: Kahili! Back from your tour abroad! Hoh! How was the competition?
Hala.trainerWins: Hoh! A hole in one, Kahili!

Kahili.greeting: Hala. Tough, but not as tough as a Kahuna. Let's play this hole together.

Hala.greeting: Kiawe! I've seen your fire dance at the festival. Bring that passion here! Hoh!
Hala.trainerWins: Hoh! Passion like a festival fire!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! The fire burned low today.

Kiawe.greeting: Kahuna Hala! I'll burn with everything I have beside you!

Hala.greeting: Kukui! The professor who gave Alola its League! Hoh! Let's honor it!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! Even the League's founder can lose!

Kukui.greeting: Hala! Woo! Battling beside the Kahuna who keeps the islands strong!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo... the islands will grow stronger from this!

Hala.greeting: Mallow! After this, I'm ordering everything at Aina's Kitchen! Hoh!
Hala.trainerWins: Hoh! Feast time at Aina's Kitchen!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! I'll still order everything at Aina's Kitchen!

Mallow.greeting: Hala! I'll cook up a feast big enough for even your appetite!
Mallow.trainerWins: I'll get the feast started!
Mallow.trainerLoses: I'll cook a consolation feast!

Hala.greeting: Hoh! Maylene! Barefoot on the hot sand! You have a Kahuna's toughness!
Hala.trainerWins: Hoh! Kahuna toughness, through and through!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! Even tough feet get burned!

Maylene.greeting: Hala! You train like a true martial artist! Let's go all out!
Maylene.trainerLoses: All out... and a loss!

Hala.greeting: Molayne! Still gazing at the stars on Ula'ula? Hoh! Gaze at our win!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! The stars weren't with us tonight!

Molayne.greeting: Hala. I'll calculate the trajectory. You supply the force.
Molayne.trainerLoses: My calculations were off. Force was fine.

Hala.greeting: Olivia! Two Kahunas together! Hoh! Melemele and Akala, side by side!
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! The islands will forgive us!

Olivia.greeting: Hala! Let's show them why the islands chose us!

Hala.greeting: Plumeria. Even Team Skull's big sister deserves a strong partner. Let's win.

Plumeria.greeting: Hala. Don't get sentimental on me, old man. Just fight.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Don't get mushy, old man. We won.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Don't say a word, old man.

Olivia.greeting: Acerola! Win this with me and I'll find you something sparkly at my shop!
Olivia.trainerLoses: Still getting you something sparkly, Acerola.

Acerola.greeting: Olivia! A necklace with a little ghost charm, please! Hee hee!

Olivia.greeting: Brock! A rock lover from Kanto? Okay, you're officially my favorite partner!
Olivia.trainerLoses: Still my favorite partner, even in defeat!

Brock.greeting: Olivia! A Kahuna who sells gems! You're... wow. Um. I'll hold the line!
Brock.trainerWins: I held the line! Um. We won!
Brock.trainerLoses: I couldn't hold the line... sorry, Olivia!

Olivia.greeting: Guzma. Behave yourself on my battlefield, got it?
Olivia.trainerWins: You behaved, and we won. Good.

Guzma.greeting: Olivia. Relax, Kahuna. Team Skull's on its best behavior. Mostly.

Olivia.greeting: Kahili! Golf can wait, the Elite Four needs you!

Kahili.greeting: Olivia. Your rocks make a fine bunker. I'll aim around them.

Olivia.greeting: Kiawe! My island's fiery Captain! Show 'em that fire dance!

Kiawe.greeting: Kahuna Olivia! Akala's fire burns for you!

Olivia.greeting: Kukui! You built the League, so you'd better not lose in it!
Olivia.trainerWins: You didn't lose in your own League!
Olivia.trainerLoses: You lost in your own League!

Kukui.greeting: Olivia! Woo! Akala's Kahuna rocks, literally!

Olivia.greeting: Mallow! Akala's sweetest Captain! Let's win and celebrate at your place!
Olivia.trainerLoses: Consolation party at your place, Mallow?

Mallow.greeting: Olivia! I'll whip up something sparkly for my Kahuna!
Mallow.trainerWins: Something sparkly for my Kahuna!
Mallow.trainerLoses: A sparkly consolation treat, then!

Olivia.greeting: Molayne! Rock and steel! Nothing's getting through us!

Molayne.greeting: Olivia. Solid materials, solid plan. I approve.

Olivia.greeting: Plumeria. I'm keeping an eye on you, girl.
Olivia.trainerWins: I watched. You fought well, girl.

Plumeria.greeting: Olivia. Watch all you want, Kahuna. I'm here to win.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Told you, Kahuna. I'm here to win.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Watch all you want. We lost.

Olivia.greeting: Roark! A miner! You must find amazing stones! Wanna trade?

Roark.greeting: Olivia! A Kahuna with a jewelry shop! Let's dig in!
Roark.trainerWins: Dug in and won!
Roark.trainerLoses: Dug in, but lost!

Olivia.greeting: Roxanne! A rock scholar! Bet you'd love Akala's fossils!
Olivia.trainerWins: Rocks for the win! Akala's fossils await!
Olivia.trainerLoses: Rocks failed us! Still want to see the fossils?

Roxanne.greeting: Olivia! I've read about Alola's geology! Let's put theory into practice!
Roxanne.trainerWins: Theory, put into practice!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Theory... and practice... both failed!

Acerola.greeting: Fantina! Do your ghosts like to dance? Mine love it!

Fantina.greeting: Acerola! Ze little ghost princess! Oui, we dance!
Fantina.trainerWins: Ze little princess and I won!
Fantina.trainerLoses: Ze dance was a flop!

Acerola.greeting: Guzma! Be nice, okay? Some of the kids at the Aether House think you're cool.
Acerola.trainerWins: You were nice! The kids will be so proud!
Acerola.trainerLoses: You were nice... and we still lost!

Guzma.greeting: Acerola. Tell the brats Big Bad Guzma says hi. Now let's go.
Guzma.trainerWins: Tell the brats Big Bad Guzma won.
Guzma.trainerLoses: Don't tell the brats about this one.

Acerola.greeting: Kahili! Teach me golf after this? I promise not to haunt your clubs!

Kahili.greeting: Acerola. Deal. Just keep your ghosts off the fairway.
Kahili.trainerWins: Ghosts stayed off the fairway. Victory.
Kahili.trainerLoses: Off the fairway... and out of luck.

Acerola.greeting: Kiawe! Captain buddies! Even your fire can't scare my ghosts!

Kiawe.greeting: Acerola! Your ghosts and my fire! A spooky bonfire!

Acerola.greeting: Professor Kukui! You should study ghost moves! They're the best!
Acerola.trainerWins: See? Ghost moves are the best!

Kukui.greeting: Acerola! Woo! Spooky moves! I'm taking notes!
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! Taking notes on that win!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo... taking notes on that loss!

Acerola.greeting: Mallow! Let's win so you can make that sweet treat you promised!
Acerola.trainerLoses: Still making that sweet treat, right?

Mallow.greeting: Acerola! I'll make your favorite! Spooky-sweet!
Mallow.trainerWins: Spooky-sweet victory!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Spooky-sour defeat!

Acerola.greeting: Molayne! You used to be a Captain too, right? Let's do our best!
Acerola.trainerWins: We did our best! And we won!
Acerola.trainerLoses: We did our best... and lost!

Molayne.greeting: Acerola. Former Captain and current Elite Four. Let's be efficient.

Acerola.greeting: Morty! You can see spirits too? Wanna be spooky friends?

Morty.greeting: Acerola. The spirits around you are... giggling. Fascinating.
Morty.trainerWins: The spirits giggled with joy.
Morty.trainerLoses: The spirits giggled at us this time.

Acerola.greeting: Plumeria! The kids say you're actually really nice!
Acerola.trainerWins: See? Really nice AND really strong!

Plumeria.greeting: Acerola. Don't spread that around, kid. Let's win.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Not a word about the nice thing, kid.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Not a word about this either, kid.

Kahili.greeting: Falkner, a fellow lover of the sky. Let's read the wind together.

Falkner.greeting: Kahili! An Elite Four master of birds! Let's take to the skies!
Falkner.trainerWins: To the skies, and to victory!
Falkner.trainerLoses: We fell from the skies!

Kahili.greeting: Guzma. Keep your temper on the fairway, would you?
Kahili.trainerWins: You stayed on the fairway. Good.
Kahili.trainerLoses: Too much temper, Guzma. We lost.

Guzma.greeting: Kahili. Sure, golf lady. Just don't slow me down.
Guzma.trainerWins: Didn't slow me down. We won.
Guzma.trainerLoses: You slowed me down, golf lady.

Kahili.greeting: Kiawe. Your fire could warm up a cold morning round.

Kiawe.greeting: Kahili! It's an honor to battle beside the Elite Four!

Kahili.greeting: Professor Kukui. You built the League I came home for.
Kahili.trainerWins: A good League to come home to.

Kukui.greeting: Kahili! Woo! Glad you came back to Alola, yeah?
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! Welcome home with a win!

Kahili.greeting: Mallow. A good meal after a good round. That's the plan.
Kahili.trainerLoses: Bad round. Still want the meal.

Mallow.greeting: Kahili! I'll make you a power lunch for your next tournament!
Mallow.trainerWins: Power lunch, on me!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Comfort lunch, on me!

Kahili.greeting: Molayne. You calculate angles too. We'll get along.

Molayne.greeting: Kahili. Trajectories, wind speed... yes, we'll get along.

Kahili.greeting: Plumeria. Stay out of the rough.
Kahili.trainerWins: You stayed out of the rough. Victory.

Plumeria.greeting: Kahili. I'm always in the rough, golf lady. Let's win.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Out of the rough, golf lady. We won.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Back in the rough, golf lady.

Kahili.greeting: Skyla, a pilot. You understand the wind like I do.

Skyla.greeting: Kahili! A golfer who reads the wind! Let's soar!
Skyla.trainerWins: Golf and flight, a win!

Kahili.greeting: Winona, a fellow master of the sky. Let's soar.

Winona.greeting: Kahili, your birds are as graceful as your swing.

Molayne.greeting: Byron, a steel master from Sinnoh. Let's see how your steel holds up.

Byron.greeting: Gahaha! Molayne! Alolan steel! Let's dig in!
Byron.trainerWins: Gahaha! Alolan steel's tough!

Molayne.greeting: Colress. A fellow engineer. Let's see your science in action.

Colress.greeting: Molayne. Your engineering mind is fascinating. Let's begin.
Colress.trainerLoses: Fascinating. A negative result.

Molayne.greeting: Guzma. Simple plan: you smash, I calculate.
Molayne.trainerWins: You smashed, I calculated. We won.
Molayne.trainerLoses: You smashed, I calculated. We lost anyway.

Guzma.greeting: Molayne. Calculate all you want. I'm still smashing.

Molayne.greeting: Jasmine, a steel master from Johto. Gentle, but strong. I like that.

Jasmine.greeting: Molayne... you're so calm. I'll do my best beside you.
Jasmine.trainerWins: You stayed calm, and we won...
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Molayne... I tried.

Molayne.greeting: Kiawe. Fire and steel. A forge, really.

Kiawe.greeting: Molayne! Let's forge a victory in Wela's flames!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Forged a victory in Wela's flames!

Molayne.greeting: Professor Kukui. You built the League; I'll build us a strategy.

Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo... back to the drawing board!

Molayne.greeting: Mallow. I'll trade you a look through the telescope for a plate of your cooking.

Mallow.greeting: Molayne! Deal! I've always wanted to see the stars up close!
Mallow.trainerWins: We won! Show me the stars!
Mallow.trainerLoses: We lost... can I still see the stars?

Kukui.greeting: Crasher Wake! A fellow masked wrestler! Woo! Let's put on a show!

Crasher Wake.greeting: Wahahah! Kukui! I know a wrestler when I see one! Let's slam them!
Crasher Wake.trainerWins: Wahahah! Slammed them flat!
Crasher Wake.trainerLoses: Wahahah! They slammed us!

Kukui.greeting: Guzma! Let's show 'em Alola's tough guys can work together, yeah?

Guzma.greeting: Kukui. Don't get cute, Professor. Just keep up.
Guzma.trainerLoses: Lost. Don't get cute about it.

Kukui.greeting: Kiawe! Your fire dance is the best move in Alola! Woo!
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! That fire dance is going in my research notes!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo! Even the best move in Alola can miss!

Kiawe.greeting: Professor! I'll show you a move worth studying!

Kukui.greeting: Mallow! After this, let's grab a bite at your place! Woo!
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! Victory bite at Aina's Kitchen!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo! Comfort food at Aina's Kitchen, then!

Mallow.greeting: Professor Kukui! I'll cook you a victory feast!
Mallow.trainerWins: Victory feast, coming right up!
Mallow.trainerLoses: A comfort feast, coming right up!

Kukui.greeting: Plumeria! Let's make this a good one, yeah?
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! A good one, just like I said!

Plumeria.greeting: Professor. Don't get preachy. Let's just win.
Plumeria.trainerWins: No sermon, Professor. Just a win. Nice.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Don't preach about this loss, Professor.

Archer.greeting: Ariana. Two executives, one goal: show them Team Rocket is still standing.
Archer.trainerWins: Team Rocket still stands. Tell everyone.
Archer.trainerLoses: Team Rocket stumbles. Tell no one.

Ariana.greeting: Archer. Try to keep up. I'm not carrying you through this one.
Ariana.trainerLoses: I wasn't carrying you, Archer. Clearly.

Archer.greeting: Bruno of the Elite Four. Your fists for our cause... just for today.
Archer.trainerWins: Your fists served our cause well. Just for today.
Archer.trainerLoses: Even your fists couldn't save our cause.

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! I fight beside you once, Rocket. Don't get used to it!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hmph! Done. Don't call me again, Rocket!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hmph! That's what fighting beside a Rocket gets me!

Archer.greeting: The Azalea bug boy. Don't look at me like that; the well business was Proton's idea.
Archer.trainerWins: Victory. Now we part ways, as agreed.
Archer.trainerLoses: Defeat. Part ways, then. I won't follow.

Bugsy.greeting: Archer. I haven't forgotten what you did at the well in Azalea. Let's just win and part ways.
Bugsy.trainerWins: We won. Now leave Azalea alone.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: We lost. And I still haven't forgotten the well.

Archer.greeting: Cianwood's brawler. Loud, but useful. Point that energy forward.
Archer.trainerWins: Pointed forward, as instructed. Victory.
Archer.trainerLoses: Too loud, not forward enough.

Chuck.greeting: Team Rocket?! WAHAHAH! Fine, I'll punch whoever's in front of me!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Punched the right people!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Punched the wrong way!

Archer.greeting: The Blackthorn dragon tamer. Your cousin gave us a lot of trouble.
Archer.trainerWins: No trouble from you today. Victory.
Archer.trainerLoses: You gave the wrong people trouble.

Clair.greeting: Archer. And I'll give you even more if you get in my way.
Clair.trainerWins: I didn't need to get in your way. Good.
Clair.trainerLoses: I should have just done it myself.

Archer.greeting: Violet's bird keeper. Keep your flock in line and we'll get along.
Archer.trainerWins: Your flock behaved. We won.
Archer.trainerLoses: Your flock scattered.

Falkner.greeting: My birds fly for Violet City, not for Team Rocket. But fine. Let's win.
Falkner.trainerWins: We won for Violet City. Not you.
Falkner.trainerLoses: Violet City's birds are grounded today.

Archer.greeting: Boss! At last! Team Rocket's executive Archer, at your command!
Archer.trainerWins: Boss! Team Rocket wins! Did you see?
Archer.trainerLoses: Boss, I've failed you. Forgive me!

Giovanni.greeting: Archer. You held the organization together. Now show me it was worth it.
Giovanni.trainerWins: It was worth it, Archer. For now.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: That was not worth waiting for, Archer.

Archer.greeting: Olivine's Gym Leader. Gentle souls make poor opponents, but adequate partners.
Archer.trainerWins: Adequate partner. Victory.
Archer.trainerLoses: Too gentle. Defeat.

Jasmine.greeting: Um... Archer, please don't do anything bad while we battle, okay?
Jasmine.trainerWins: We won, and you behaved... thank you.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: We lost... but at least you behaved.

Archer.greeting: Karen of the Elite Four. Darkness suits us both, wouldn't you say?
Archer.trainerWins: Darkness triumphs.
Archer.trainerLoses: Even darkness can be outdone.

Karen.greeting: Archer. We share an affinity for the night, not a cause. Remember that.
Karen.trainerWins: The night was ours. The cause was not.
Karen.trainerLoses: The night slipped away from us.

Archer.greeting: Koga, the poison ninja. Team Rocket could have used a man like you.
Archer.trainerWins: Team Rocket could still use a man like you.
Archer.trainerLoses: Even a ninja couldn't save us.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! A ninja serves no criminal, Archer. But today, we strike together!

Archer.greeting: The Dragon Master who ruined our Mahogany operation. The irony isn't lost on me.
Archer.trainerWins: The irony of winning beside you is delicious.
Archer.trainerLoses: The irony of losing beside you is bitter.

Lance.greeting: Archer. I'll be watching you every turn of this battle.
Lance.trainerWins: You behaved. We won. Don't mistake that for trust.
Lance.trainerLoses: I watched every turn. We still lost.

Archer.greeting: Ecruteak's seer. Tell me, do you see Team Rocket's return?
Archer.trainerWins: Team Rocket's return, foreseen.
Archer.trainerLoses: The seer was right. Nothing beyond this.

Morty.greeting: Archer. I see this battle, and nothing beyond it for your team.
Morty.trainerWins: I saw victory. Nothing beyond it.
Morty.trainerLoses: I saw defeat. I told you as much.

Archer.greeting: Petrel. Drop the disguises today, please. I need you as yourself.
Archer.trainerWins: You fought as yourself. Victory.
Archer.trainerLoses: Too many selves. Defeat.

Petrel.greeting: Archer! Which self do you want? I have several!
Petrel.trainerWins: All my selves won! Thanks, Archer!
Petrel.trainerLoses: All of me lost! Which one was weakest?

Archer.greeting: Proton. Save the cruelty for our opponent.
Archer.trainerWins: You saved the cruelty for them. Good.
Archer.trainerLoses: You wasted your cruelty, Proton.

Proton.greeting: Archer. No promises. That's half the fun.

Archer.greeting: Mahogany's old Gym Leader. We were practically neighbors.
Archer.trainerWins: Neighbors in victory.
Archer.trainerLoses: Neighbors in defeat.

Pryce.greeting: Archer. Your hideout under my town was not neighborly. Let's just battle.
Pryce.trainerWins: We won. The hideout is still not forgiven.
Pryce.trainerLoses: We lost. Your hideout's karma, perhaps.

Archer.greeting: Goldenrod's Gym Leader. No hard feelings about the Radio Tower, I trust.
Archer.trainerWins: No hard feelings, then. We won.
Archer.trainerLoses: Hard feelings now, I suppose.

Whitney.greeting: Hard feelings? You took over our Radio Tower! ...Fine, let's just win!
Whitney.trainerWins: We won! Still mad about the Radio Tower, though!
Whitney.trainerLoses: We lost AND you took our Radio Tower! Waaah!

Archer.greeting: The masked psychic. Read my mind, and you'll find nothing but strategy.
Archer.trainerWins: Strategy prevails.
Archer.trainerLoses: Strategy failed.

Will.greeting: Archer. Your mind is orderly. Unpleasantly so. Let us begin.
Will.trainerWins: An orderly mind, a clean victory.

Ariana.greeting: Bruno. All that muscle, and still on the wrong side. Today it's my side.
Ariana.trainerLoses: My side lost. Thanks for nothing.

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! I stand beside you only because the draw says so!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hmph! Even the draw can't make me like this!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hmph! This is why I don't stand beside Rockets!

Ariana.greeting: Bugsy. Stop glaring. We're on the same team for once.
Ariana.trainerWins: Same team, same win. Stop glaring.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Glare all you want. We lost.

Bugsy.greeting: Ariana. I'll battle with you. I won't like it.
Bugsy.trainerWins: We won. I still don't like it.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: We lost. I like it even less.

Ariana.greeting: Chuck. Less shouting, more winning.
Ariana.trainerWins: More winning. Good. Less shouting next time.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Less shouting might have helped.

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! A Rocket lady with attitude! Let's go!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Attitude wins!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Attitude wasn't enough!

Ariana.greeting: Clair. You and I both know how to command a room. Let's command this one.
Ariana.trainerLoses: The room didn't listen.

Clair.greeting: Ariana. For once, I agree with a Rocket. Let's win.
Clair.trainerWins: I agree again. A fine win.
Clair.trainerLoses: I disagree with this result.

Ariana.greeting: Falkner. Don't let your birds peck at my partners this time.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Your birds failed us.

Falkner.greeting: Ariana. As long as you keep your hands to yourself, we'll be fine.
Falkner.trainerWins: Hands to yourself, and we won.
Falkner.trainerLoses: Hands to yourself, and we lost.

Ariana.greeting: Boss. Team Rocket's executive Ariana, reporting. We waited for you.
Ariana.trainerWins: Boss! It was worth the wait!
Ariana.trainerLoses: Boss, I'm sorry. We'll do better.

Giovanni.greeting: Ariana. Loyal as ever. Let's remind the world why they feared us.
Giovanni.trainerWins: The world remembers why they feared us.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: The world won't fear that, Ariana.

Ariana.greeting: Jasmine. Sweet girl. Try not to apologize to our opponent mid-battle.
Ariana.trainerWins: You didn't apologize once. I'm impressed.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Did you apologize to them? We lost.

Jasmine.greeting: Ariana... I'll try. But you be nice too, okay?
Jasmine.trainerWins: You were nice, and we won! Thank you.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: You were nice... and we lost anyway.

Ariana.greeting: Karen. A woman who doesn't care what others think. I respect that.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Respect isn't enough to win.

Karen.greeting: Ariana. I care what my partners think. That's the difference between us.
Karen.trainerWins: My partner thinks we won well. So do I.
Karen.trainerLoses: Losing taught us something. Even you, Ariana.

Ariana.greeting: Koga. A man of poison. We understand each other.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Even poison has its limits.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Ariana, our poisons are alike, but our hearts are not.
Koga.trainerLoses: Fwahaha! Our poisons failed us both!

Ariana.greeting: Lance. You sent half our grunts running in Mahogany. Impressive, I'll admit.
Ariana.trainerWins: Impressive. Again. Don't let it go to your head.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Even you couldn't send them running, Lance.

Lance.greeting: Ariana. Behave yourself, and I won't have to do it again.
Lance.trainerWins: You behaved. I didn't have to do it again.
Lance.trainerLoses: We lost. At least you behaved.

Ariana.greeting: Morty. Stop staring at me like you can see my past.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Stop staring. We lost.

Morty.greeting: Ariana. I see a past. I also see a choice to make better ones.
Morty.trainerWins: A better choice, and a better result.
Morty.trainerLoses: The choice was right. The result was not.

Ariana.greeting: Petrel. If you impersonate me today, I'll end you.
Ariana.trainerWins: You didn't impersonate me. You live.
Ariana.trainerLoses: We lost, and you're still too close, Petrel.

Petrel.greeting: Ariana! I would never! ...Your outfit's too hard to copy anyway.
Petrel.trainerWins: I didn't copy you! We won!
Petrel.trainerLoses: We lost! But I didn't copy you, I swear!

Ariana.greeting: Proton. Cruel and useful. Let's go.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Cruel, but useless today.

Proton.greeting: Ariana. Glad someone appreciates my talents.

Ariana.greeting: Pryce. Old and cold. My kind of partner.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Old, cold, and beaten.

Pryce.greeting: Ariana. Cold, yes. On your side? Only today.
Pryce.trainerWins: Today only. We won.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Today only. We lost.

Ariana.greeting: Whitney. If you cry, I'm leaving.
Ariana.trainerLoses: You're crying, aren't you? I'm leaving.

Whitney.greeting: Ariana! I won't cry! ...Probably!
Whitney.trainerWins: I didn't cry! We won!
Whitney.trainerLoses: I'm not crying! ...Waaaah!

Ariana.greeting: Will. Keep your mind games pointed at them, not me.
Ariana.trainerLoses: Your mind games missed.

Will.greeting: Ariana. Your mind is guarded. Wise.

Proton.greeting: Bruno. Big guy. Let's be cruel together.

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! I am never cruel! Only strong! Hoo hah!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hmph! Strong, not cruel! Hoo hah!

Proton.greeting: Bugsy! Long time since that business at the Azalea well. Still mad?
Proton.trainerWins: Still mad? We won, at least.

Bugsy.greeting: Proton. Yes. Very. Let's just battle before I say something I regret.
Bugsy.trainerWins: We won. I'm still mad.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: We lost. I'm even madder.

Proton.greeting: Chuck. You punch things. I hurt things. Same idea.
Proton.trainerWins: Punched and hurt. Same thing. We won.

Chuck.greeting: WAHAH... no, not the same idea! But let's win anyway!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Not the same idea, but we won!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Still not the same idea, and we lost!

Proton.greeting: Clair. Your dragons look mean. I like mean.

Clair.greeting: Proton. My dragons are proud, not mean. You wouldn't know the difference.
Clair.trainerWins: Proud dragons. A proud victory.
Clair.trainerLoses: Pride failed us. Don't call it meanness.

Proton.greeting: Falkner. Birds are fun to scare. Not yours, though. Today.
Proton.trainerWins: Didn't touch your birds. We won.
Proton.trainerLoses: Didn't touch your birds. We lost anyway.

Falkner.greeting: Proton. One wrong move toward my birds and we're done.
Falkner.trainerWins: We're done. And we won.
Falkner.trainerLoses: We're done. We lost.

Proton.greeting: Boss! The scariest, cruelest guy in Team Rocket, ready to serve!

Giovanni.greeting: Proton. Cruelty is only useful when it wins. Win.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Cruelty won today. Remember that it must.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Cruelty that loses is worthless, Proton.

Proton.greeting: Jasmine. You look like you've never been mean in your life.

Jasmine.greeting: Proton... I haven't. And I won't start now.
Jasmine.trainerWins: I wasn't mean, and we won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: I wasn't mean... and we lost.

Proton.greeting: Karen. Dark and cool. Let's scare them silly.

Karen.greeting: Proton. Strength isn't about scaring people. Watch and learn.
Karen.trainerWins: Watch and learn. That's how you win.
Karen.trainerLoses: Even I couldn't teach you today.

Proton.greeting: Koga. Poison buddies! Let's make them suffer.

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! Suffering is not my aim, Proton. Victory is.

Proton.greeting: Lance. You stomped our hideout. Bet you'd stomp them too.

Lance.greeting: Proton. Keep your cruelty in check, or I'll stomp you first.
Lance.trainerWins: In check, and victorious.

Proton.greeting: Morty. Seen any good ghosts lately? I'm scarier.
Proton.trainerWins: Scarier than any ghost. We won.

Morty.greeting: Proton. The spirits are not impressed by you.
Morty.trainerWins: The spirits were impressed by our win. Not you.
Morty.trainerLoses: The spirits are even less impressed now.

Proton.greeting: Petrel. Who are you supposed to be today?
Proton.trainerWins: You were me today. Not bad.

Petrel.greeting: Proton! I'm you! See? I'm frowning!
Petrel.trainerWins: I frowned the whole time! We won!
Petrel.trainerLoses: I frowned the whole time... we lost!

Proton.greeting: Pryce. Grumpy old man. Perfect.

Pryce.greeting: Proton. Respect your elders, boy. Then win.
Pryce.trainerWins: Elders win. Remember that.
Pryce.trainerLoses: Elders lose too, boy.

Proton.greeting: Whitney. Don't you dare cry.

Whitney.greeting: Proton! You're so mean! ...Let's win anyway!
Whitney.trainerWins: You're mean, but we won!
Whitney.trainerLoses: You're mean AND we lost! Waaah!

Proton.greeting: Will. Fancy mask. Fancy moves. Fine.

Will.greeting: Proton. Your thoughts are... unpleasant. Let us begin.

Petrel.greeting: Bruno! Hoo hah! See, I can do you too!
Petrel.trainerWins: Hoo hah! I won as you!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Hoo hah... I lost as you!

Bruno.greeting: Hmph! Stop that! Fight as yourself!
Bruno.trainerWins: Hmph! You fought as yourself, finally!
Bruno.trainerLoses: Hmph! Fight as yourself and maybe you'll win!

Petrel.greeting: Bugsy! I'm a bug researcher too. Totally. Trust me.
Petrel.trainerWins: A bug researcher's victory!
Petrel.trainerLoses: A bug researcher's defeat!

Bugsy.greeting: Petrel. I know it's you. I can tell by the hair.
Bugsy.trainerWins: The hair gave you away. The win is real, though.
Bugsy.trainerLoses: The hair gave you away, and we lost.

Petrel.greeting: Chuck! WAHAHAH! How's my impression?
Petrel.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Punched like you!
Petrel.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Punched wrong!

Chuck.greeting: WAHAHAH! Not bad! Now punch like me too!
Chuck.trainerWins: WAHAHAH! Good impression, good win!
Chuck.trainerLoses: WAHAHAH! Good impression, bad result!

Petrel.greeting: Clair! I could be a dragon tamer too, with the right cape.
Petrel.trainerWins: Cape or no cape, we won!
Petrel.trainerLoses: I needed the cape after all!

Clair.greeting: Petrel. You couldn't. Don't even try.
Clair.trainerWins: Don't even think of copying this win.
Clair.trainerLoses: We lost. You still couldn't be a dragon tamer.

Petrel.greeting: Falkner! I once dressed as a bird keeper. Fooled everyone!
Petrel.trainerWins: Fooled everyone! We won!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Fooled nobody! We lost!

Falkner.greeting: Petrel. You did not fool anyone. Let's just battle.
Falkner.trainerWins: You fooled no one. We still won.
Falkner.trainerLoses: No disguise could have saved that.

Petrel.greeting: Boss! I played you at the Mahogany hideout once! Nobody could tell! ...Well, almost nobody.
Petrel.trainerWins: Boss! I won as myself!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Boss! I lost as myself!

Giovanni.greeting: Petrel. Never do that again. Now, battle.
Giovanni.trainerWins: Good. You were yourself. You won.
Giovanni.trainerLoses: Be yourself next time, and win.

Petrel.greeting: Jasmine! I could dress as a lighthouse keeper!
Petrel.trainerWins: I stayed myself! We won!
Petrel.trainerLoses: I stayed myself... we lost!

Jasmine.greeting: Petrel... please just be yourself. It's okay.
Jasmine.trainerWins: You were yourself, and we won.
Jasmine.trainerLoses: You were yourself. That's okay, even though we lost.

Petrel.greeting: Karen! Want me to dress as you? I've got the attitude down!
Petrel.trainerWins: No copying, all winning!
Petrel.trainerLoses: I didn't copy you! We lost!

Karen.greeting: Petrel. No. Never.
Karen.trainerWins: Good. Never copy me. We won.
Karen.trainerLoses: Never. And we lost.

Petrel.greeting: Koga! Disguise and stealth! We're basically the same!
Petrel.trainerWins: Disguise and stealth win!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Disguise and stealth failed!

Koga.greeting: Fwahaha! A ninja's shadow is not a costume, Petrel!
Koga.trainerWins: Fwahaha! A shadow, not a costume, won today!

Petrel.greeting: Lance! I'm also a dragon master today. Just go with it.
Petrel.trainerWins: Dragon master Petrel wins!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Dragon master Petrel... lost.

Lance.greeting: Petrel. I'll go with you winning. Not the disguise.
Lance.trainerWins: You won. The disguise did not.
Lance.trainerLoses: You lost. The disguise didn't help.

Petrel.greeting: Morty! Can you see through my disguise?
Petrel.trainerWins: You can't see through my win!
Petrel.trainerLoses: You saw right through that loss.

Morty.greeting: Petrel. I see you. I always see you.
Morty.trainerWins: I saw you. And I saw victory.
Morty.trainerLoses: I saw you, and I saw defeat.

Petrel.greeting: Pryce! I'm wearing a scarf! We match!
Petrel.trainerWins: Scarf buddies win!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Scarf buddies lose!

Pryce.greeting: Petrel. We do not match. Battle.
Pryce.trainerWins: We still don't match. We won.
Pryce.trainerLoses: We still don't match. We lost.

Petrel.greeting: Whitney! I'm your number one fan! Or am I?
Petrel.trainerWins: Your number one fan won! Or did I?
Petrel.trainerLoses: Your number one fan lost! Or did I?

Whitney.greeting: Petrel! Wait, are you the guy from the Radio Tower?!
Whitney.trainerWins: You ARE the Radio Tower guy! ...We won, though!
Whitney.trainerLoses: You're the Radio Tower guy AND we lost!

Petrel.greeting: Will! Masks! We both love masks!
Petrel.trainerWins: Masks win!
Petrel.trainerLoses: Masks lose!

Will.greeting: Petrel. My mask hides nothing. Yours hides everything.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The Battle Frontier's Salon Maiden. Read my feelings if you like. You'll find only resolve.

Anabel.greeting: Maxie. Resolve, yes... and something heavier underneath. Let's begin.
Anabel.trainerWins: Resolve, and something heavier. Still a win.
Anabel.trainerLoses: That heaviness weighed us down, Maxie.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Archie. Our goals are opposites, but our enemy today is the same. Don't get in my way.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: You stayed out of my way. A rare success.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: You got in my way, Archie. As always.

Archie (RSE).greeting: Maxie! Still dreaming of dry land? Fine, I'll put up with you for one battle.
Archie (RSE).trainerWins: Bwahaha! Put up with you, and we won!
Archie (RSE).trainerLoses: Bwahaha! That's what I get for working with you!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Archie. You seem... changed. No matter. Battle well and keep your distance.

Archie (ORAS).greeting: Bwahaha! Maxie, you haven't changed a bit! Same scowl, same glasses!
Archie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Bwahaha! Same scowl, but a loss!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Dewford's surfer. All that water. How wasteful.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: A waste of water, but a fine result.

Brawly.greeting: Whoa, Team Magma? Okay, dude, but the ocean stays where it is!
Brawly.trainerWins: The ocean stays, and we win, dude!
Brawly.trainerLoses: The ocean stays, and we wipe out!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The Elite Four's old sailor. You love the sea. I love the land. Today, we love winning.

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Maxie, a landlubber! Fine, let's make 'em walk the plank!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Walked the plank, they did!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Lavaridge's Gym Leader. Mt. Chimney's heat runs in your blood. Use it.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Mt. Chimney's heat, put to good use.

Flannery.greeting: Maxie! You messed with Mt. Chimney once! Behave, or I'll burn you too!
Flannery.trainerWins: I didn't need to burn you! We won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: I should have burned you instead!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The ice-cold Elite Four. A cold head is useful. Stay that way.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: A cold head served us well.

Glacia.greeting: Maxie. Your plans were rather hot-headed. Let's keep this battle cool.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Sootopolis's Gym Leader. Your city nearly sank because of Archie, not me.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Your city survived, and we won.

Juan.greeting: Maxie. My city remembers both of you, I assure you. Let us battle.
Juan.trainerWins: My city's memories include this win, Maxie.
Juan.trainerLoses: My city will not remember this kindly.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Archie's lackey. Keep your shouting down and your fists up.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Too much shouting, not enough fist.

Matt (Team Aqua).greeting: BWAHAHA! Team Magma's boss?! Fine! My fists are always up!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Petalburg's Gym Leader. A father with discipline. Good.

Norman.greeting: Maxie. I'll keep my eye on you. Now, let's battle.
Norman.trainerWins: I watched you, and we won.
Norman.trainerLoses: I watched you, and we lost.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The Mt. Pyre girl. Yes, we took the orb. Let's not discuss it.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: We didn't discuss the orb. We won.

Phoebe.greeting: Maxie! The spirits are still mad at you! ...Okay, let's battle anyway.
Phoebe.trainerWins: The spirits are a little less mad now!
Phoebe.trainerLoses: The spirits are even madder now!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The scholar of Rustboro. Study the earth, and you'll understand my goals.
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Understanding the earth leads to victory.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: The earth gave way beneath us.

Roxanne.greeting: Maxie. I've studied geology. Your goals are scientifically reckless.
Roxanne.trainerWins: Scientific success, reckless partner.
Roxanne.trainerLoses: Scientifically, we were doomed.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Team Aqua's admin. Keep your sea talk to yourself.

Shelly.greeting: Ahahaha! Maxie! You're even grumpier up close!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: The Elite Four's punk. Your attitude is... tolerable today.

Sidney.greeting: Hey hey, Maxie! Glasses guy! Let's have a wild one!
Sidney.trainerWins: Wild one, glasses guy! We won!
Sidney.trainerLoses: Wild one, glasses guy! We lost!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Steven Stone. You've interfered with Team Magma more than once.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: Even you couldn't interfere with that loss.

Steven.greeting: Maxie. And I'll keep doing it. For today, let's just win.
Steven.trainerWins: We won. I'll still be watching you.
Steven.trainerLoses: We lost. I'll keep watching anyway.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Tabitha. Quiet. Follow my lead.
Maxie (RSE).trainerLoses: You followed my lead into defeat.

Tabitha.greeting: Hehehe! Yes, Leader Maxie! Right behind you!
Tabitha.trainerLoses: Hehehe... right behind you, into defeat...

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Sootopolis's elegant one. The land will outlast your beautiful sea.

Wallace.greeting: Maxie. Elegance outlasts everything. Let me show you.

Maxie (RSE).greeting: A sickly boy turned trainer. The land made you strong, did it?
Maxie (RSE).trainerWins: Your partners did make you strong. Victory.

Wally.greeting: Mr. Maxie... um, it was my partners that made me strong. Let's battle!
Wally.trainerWins: My partners made us win, Mr. Maxie!
Wally.trainerLoses: I'm sorry, Mr. Maxie... we'll get stronger!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Mauville's Gym Leader. Keep your laughing to a minimum.

Wattson.greeting: Wahahahah! Maxie! A grumpy partner! I'll laugh for both of us!
Wattson.trainerWins: Wahahahah! Laughed for both of us AND won!
Wattson.trainerLoses: Wahahahah! Still laughing, even in defeat!

Maxie (RSE).greeting: Fortree's sky trainer. The Weather Institute was a necessary detour.

Winona.greeting: Maxie. My sky remembers that detour. Let's battle.
Winona.trainerWins: My sky remembers this win too.

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Fufufu... The Salon Maiden. Feel what you will. I've made peace with my past.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... At peace, even in defeat.

Anabel.greeting: Maxie. I feel... regret, and hope. Let's battle.
Anabel.trainerWins: Regret, hope... and victory.

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Fufufu... Archie, as you once were. Brash. Reckless. Shall we show him how we grew?
Maxie (ORAS).trainerWins: Fufufu... We grew, and we won.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... We grew, and still lost.

Archie (RSE).greeting: Maxie? You talk funny now. Whatever. Let's win, then we argue.
Archie (RSE).trainerWins: Won! Now we argue!

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Archie. We nearly ended the world together. Today, let's merely end a battle.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerWins: The battle ended. The world did not. Good.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: We ended nothing but our own chances.

Archie (ORAS).greeting: Bwahahaha! Maxie, old rival! Land and sea, side by side!

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Fufufu... Dewford's surfer. The sea has its uses, I suppose. Ride it well.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerWins: Fufufu... You rode the sea well.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... The sea had other plans.

Brawly.greeting: Whoa, Maxie! You're kinda chill now! Let's ride!
Brawly.trainerWins: Chill Maxie wins!
Brawly.trainerLoses: Chill Maxie lost, dude.

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Fufufu... A sailor who tames dragons. Humanity's spirit at its finest.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... Humanity's spirit, humbled.

Drake.greeting: Gwahaha! Maxie! You're less of a stick in the mud these days!
Drake.trainerWins: Gwahaha! Not a stick in the mud at all!
Drake.trainerLoses: Gwahaha! Stuck in the mud, we were!

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Lavaridge's Gym Leader. Mt. Chimney's heat... I've learned to respect it.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: The mountain humbled us.

Flannery.greeting: Maxie! Good! Respect the mountain, and we'll get along fine!
Flannery.trainerWins: See? We got along fine and won!
Flannery.trainerLoses: We got along fine... but we lost!

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Fufufu... Ice upon land. A stable foundation for victory.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... The ice cracked beneath us.

Glacia.greeting: Maxie. How poetic. Let's keep it cool.

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: The master of Sootopolis. Your city's cave holds memories I'd rather forget.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... Forgiveness, but no victory.

Juan.greeting: Maxie. Forgiveness is an art. Let us create some today.
Juan.trainerWins: An artful act of forgiveness. A win.
Juan.trainerLoses: Forgiveness remains. The win does not.

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Fufufu... Archie's strongman. Your energy could move mountains. Literally.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... The mountains did not budge.

Matt (Team Aqua).greeting: BWAHAHA! Maxie! I'll move ALL the mountains!

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Norman. Your child stopped me once. You raised them well.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... There's still growing to do.

Norman.greeting: Maxie. Thank you. Let's show them we've all grown.
Norman.trainerWins: Grown, and victorious.
Norman.trainerLoses: Grown, but humbled.

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: The girl of Mt. Pyre. What I took from your mountain... I regret it. Let us leave it there.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... Forgiven, at least.

Phoebe.greeting: Maxie! The spirits say you're forgiven! Mostly!
Phoebe.trainerWins: The spirits say you're fully forgiven now!
Phoebe.trainerLoses: The spirits are back to mostly forgiven.

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Rustboro's scholar. Geology is a passion we share. Fufufu.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... The layers crumbled.

Roxanne.greeting: Maxie! Then you'll appreciate the stratigraphy of this battle!
Roxanne.trainerWins: The battle's strata show victory!
Roxanne.trainerLoses: The strata show defeat!

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Fufufu... Team Aqua's admin. The sea is lucky to have you.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... Even luck runs out.

Shelly.greeting: Ahahaha! Maxie complimenting me? The world must be ending!
Shelly.trainerWins: Ahahaha! The world didn't end, and we won!
Shelly.trainerLoses: Ahahaha! The world didn't end, but our chances did!

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: The Elite Four's wild one. Chaos has its place. Fufufu.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerWins: Fufufu... Chaos found its place: victory.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: Fufufu... Chaos found its place: our defeat.

Sidney.greeting: Hey hey, Maxie! You've loosened up! I like it!
Sidney.trainerWins: Loosened-up Maxie wins! I like it!
Sidney.trainerLoses: Loosened up, and still lost! Ha!

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Steven. The Space Center in Mossdeep... I owe you an apology.
Maxie (ORAS).trainerWins: We won. Are we even, Steven?
Maxie (ORAS).trainerLoses: We lost. I still owe you, it seems.

Steven.greeting: Maxie. Help me win today, and we'll call it even.
Steven.trainerWins: Even, Maxie. Thank you.

Maxie (ORAS).greeting: Tabitha. Team Magma's finest admin. Let us prove it.

Ghetsis.greeting: N. Do as I say, as you always did. Win.
