Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Failure. You never did learn obedience.

N.greeting: Grimsley. Your partners are tired of your gambling, but they love you anyway.
N.trainerWins: Your partners are glad you bet on them.
N.trainerLoses: Your partners forgive you. They always do.

Grimsley.greeting: N. Then I'll bet on them. Let's battle.
Grimsley.trainerWins: The bet on them paid off.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Even my best bet lost today.

N.greeting: Iris. Your dragons are so happy. You must be a wonderful partner.
N.trainerWins: Your dragons are dancing. They're so proud.
N.trainerLoses: Your dragons say it's okay. They still love you.

Iris.greeting: N! You can talk to Pokémon? That's so cool! Let's win!
Iris.trainerWins: My dragons are happy? Yay! We won!
Iris.trainerLoses: Tell my dragons I'm sorry, okay?

N.greeting: Lenora. I'm sorry about the Dragon Skull. Team Plasma had no right.
N.trainerWins: That's better history. I'm glad.
N.trainerLoses: History isn't always kind. I'm still sorry.

Lenora.greeting: N. Thank you. Let's make some better history today.
Lenora.trainerWins: Better history, made together.
Lenora.trainerLoses: History's lessons are hard sometimes.

N.greeting: Marlon. Your partners ride the waves with you. They're so free.
N.trainerWins: Your partners felt free out there.
N.trainerLoses: Your partners say the waves will come again.

Marlon.greeting: N, dude! You totally get it! Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: Totally got it, dude! We won!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Wiped out, but you still get it!

N.greeting: Marshal. I defeated your master once. Your partners still remember.
N.trainerWins: As allies, we won. Your partners are glad.
N.trainerLoses: As allies, we lost. They're still glad.

Marshal.greeting: N. And I remember. Let us fight as allies now.

N.greeting: Roxie. Your partners love your music. It makes them feel brave.
N.trainerWins: Your partners felt brave the whole time.
N.trainerLoses: Your partners were brave. Even in defeat.

Roxie.greeting: N! Really?! Let's rock out, then!
Roxie.trainerWins: Rocked out! They felt brave? Awesome!
Roxie.trainerLoses: They were brave! We just lost!

N.greeting: Shauntal. You write about Pokémon and people. I'd like to read one.
N.trainerWins: A happy chapter. I'd like to read it.
N.trainerLoses: A sad chapter. I'd still read it.

Shauntal.greeting: N! The King of Team Plasma, in my novel! Let's battle first!
Shauntal.trainerWins: The King and I, victorious! Into the novel!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The King's chapter ends in defeat!

N.greeting: Skyla. Your birds love the sky as much as you do.
N.trainerWins: Your birds are singing. They love the win.
N.trainerLoses: Your birds are quiet. They'll sing again.

Skyla.greeting: N! The sky's big enough for everyone's dreams! Let's soar!
Skyla.trainerWins: Big sky, big dreams, big win!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Dreams still big, even after that!

N.greeting: Zinzolin. You never really listened to me. Will you now?
N.trainerWins: You listened. We won.
N.trainerLoses: You didn't listen. We lost.

Zinzolin.greeting: Lord N. I will... for this one battle.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: I listened, Lord N. And we won.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: I listened, Lord N. Yet we lost.

Ghetsis.greeting: Alder. The old Champion. Your free spirit was always a weakness.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Your free spirit failed us. As I knew it would.

Alder.greeting: Ghetsis. And your greed was always yours. Let's just win this.
Alder.trainerWins: Ha! Greed didn't ruin it this time!
Alder.trainerLoses: Greed and freedom both lost today.

Ghetsis.greeting: Bianca. Juniper's little helper. Stay out of my way.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: You stayed out of my way. Adequate.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: You were in my way. Pathetic.

Bianca.greeting: Ghetsis... you're so scary! But I'll battle! For my partners!
Bianca.trainerWins: I battled for my partners! And we won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I tried my best for my partners...

Ghetsis.greeting: Brycen. A retired actor. How fitting that you play hero now.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: A poor performance. Even for an actor.

Brycen.greeting: Ghetsis. I play nothing. Let us battle.

Ghetsis.greeting: Burgh. Your art will never capture true power.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Your art is all you'll have left.

Burgh.greeting: Ghetsis. True power isn't something I'd want to paint.
Burgh.trainerWins: I won't paint this. Not even the victory.
Burgh.trainerLoses: I'll paint this loss. Without you in it.

Ghetsis.greeting: Caitlin. Try to stay awake. I won't carry you.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: You fell asleep. I knew it.

Caitlin.greeting: Ghetsis. Your voice is enough to keep anyone awake. Unfortunately.
Caitlin.trainerWins: Awake, and victorious. Your voice did help.
Caitlin.trainerLoses: Your voice kept me awake for this? Tiresome.

Ghetsis.greeting: Cheren. You stood against Team Plasma twice. A persistent boy.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Your lesson was irrelevant. We won.

Cheren.greeting: Ghetsis. I'm a teacher now. Today's lesson: you don't win alone.
Cheren.trainerWins: Lesson learned: nobody wins alone.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Even teachers lose. Lesson noted.

Ghetsis.greeting: Chili. Control your temper, or I'll control it for you.

Chili.greeting: Ghetsis! Just try it! ...After we win!
Chili.trainerWins: Won! Now try it!

Ghetsis.greeting: Cilan. Spare me your commentary.

Cilan.greeting: Ghetsis. This battle has a bitter aftertaste already.
Cilan.trainerWins: A sweet victory, with a bitter aftertaste!
Cilan.trainerLoses: A bitter defeat, with a bitter aftertaste.

Ghetsis.greeting: Clay. Driftveil's mine boss. Useful muscle.

Clay.greeting: Ghetsis. I ain't your muscle. Let's just get this done.
Clay.trainerWins: Done. And I ain't your muscle.
Clay.trainerLoses: Done. Don't call me again.

Ghetsis.greeting: Colress. My scientist. Prove your research was worth funding.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Your research was worth funding after all.

Colress.greeting: Ghetsis. My research belongs to no one now. But I'll battle.
Colress.trainerWins: My research, my win. Not yours.
Colress.trainerLoses: My research belongs to no one. Neither does this loss.

Ghetsis.greeting: Cress. Serve us a victory.

Cress.greeting: Ghetsis. I'll serve, but not you. Let's begin.
Cress.trainerWins: I served a win. Not for you.

Ghetsis.greeting: Drayden. Opelucid's mayor. Your city froze once. Remember?
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Opelucid remembers. So do I. Victory.

Drayden.greeting: Ghetsis. I remember who froze it. Let us battle.
Drayden.trainerWins: We won. I still remember who froze it.
Drayden.trainerLoses: We lost. The city will not forget either.

Ghetsis.greeting: Elesa. Glamour is a tool. Use it.

Elesa.greeting: Ghetsis. My glamour isn't for you. Let's battle.
Elesa.trainerWins: My glamour won. Not for you.

Ghetsis.greeting: Grimsley. A gambler. You'll lose eventually.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: You'll lose eventually. Not today, it seems.

Grimsley.greeting: Ghetsis. Not today. I'm betting against you.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Bet against you, and still won.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Bet against you. Lost both ways.

Ghetsis.greeting: Iris. A child Champion. Pathetic.

Iris.greeting: Ghetsis! I'm not pathetic! I'll show you!
Iris.trainerWins: See? Not pathetic! We won!
Iris.trainerLoses: I'm not pathetic! I'll beat you next time!

Ghetsis.greeting: Lenora. Your museum's skull made a fine gift.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: A fine gift, and a fine win.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: The skull is cursed. As are we.

Lenora.greeting: Ghetsis. It was never yours to give. Let's battle.
Lenora.trainerWins: We won. The skull's still not yours.
Lenora.trainerLoses: We lost. The skull is still not yours.

Ghetsis.greeting: Marlon. Your carefree attitude disgusts me.

Marlon.greeting: Ghetsis, dude. Lighten up! Let's ride!
Marlon.trainerWins: Lightened up, dude! We won!
Marlon.trainerLoses: Should've lightened up, dude.

Ghetsis.greeting: Marshal. Alder's student. Weak, like his master.

Marshal.greeting: Ghetsis. My master is stronger than you'll ever be.
Marshal.trainerWins: My master is stronger. And so am I.
Marshal.trainerLoses: My master would have won this.

Ghetsis.greeting: Roxie. Turn your noise down.

Roxie.greeting: Ghetsis! Turn it down? Never! This one's for every Pokémon you hurt!
Roxie.trainerWins: That one was for them! We won!
Roxie.trainerLoses: I'll keep playing for them, even after this!

Ghetsis.greeting: Shauntal. Write about me. Make me the hero.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Even villains can be heroes. Not today.

Shauntal.greeting: Ghetsis. I'll write you as the villain. Let's battle.
Shauntal.trainerWins: The villain won. That's... a plot twist.
Shauntal.trainerLoses: The villain lost. As he should.

Ghetsis.greeting: Skyla. Fly where I tell you.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: You flew where I told you. Victory.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: You flew where you wanted. Defeat.

Skyla.greeting: Ghetsis! I fly where I want! Let's go!
Skyla.trainerWins: I flew where I wanted, and we won!
Skyla.trainerLoses: I flew where I wanted... we lost!

Ghetsis.greeting: Zinzolin. My fellow Sage. Let us remind them who we are.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: They don't remember us, it seems.

Zinzolin.greeting: Lord Ghetsis. As you wish.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: As you wished, Lord Ghetsis. Victory.

Zinzolin.greeting: Alder. The free-spirited former Champion. How chilly of you to join me.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: How chilly of you to win with me.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: The cold has no mercy, even for us.

Alder.greeting: Zinzolin. You froze Opelucid. I haven't forgotten. Let's battle.
Alder.trainerWins: Won. I still haven't forgotten Opelucid.
Alder.trainerLoses: Lost. Opelucid's still not forgotten.

Zinzolin.greeting: Bianca. Juniper's assistant. Stand behind me, child.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: You stood in front of me. Defeat.

Bianca.greeting: Zinzolin! I'm not a child! Let's battle!
Bianca.trainerWins: I'm not a child! We won!
Bianca.trainerLoses: I'm still not a child! Even if we lost!

Zinzolin.greeting: Brycen. A fellow lover of ice. Finally, someone civilized.

Brycen.greeting: Zinzolin. Ice is not for crimes. Let us battle.
Brycen.trainerLoses: Ice can't be used for crimes, or for winning, it seems.

Zinzolin.greeting: Burgh. Paint us a frozen landscape.

Burgh.greeting: Zinzolin. I'll paint you losing. Let's battle!
Burgh.trainerWins: Painted you winning. Not losing. Strange!
Burgh.trainerLoses: Painted you losing! Didn't expect myself in the picture!

Zinzolin.greeting: Caitlin. Elegance and ice. A fine pairing.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: A fine pairing, as I said.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: A poor pairing, in the end.

Caitlin.greeting: Zinzolin. Elegance, yes. Ice, no thank you.

Zinzolin.greeting: Cheren. The teacher. Teach them about cold.

Cheren.greeting: Zinzolin. I'll teach them about teamwork. Let's battle.
Cheren.trainerWins: Teamwork taught. Victory.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Teamwork taught. Not learned.

Zinzolin.greeting: Chili. You're too hot for my taste.

Chili.greeting: Zinzolin! Good! Let's burn 'em!
Chili.trainerWins: Burned 'em!

Zinzolin.greeting: Cilan. Spare me your culinary metaphors.

Cilan.greeting: Zinzolin. This battle is... a cold dish. Let's begin.
Cilan.trainerWins: A cold dish, served perfectly!
Cilan.trainerLoses: A cold dish, sent back!

Zinzolin.greeting: Clay. Driftveil's miner. Dig us a victory.

Clay.greeting: Zinzolin. I'll dig, but not for you. Let's get to work.
Clay.trainerWins: Dug the win. Not for you.
Clay.trainerLoses: Dug. Still lost.

Zinzolin.greeting: Colress. Your science froze Opelucid. Well done.

Colress.greeting: Zinzolin. That was not my finest moment. Let's battle.
Colress.trainerWins: Not my finest moment, but a fine win.
Colress.trainerLoses: Another poor moment.

Zinzolin.greeting: Cress. Cold water. I approve.

Cress.greeting: Zinzolin. Your approval is unnecessary. Let's begin.
Cress.trainerWins: Approval unnecessary. Victory.

Zinzolin.greeting: Drayden. Opelucid's mayor. Your city looked lovely frozen.

Drayden.greeting: Zinzolin. You'll pay for that someday. Today, we battle.
Drayden.trainerWins: We won. You will still pay.
Drayden.trainerLoses: We lost. And you will still pay.

Zinzolin.greeting: Elesa. Electric glamour. How warm.

Elesa.greeting: Zinzolin. My spotlight melts ice. Stay out of it.
Elesa.trainerWins: Stayed out of my spotlight. Thank you.

Zinzolin.greeting: Grimsley. Gamble on the cold.

Grimsley.greeting: Zinzolin. I gamble on myself. Let's battle.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Bet on myself. Won.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Bet on myself. Lost.

Zinzolin.greeting: Iris. Opelucid's girl. Your city froze beautifully.

Iris.greeting: Zinzolin! That was mean! Let's win anyway!
Iris.trainerWins: That was still mean! But we won!

Zinzolin.greeting: Lenora. Your museum. Cold and quiet. I like it.

Lenora.greeting: Zinzolin. It's for history, not for you.
Lenora.trainerWins: For history, not for you. A win.
Lenora.trainerLoses: For history. Not a win.

Zinzolin.greeting: Marlon. The sea is too warm. Cool down.

Marlon.greeting: Zinzolin, dude. Chill out. Let's ride.
Marlon.trainerWins: Chilled out, dude. We won.
Marlon.trainerLoses: Froze up, dude. Bummer.

Zinzolin.greeting: Marshal. Alder's student. Strong and silent. Good.

Marshal.greeting: Zinzolin. Silence suits me. Strike when I strike.

Zinzolin.greeting: Roxie. Too loud. Too warm.
Zinzolin.trainerWins: Loud and warm, and somehow victorious.

Roxie.greeting: Zinzolin! Too loud? I'm just getting started! Let's rock!
Roxie.trainerWins: Just getting started, and we won!
Roxie.trainerLoses: Just getting started, and we lost!

Zinzolin.greeting: Shauntal. Write about the cold.

Shauntal.greeting: Zinzolin. I'll write about you losing. Let's battle.
Shauntal.trainerWins: I wrote you winning? A plot twist!
Shauntal.trainerLoses: I wrote you losing. As predicted!

Zinzolin.greeting: Skyla. The cold sky. Lovely.

Skyla.greeting: Zinzolin! The sky's lovely when it's warm, too! Let's soar!
Skyla.trainerWins: Lovely sky, lovely win!
Skyla.trainerLoses: Grounded, even in this lovely sky!

Lysandre.greeting: Bryony. Elegant and merciless. Exactly as I like it.
Lysandre.trainerWins: Merciless, as I like. Well done.

Bryony.greeting: Lysandre. Your praise is the only kind worth having.

Lysandre.greeting: Dexio. Sycamore's assistant. My old friend chose his students well.
Lysandre.trainerWins: My old friend's students. Well chosen.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: Sycamore's student. Tell him I said hello.

Dexio.greeting: Lysandre... the Professor still talks about you. Let's just battle.
Dexio.trainerWins: We won. I'll tell the Professor.
Dexio.trainerLoses: We lost. I'll tell the Professor that too.

Lysandre.greeting: Diantha. You once came to my café for a quiet coffee. Today, a loud battle.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: A loud defeat. Coffee to console us?

Diantha.greeting: Lysandre. I'll take the battle, as long as no world-ending weapon is involved.
Diantha.trainerWins: No weapons, just a win. I'll take it.
Diantha.trainerLoses: No weapons, and still a loss.

Lysandre.greeting: Drasna. Your gentleness hides great strength. A beautiful contradiction.

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Lysandre. You do say the loveliest things for a villain.
Drasna.trainerWins: Oh my! Lovely things AND a victory!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Oh dear! Lovely things, but a loss!

Lysandre.greeting: Mable. Team Flare's researcher. Put that mind to work.

Mable.greeting: Lysandre. Already working. You'll see the results.
Mable.trainerWins: Told you you'd see the results.

Lysandre.greeting: Malva. My loyal Elite Four member. You never wavered.

Malva.greeting: Lysandre. I'm a professional. Now let's make this battle front-page news.

Lysandre.greeting: Siebold. A chef who makes art. You understand beauty.

Siebold.greeting: Lysandre. I understand that beauty is shared, not hoarded.

Lysandre.greeting: Sina. Sycamore's assistant. Bright as a Kalos morning.
Lysandre.trainerWins: Bright as a Kalos morning, and victorious.

Sina.greeting: Lysandre... the Professor misses you, you know. Let's battle.
Sina.trainerLoses: We lost. He still misses you, you know.

Lysandre.greeting: Wikstrom. A knight's honor. Admirable, if outdated.
Lysandre.trainerWins: Admirable, and not outdated after all.

Wikstrom.greeting: Lysandre! Honor never goes out of date! Let us battle!

Lysandre.greeting: Xerosic. My scientist. Let's see your genius at work.

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm! Bryony! Your elegance is statistically significant!

Bryony.greeting: Xerosic. Was that a compliment? Let's battle.
Bryony.trainerWins: That was a compliment, then. And a win.

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm! Sycamore's assistant! A fellow scientist!

Dexio.greeting: Xerosic... I'm a researcher, not a mad scientist. Let's battle.
Dexio.trainerWins: Researcher, not mad scientist. We won.

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm! The Champion! Such data you'd provide!
Xerosic.trainerWins: Hmhmhm! Such data from that win!
Xerosic.trainerLoses: Hmhmhm! Such data from that loss!

Diantha.greeting: Xerosic. No data. Just a battle.
Diantha.trainerWins: No data. Just a win.
Diantha.trainerLoses: No data. Just a loss.

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Xerosic. My dragons aren't for experiments, dear.
Drasna.trainerWins: Not for experiments, but for winning!
Drasna.trainerLoses: Not for experiments, nor for winning today.

Mable.greeting: Xerosic. Let's run this experiment properly.

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm! Malva! Report on our results!

Malva.greeting: Xerosic. Live, from the Battle Tree: you're about to be impressed.
Malva.trainerWins: Live from the Battle Tree: impressed?
Malva.trainerLoses: Live from the Battle Tree: unimpressed.

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm! A chef! Cooking is just chemistry!

Siebold.greeting: Xerosic. Cooking is art. Let us battle.

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm! Sycamore's assistant! Ice! Such cold data!

Sina.greeting: Xerosic! Leave my ice alone! Let's battle!
Sina.trainerWins: You left my ice alone! We won!
Sina.trainerLoses: You touched my ice, didn't you? We lost!

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm! A knight! Such fascinating armor!

Wikstrom.greeting: Xerosic! My armor is not for study! Let us battle!
Wikstrom.trainerWins: Not for study, but for victory!

Bryony.greeting: Sycamore's assistant. Try to keep up.

Dexio.greeting: Bryony. I'll keep up just fine. Let's battle.
Dexio.trainerWins: Kept up just fine. Told you.

Bryony.greeting: The Champion. Let's see if your elegance matches mine.

Diantha.greeting: Bryony. Elegance is in the battle, not the outfit.
Diantha.trainerWins: Elegance in battle. A win.
Diantha.trainerLoses: Elegance in battle. A loss.

Drasna.greeting: Oh, Bryony. You're quite fierce yourself, dear.
Drasna.trainerWins: You're fierce, dear, and we won!

Bryony.greeting: Mable. Purple and blue. A sophisticated palette.

Mable.greeting: Bryony. Let's paint them in defeat.

Bryony.greeting: Malva. Report on how elegant I am.

Malva.greeting: Bryony. Breaking news: you're almost as elegant as I am.
Malva.trainerWins: Breaking: almost as elegant, and victorious.

Siebold.greeting: Bryony. Elegance is my specialty. Let us battle.

Bryony.greeting: Sycamore's assistant. Don't trip over your enthusiasm.

Sina.greeting: Bryony! Enthusiasm is my best feature! You'll see!

Wikstrom.greeting: Bryony! Chivalry is eternal! Let us battle!

Mable.greeting: Sycamore's assistant. Let's compare research methods.

Dexio.greeting: Mable. After the battle. Let's go.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Let's compare methods. What went wrong?

Mable.greeting: The Champion. Let's research your weaknesses. Kidding. Mostly.

Diantha.greeting: Mable. I'll research yours. Let's battle.
Diantha.trainerWins: I researched yours. And won.
Diantha.trainerLoses: I researched yours. Still lost.

Mable.greeting: Drasna. Dragons. A fascinating research subject.

Drasna.greeting: Oh my, Mable. My dragons are friends, not subjects.

Malva.greeting: Mable. Findings: we're about to win. Back to you.

Mable.greeting: Siebold. Cooking is research, in a way.

Siebold.greeting: Mable. Cooking is passion. Let us battle.

Mable.greeting: Sycamore's assistant. Cold research. I like it.

Sina.greeting: Mable! Cold research? Dexio would love this! Let's battle!

Wikstrom.greeting: Mable! Study my steel all you like; it shall not yield!

Lusamine.greeting: Acerola. Such a darling girl. Your ghosts are beautiful, too.

Acerola.greeting: Lusamine... you're scary. But let's battle!
Acerola.trainerWins: You're scary... but we won! Hee hee!

Lusamine.greeting: Faba. My Branch Chief. Do try not to embarrass me.
Lusamine.trainerWins: You didn't embarrass me. For once.

Faba.greeting: President Lusamine! I, Faba, would never!
Faba.trainerWins: I, Faba, made you proud, President!
Faba.trainerLoses: I, Faba, am so sorry, President!

Lusamine.greeting: Guzma. You were always so useful. Be useful again.
Hala. The Kahuna of Melemele. Your strength is... adequate.

Hala.greeting: Lusamine. My strength is for the island's people. Hoh! Let's battle.
Hala.trainerLoses: Hoh! The island's people will forgive us!

Kahili.greeting: Lusamine. Quaint, and winning. Let's play this round.

Lusamine.greeting: Kiawe. A Captain. Your passion is... charming.

Kiawe.greeting: Lusamine. My fire burns for Alola. Let's battle.
Kiawe.trainerLoses: My fire burned out for Alola...

Lusamine.greeting: Kukui. The professor. Your League was a lovely idea.
Lusamine.trainerWins: A lovely League, with a lovely win.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: A lovely League, with a sad loss.

Kukui.greeting: Lusamine. Woo! A President in my League! Let's make it a good one!
Kukui.trainerWins: Woo! President in my League wins!
Kukui.trainerLoses: Woo... President in my League loses!

Mallow.greeting: Lusamine. I'll cook you something sweet after we win!
Mallow.trainerWins: Sweet treat time! We won!
Mallow.trainerLoses: A sweet treat to cheer us up!

Lusamine.greeting: Molayne. A stargazer. Ultra Space is beyond your telescope.

Molayne.greeting: Lusamine. Perhaps. But my telescope doesn't hurt anyone.

Lusamine.greeting: Olivia. A Kahuna who sells jewelry. How lovely.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: Lovely jewelry. Pity about the battle.

Olivia.greeting: Lusamine. My jewelry is beautiful. So's my battling. Let's go!

Lusamine.greeting: Plumeria. Team Skull's big sister. You never liked me.
Lusamine.trainerWins: You still don't like me. We still won.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: You still don't like me. We still lost.

Plumeria.greeting: Lusamine. Still don't. Let's just win this.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Still don't like you. Won anyway.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Still don't like you. And we lost.

Faba.greeting: I, Faba, will allow you to battle beside me, girl.
Faba.trainerLoses: I, Faba, did not permit this loss!

Acerola.greeting: Faba! You're so full of yourself! Let's battle!
Acerola.trainerWins: Still full of yourself! But we won!

Henry (Tamer).trainerLoses: I'll ask my partner for a new plan. He'll just tell me to relax.

Rika.greeting: Honor? Sure, Henry. I just want to win. Keep up.
Rika.trainerWins: ...Fine. Your partner's not bad either, Henry.
Rika.trainerLoses: Study it yourself, Henry. I'm busy being annoyed.

Rika.greeting: Henry overthinks everything, but at least he doesn't panic. Let's go.
Rika.trainerWins: Decisive. That's the only way I battle.
Rika.trainerLoses: Don't you dare say "even the Queen," Henry.

Rika.greeting: Our partners train together. We don't. Let's see if that matters.
Rika.trainerWins: Guess it mattered. Whatever. Good job, Henry.
Rika.trainerLoses: If your partner tells you to relax one more time, Henry...

Tai.greeting: Takato got pulled here from his own world, just like me. And the kid's got goggles too. I like him already!
Tai.trainerWins: Nice work, Takato! Those goggles are working for you!
Tai.trainerLoses: Chin up, Takato. Even legends lose. We'll get them next time!

Tai.greeting: Two worlds, two Tamers, one tree! Takato and I didn't ask to be brought here, but we're making the most of it!
Tai.trainerWins: That's how you make the most of it! High five, Takato!
Tai.trainerLoses: Okay, that one stung. Takato, you were great, though!

Tai.greeting: Takato keeps calling me "the legendary Tai." I'm just a guy with goggles! ...But let's give you a legendary battle.
Tai.trainerLoses: So much for legendary. Let's keep that between us, Takato.

Takato.greeting: I'm actually teaming up with THE Tai! I've worn goggles because of you for as long as I can remember!
Takato.trainerWins: We won together! Tai, can I get your autograph?!
Takato.trainerLoses: I let you down, Tai... I'll be braver next time, I promise!

Takato.greeting: Tai and I both got pulled here from our own worlds. I never thought I'd meet my hero like this!
Takato.trainerWins: A high five from Tai! I'm never washing this hand!
Takato.trainerLoses: Tai said I was great?! ...Wait, we lost. Still counts!

Takato.greeting: The legendary Tai is my partner! I've dreamed about this! Don't hold back, okay? Because we won't!
Takato.trainerWins: Legendary! Totally legendary! Did you see us?!
Takato.trainerLoses: Even losing next to Tai is kind of amazing. ...Kind of.

Colress.greeting: A boy who crossed over from another world, laptop and all! Izzy, your data could rewrite my research. Shall we?
Colress.trainerWins: Splendid! Izzy's predictions and my analysis, perfectly in sync. More data for both of us!
Colress.trainerLoses: A setback! Fascinating, though. Izzy, we must analyze every turn of this.

Colress.greeting: Izzy says his world is made of data. I say every world is, if you look closely enough. Let us look closely.
Colress.trainerWins: As expected: understanding a thing is the first step to mastering it.
Colress.trainerLoses: Hmm! A variable from your world I hadn't accounted for, Izzy. How thrilling.

Colress.greeting: Izzy calculates, I theorize. Together, we bring out every last drop of our partners' potential!
Colress.trainerWins: Potential, fully realized! Izzy, that was a beautiful equation.
Colress.trainerLoses: Our potential wasn't enough today. Then we refine the formula!

Izzy.greeting: Colress wants to study how I crossed over from my world. I want to study him back. A prodigious partnership!
Izzy.trainerWins: Prodigious! I'm logging this as our first joint publication, Colress.
Izzy.trainerLoses: An anomaly in our results. Colress, I've already started the post-battle analysis.

Izzy.greeting: Colress thinks the rift that brought me here from my world can be measured. So do I. But first, a field test!
Izzy.trainerWins: Field test successful! Colress, we may need a bigger hard drive.
Izzy.trainerLoses: The field test failed, but the data is priceless. Right, Colress?

Izzy.greeting: Colress talks about potential the way I talk about computers. I like him already. Let's run the numbers!
Izzy.trainerWins: The numbers don't lie. Nice work, Colress!
Izzy.trainerLoses: The numbers lied. Or I mistyped. Colress, can you check my math?

Cheren.greeting: Izzy came here from another world and still finds time to study. I respect that. Let's be methodical.
Cheren.trainerWins: A methodical win. Good work, Izzy. My students could learn from you.
Cheren.trainerLoses: We were methodical and still lost. There's a lesson in that. Let's find it, Izzy.

Cheren.greeting: Izzy, you were pulled out of your world into ours. Show me how you adapt. That's real strength.
Cheren.trainerWins: That's what I mean by strength: adapting. Well done, Izzy.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Even adapting has its limits. We'll grow past them, Izzy.

Cheren.greeting: Izzy plans three moves ahead. I plan four. Between us, nothing is left to chance.
Cheren.trainerWins: Four moves ahead, as planned. Thank you, Izzy.
Cheren.trainerLoses: Four moves ahead, and I still missed one. Interesting.

Izzy.greeting: Cheren asked me to teach his class about the world I came from. Today's lesson: teamwork across worlds!
Izzy.trainerWins: Lesson learned! Cheren, can I tell your students about this battle?
Izzy.trainerLoses: Today's lesson didn't go to plan. Cheren, I'll revise the curriculum.

Izzy.greeting: Cheren keeps asking what strength means. In the world I'm from, it's knowledge. Let's test that hypothesis!
Izzy.trainerWins: Hypothesis confirmed: knowledge is strength! Right, Cheren?
Izzy.trainerLoses: Hypothesis inconclusive. Cheren, I propose a rematch for more data.

Izzy.greeting: Cheren's a teacher and I'm a programmer. We both love a good logic problem. You're today's!
Izzy.trainerWins: Problem solved! Cheren, that was textbook.
Izzy.trainerLoses: Problem unsolved... for now. Cheren, let's debug our strategy.
